name: Thames International College
address: Surya Bikram Gyawali Marg, Old Baneshwor, Kathmandu
description: Thames International College is a leading Tribhuvan University-affiliated college in Kathmandu, offering undergraduate programs in Business, Information Technology, and Social Sciences. Located in Old Baneshwor, the college has over 25 years of excellence in higher education and has produced 5,000+ graduates. Thames is known for its liberal education philosophy, experiential learning, student-centered approach, and commitment to preparing future-ready professionals through academic excellence and practical education.The college offers undergraduate education through three specialized academic schools: the School of Business & Management, the School of Information Technology, and the School of Social Sciences. Every program is designed to combine academic knowledge with practical experience, helping students develop critical thinking, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills for today's dynamic professional environment.School of Business & ManagementThe School of Business & Management prepares students for careers in business leadership, entrepreneurship, finance, marketing, and management through industry-oriented learning and practical exposure.It offers:Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA – Marketing)Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA – Banking and Finance)Bachelor of Business Management (BBM – Entrepreneurship)School of Information TechnologyThe School of Information Technology equips students with technical knowledge and practical computing skills to meet the demands of the rapidly evolving digital world.It offers:Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA)Bachelor of Information Technology Management (BITM)School of Social SciencesThe School of Social Sciences develops socially responsible graduates through interdisciplinary education, research, and community engagement.It offers:Bachelor of Psychology (BPsy)Bachelor of Social Work (BSW)Bachelor of Sociology (BSO)MissionThames International College aims to provide world-class liberal education and a transformative college experience for students from diverse backgrounds. The institution is committed to developing critical, independent, cooperative, future-ready, and socially responsible global citizens capable of succeeding in an ever-changing world.VisionThe vision of Thames International College is to become a premier academic institution that transforms educational approaches and raises the benchmark of higher education in Nepal through innovation, quality, and academic excellence.Educational PhilosophyThames follows a liberal education model that prepares students for both professional success and lifelong learning. The educational philosophy emphasizes:Broad interdisciplinary knowledge alongside specialized study.Critical thinking, discussion, reflection, and problem-solving.Independent, confident, and lifelong learners.Learning beyond the classroom through internships, field placements, community service, volunteering, and practical experiences.Future Ready ProgramsTo complement academic degrees, Thames offers Future Ready Programs that enhance students' professional and personal development. These include:Digital Proficiency Program (DPP)Advanced Information Technology Program (AITP)Business Creation and Entrepreneurship Program (BCEP)Global Citizenship Program (GCP)These certificate programs help students build industry-relevant skills beyond their major and prepare them for future career opportunities.Student Resources and ServicesThames International College supports students through a wide range of academic and career services, including:Career Development Center (CDC)Heart and Mind HubInformation Technology (IT) CenterWriting CenterDavid J. Rusk LibraryCommunity Service Outreach ProgramThese resources enrich the student experience while promoting academic success, personal growth, leadership, and community engagement.Core ValuesThames International College is guided by seven core values that shape its academic culture and student experience:Freedom – Encouraging individuality, acceptance, and personal growth.Student Experience – Prioritizing holistic personal and professional development.Experiential Learning – Promoting hands-on learning beyond the classroom.Diversity – Building an inclusive community that values different perspectives.Critical Thinking – Developing analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.Lifelong Learning – Inspiring continuous learning beyond graduation.Future Ready – Preparing globally competitive graduates for an evolving world.

name: Softwarica College of IT and E-commerce
description: Softwarica College, in collaboration with Coventry University, UK, offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs, including BSc (Hons) Computing, BSc (Hons) Ethical Hacking and Cyber Security, BSc (Hons) Computer Science with AI, and MSc Data Science and Computational Intelligence. On successful completion, students will receive the Coventry University degree award. All three undergraduate and one postgraduate course are equivalent degrees from Tribhuvan University (TU).Coventry University is a forward-looking, pioneering, modern University. It is one of the UK’s leading Universities, ranked No.13 in the Guardian University Guide 2019. For its quality of teaching, the university has been awarded TEF Gold in the Teaching and Excellence Framework (TEF) 2017.Over the years, Softwarica College has been committed to grooming students with a modern and hands-on learning approach, aiming to produce industry-ready graduates. The institution focuses on providing IT education with a balanced integration of real-life skills for holistic development. Additionally, the college prioritizes personality development and soft skills training to prepare students for successful careers.Softwarica College exposes students to the entrepreneurial world, encouraging them to innovate products and showcase them on various platforms to reach a wider audience. Expert guidance and support further enhance the reliability and practicality of student projects.Furthermore, the college provides students with opportunities to launch their careers as employees in locally and globally recognized companies that meet national and international standards.With a 100% employment rate among its 3,500+ alumni, Softwarica College has successfully developed market-ready graduates who have established careers worldwide.The college's infrastructure has been designed to provide an ideal learning environment where students gain real-time industry experience. Equipped with advanced computer labs, technical and networking facilities, an extensive collection of IT and business-related books, and a team of expert faculty members, the college ensures a valuable learning experience.Softwarica College requires three years of dedication from students to guarantee an enriching academic journey that fosters holistic development. The curriculum is designed to cater to tech-savvy and enthusiastic learners through regular assignments, report writing, field visits, research projects, group discussions, and presentations, all of which are fundamental aspects of program delivery.With a vision to provide real-world work experience, the college facilitates job opportunities for graduates with renowned companies in Nepal and abroad, aligning their placements with their skill levels. As a result, Softwarica College produces some of the best IT professionals in the Nepali tech sector, ensuring they secure numerous employment opportunities.

name: Techspire College
description: In 2017, Techspire entered into an academic collaboration with the Asia Pacific University of Technology and Innovation (APU). Techspire offers a comprehensive educational experience that prepares students for the dynamic and competitive industries of today. The college focuses on practical skills, industry relevance, and personalized attention to empower students for success in their chosen professions. Beyond academics, Techspire encourages innovation and entrepreneurship, with eligible ventures having the opportunity to access seed funding of up to NPR 1 crore, subject to program criteria and evaluation. Techspire has over 1,400 active students and more than 50 industry partnerships, alongside a dual curriculum and 25+ non-credit courses that support learning beyond the core degree. Its focus on hands-on learning, industry exposure, and technology skill development helps students build a foundation for careers in the evolving IT sector. name: Kathford International College of Engineering and Management
description:
Step into the future of education where AI meets ambition. Kathford International College — Nepal’s leading Engineering, IT, and Management institution — empowers students to innovate, lead, and thrive in a technology-driven world.

At Kathford, we prepare our students not just for exams, but for careers. Prep4Profession is our initiative that offers industry-relevant, non-credit certification courses designed to boost our students’ professional skills and workplace readiness. These courses go beyond the academic curriculum, equipping students with practical tools, technical expertise, and in-demand knowledge that employers are looking for. Whether it’s mastering software, developing communication skills, or learning about emerging trends in technology and business, Prep4Profession helps students build a career-ready profile—starting from day one.

College isn’t just about studies—it’s about building unforgettable memories. With “Fun Friday” at Kathford, every week ends on a high note with laughter, connection, and celebration. Students enjoy music sessions, games, open mic performances, themed events, and cultural showcases that let their creativity shine. These events, organized by student clubs and the college team, are more than just fun—they promote mental well-being, social interaction, and community spirit. They also offer a platform for students to showcase talents and develop organizational and hosting skills. It’s where friendships form, confidence builds, and the campus truly comes alive.

At Kathford, we believe every student has untapped potential waiting to shine. Campus Catalyst is our dedicated support system designed to uplift students who are facing academic challenges. Through personalized mentoring, focused academic assistance, skill-building workshops, and motivation-driven activities, we help students regain confidence, overcome obstacles, and reach their fullest potential. Whether it’s clarifying difficult concepts, building better study habits, or simply finding the right guidance, Campus Catalyst is here to ensure no student is left behind. We stand by our students every step of the way—empowering them not just to pass, but to thrive.

Navigating academic and career choices can be challenging—but not at Kathford. Our Mentorship Program pairs students with experienced mentors including alumni, faculty, and industry professionals. Through one-on-one sessions, group guidance, and mentorship meetups, students gain clarity, direction, and support. Whether you’re exploring career paths, seeking feedback, or building your network, this personalized mentorship journey ensures you’re never alone in your academic and professional growth. Beyond advice, mentors share real-world insights, open doors to opportunities, and inspire students to think bigger about their goals. At Kathford, mentorship is not just guidance—it’s a lasting relationship that empowers you to thrive in every stage of your journey.

At Kathford, academic success begins with clear goals and strategic direction. The Academic Goals and Strategy framework outlines what students are expected to achieve and maps out how they’ll get there through well-structured programs, progressive learning outcomes, and targeted teaching methods. With tools like curriculum mapping and Bloom’s Taxonomy, we ensure students grow from foundational knowledge to advanced skills and critical thinking. This model provides a consistent, engaging, and future-focused academic experience—preparing students to thrive in real-world challenges with confidence and clarity.

name: School of Arts, Sciences, & Technology (SAST)
description: School of Arts, Sciences & Technology (SAST), located at Trishakti Marg, Lazimpat, Kathmandu, offers an undergraduate Liberal Arts and Sciences program grounded in a forward-looking educational philosophy that integrates intellectual curiosity, critical inquiry, and interdisciplinary learning. The program prepares students for academic excellence and meaningful societal engagement.Its defining features reflect a coherent curricular design and a strong commitment to developing intellectually agile, socially responsible, and adaptable graduates. Through a carefully scaffolded approach that emphasizes breadth and depth, exploration and application, the program fosters analytical rigor, intellectual versatility, and a sustained commitment to lifelong learning.The School of Arts, Sciences & Technology offers undergraduate programs including Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (CSIT), Bachelor of Science in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DSAI), Bachelor of Science in Integrated Science, Bachelor of Arts in Psychology, Bachelor of Arts in Social Sciences, Bachelor of Arts in Finance and Economics, Bachelor of Arts in Economics, Bachelor of Science in Business Analytics, Bachelor of Science in Sustainable Energy Systems (SES), Bachelor of Science in Environmental Technologies and Management (ETM), Bachelor of Science in Climate Change and Sustainability (CCS), Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy, Politics, Economics and Law (PPEL), Bachelor of Arts in English Studies, Bachelor of Arts in Communication and Media Studies (CMS), and Bachelor of Arts in Gender and Development Studies (GDS).VisionReshaping higher education for a better future.MissionTo produce competent, conscientious, and socially responsible scholars and leaders by fostering knowledge, creativity, innovation, and entrepreneurship for a sustainable and prosperous society.Core ValuesIntegrity and ethicsIntellectual rigor and excellencePursuit of truthAcademic autonomy and freedomTolerance, dignity, and respectEquity, inclusion and social responsibilityCollegiality and accountabilityInnovationPublic purposeResponsiveness and institutional resilience

name: The London College
description: The London College, promoted by ISMT Group, offers higher education in academic partnership with the University of the West of Scotland. The London College follows the benchmarks of the UK Education system that applies the best of educational practices, theories, resources, and standards that provide students with industry-relevant knowledge, hands-on practical skills, and professional aptitude that are prerequisites in the competitive employment market and modern industry. The College offers programs that cater to the needs of students who wish to pursue a career in computing, IT, Data Science, AI etc. The college's faculty members are highly qualified and experienced, ensuring that students receive the best possible education. The College has state-of-the-art facilities and the latest technology to provide students with a hands-on learning experience. The curriculum is designed to provide students with the necessary skills and knowledge to succeed in their chosen fields. The College is committed to innovation that addresses key industry requirements. We provide an environment that offers an exciting, challenging, engaging, and creative higher education experience. This will, we hope, provide a platform for students’ future personal and professional development. The College works closely with a range of partners and professional bodies to ensure our graduates have the appropriate skills and knowledge to achieve the careers they aspire to.A degree from The London College provides students with an exceptional opportunity for exciting careers at the forefront of their respective industries. MissionTo provide students with the knowledge and necessary skills required for quality future employment, which will enable them to contribute to society and the nation. The college shall always strive to further its mission under the motto 'creative, excellent, result-oriented'.VisionTo be a premier institution of higher learning, empowering students to achieve their full potential through exceptional education, research, and innovation. Cultivating critical thinkers and preparing students to become responsible and able global citizens.Why The London College?Studying BSc (Hons) Computing Science and BSc (Hons) Computer Networking at The London College is an excellent choice for anyone looking to build a career in Computing and IT-related sectors. The college has a strong foundation in its subject areas, with highly knowledgeable, industry-relevant faculty members dedicated to providing students with subject-specific applied skills and skills for life and work.The course is designed to meet the demands of the rapidly growing industry, providing students with the skills and knowledge they need to succeed in their fields of study. The course emphasizes practical, hands-on learning that allows students to apply their knowledge in real-world settings.The college is well-equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, including computer labs, data science and AI labs, and software development environments. Furthermore, the college has strong industry connections, providing students with internships and job opportunities, as well as networking events with leading companies in the field.Studying a BSc in Computer Science, Data Science, and AI, students can pursue a wide range of career opportunities, such as software developer, data analyst, machine learning engineer, data scientist, AI researcher, and many more.Further, the college offers a variety of extracurricular activities that help students further develop their skills and interests in computer science, data science, and AI.The college also offers a strong career services department, which can help students find job opportunities after graduation, and a strong alumni network that can provide networking opportunities and mentorship after graduation.

name: People's Campus
description: People’s Campus is located at Paknajol, Kathmandu with the main block of the campus consisting of more than 60 classrooms and spacious ground for outdoor games, parking, and other purposes. The campus building and the inner area cover more than four ropanies of land at the heart of the city in Paknajol, which makes the campus self-dependent regarding the need for infrastructure. Its peaceful atmosphere is conducive to learning and teaching. The campus is a pioneering and a leading community-based academic institution was established in 1981 AD by a group of educationist, academicians and key stakeholders in the field of education with the motto of enhancing quality education which is affordable to the wider society. People's Campus offers 10+2 in Management with the affiliation from National Examination Board (NEB) and BBA, BBM, BBS and MBS programs with the affiliation from Tribhuvan University.Along the changing pace and demand of time, the campus has been modifying and modernizing the teaching pedagogy and organizing various types of demand-driven training for the teachers. In order to strengthen the learner autonomy in the classroom and motivate the learners intrinsically, the campus organizes activities viz workshops, presentations, seminars, and well-modified lectures. People's campus combines academic excellence with an innovative and entrepreneurial approach to research supporting a culture that engages and challenges students and staff in their pursuit of learning.People's Campus ensures that students are prepared for employment, entrepreneurship, and opportunities when they graduate. One of the ways in which we do this is through the awards, which recognizes and reward students who have gained significant academic skills through curricular and extracurricular activities and help them develop skills successfully to be potential employees and employer. The evidence is People’s Campus has regularly been winning the prestigious “Nepal Chamber of Commerce Excellence Award” for securing the best result in the Management Education and TU topper awards several times in BBS and MBS of TU.Objectives:Provide quality education for all at an affordable costImpart value based quality education on civility, integrity, and respectProvide students with research skills required to succeed in the competitive societyEnsure opportunities for outstanding careersEnsure that the competent manpower for the service of the nation and the global community

name: Embark College
description: Embark College is a beacon of educational excellence. It is committed to shaping future leaders who excel as professionals, innovative thinkers, fearless leaders, and compassionate global citizens. With a mission to inspire curiosity, ignite entrepreneurial spirit, and foster an inclusive learning environment, the college is dedicated to transforming education into a catalyst for personal and societal growth.At Embark College, education goes beyond traditional academics. The institution emphasizes a holistic approach, equipping students with the skills, adaptability, and resilience required to navigate the complexities of the modern world with confidence and integrity.Embark College graduates are more than career-ready; they emerge as empowered individuals capable of making meaningful contributions to a rapidly evolving global landscape. Guided by its steadfast commitment to excellence, innovation, and social responsibility, Embark College strives to leave a lasting impact on both its students and society.With a vision to nurture the next generation of change-makers, Embark College invites aspiring learners to join a transformative journey toward leadership and lifelong success.AffiliationThe University of Roehampton, located in London, UK, is renowned for its vibrant campus community and commitment to providing an exceptional student experience. Established in 2004, though its roots date back over 175 years, Roehampton offers various undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various disciplines, including Business, Information Technology, Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, and Education.Roehampton stands out for its supportive, inclusive environment, where students are encouraged to explore their academic interests and personal passions. The university prides itself on its strong emphasis on research-led teaching, ensuring students benefit from the latest developments in the field. It has modern facilities, beautiful parkland surroundings, and a strong focus on student well-being. Roehampton provides an ideal setting for students to thrive academically and socially.Core Values of Embark CollegeExcellenceInnovationEthicsLeadershipDiversityIntegritySustainable GrowthMission of Embark CollegeEmbark College's mission is to empower individuals to become leaders, innovators, and compassionate global citizens. The college nurtures intellectual curiosity, an entrepreneurial mindset, professional development, and inclusivity. It provides a holistic education that goes beyond textbooks. Embark strives to develop individuals capable of flourishing in the modern world with confidence and integrity.Empowerment: Empower individuals to become fearless leaders, innovative thinkers, and compassionate global citizens.Environment: The college strives to create an environment that nurtures intellectual curiosity, encourages entrepreneurial spirit, and promotes a culture of inclusivity.Commitment: They are committed to providing a holistic education that goes beyond textbooks, fostering the development of well-rounded individuals capable of confidently and with integrity navigating the complexities of the modern world.Vision of Embark CollegeEmbark College envisions a future where education is the driving force towards positive change. They seek to become a hub for learning that attracts and inculcates skillful human capital. Their vision is to produce graduates who excel beyond their chosen fields, possessing the adaptability and determination to define a rapidly evolving world. Through their commitment to excellence, innovation, and social responsibility, they are a catalyst for positive transformation, leaving an indelible mark on individuals and society alike. They are committed to integrating sustainability principles into our curriculum and promoting skill-based education.

name: Global College of Management
description: Global College of Management (GCM), located in Baneshwor, Kathmandu, is an English-medium, co-educational institution owned by Professional Holdings Ltd. GCM aims to be an internationally renowned learning center recognized for academic excellence in teaching and research in business and management studies. GCM has become a choice for young students seeking to explore their career goals and achieve higher goals. The college focuses on experiential learning, practical input and exposure, life skills development, quality education, a conducive environment, and results.The institution has created an environment in which students can support their intellectual, emotional, and physical development. GCM fosters individual student exposure in an academic environment supported by physical facilities. To encourage holistic personality development, the college offers a series of co-curricular and extra-curricular activities. The classrooms are equipped with multimedia projectors and audio-visual facilities that support the goal of providing a comfortable learning space. Additionally, the college features seminar halls with air conditioning and essential amenities for various academic events, as well as computer labs with internet access.Students have access to technology-driven facilities, including computer labs and a spacious library with a substantial collection of physical and electronic resources. The learning environment is further supported by integrated e-learning systems, virtual classrooms, and tech-enabled teaching methods. GCM facilitates students not only with theoretical academic knowledge but also through frequent field visits to industries and organizations, case studies, research activities, and presentation sessions designed to build self-confidence and practical skills.The academic direction of GCM is guided by a team of academicians, researchers, and professionals. The college focuses on nurturing students to become professionals equipped with the knowledge, skills, and ethical values required to lead in global contexts. GCM graduates have established track records in further studies and job placements both within Nepal and abroad. By providing modern physical, technological, and digital learning resources, GCM offers management education that prepares students for 21st-century careers at an affordable cost.Excellence & RecognitionConsistently recognized as Nepal’s leading institution for +2 Management Studies, GCM has established itself as the first choice for ambitious learners from across the country. The college’s success is not limited to rankings or numbers; it is reflected in the thousands of students who have gone on to excel at top universities and in careers worldwide.GCM’s reputation sustains with the strength of three pillars:· Academic Distinction: The academic programs of GCM are designed to meet global standards, ensuring students receive a curriculum that is both rigorous and time-tested.· Dynamic Teaching Model: GCM embraces student-centered learning, integrating lectures with group discussions, interactive projects, case methods of learning, and the use of digital tools to make learning engaging and impactful.· Holistic Development: GCM is more than an academic institution-it is a nurturing ground for leadership, creativity, and personal growth.

name: Divya Gyan College
description: Divya Gyan College, established in 2007 and located at Putalisadak, Kamaladi Mod, Kathmandu, delivers quality education in Information Technology and Management. Established by a team of dedicated and result-oriented academicians and professionals under the motto “Unleashing Limitless Possibilities,” the college offers Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) and Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) programs in affiliation with Tribhuvan University (TU).Divya Gyan College aims to equip inquisitive learners with essential facilities and practical skills to prepare them for their future careers. Alongside regular university curricula, the institution offers non-credit courses every semester, enabling BCA students to kickstart their professional journeys from the first semester and access global IT certification courses. Similarly, BBS students can deepen their expertise in accountancy, finance, marketing, and management through specialized professional courses designed to support career growth.Supported by a strong faculty with extensive academic and professional experience, the college focuses on students' holistic intellectual, social, psychological, emotional, and spiritual development. Divya Gyan College remains committed to fostering capable and responsible global citizens through strategic educational innovations.MissionDivya Gyan College's mission is to provide affordable and quality education in management and IT. The college believes in both academic and professional growth. Therefore, college equip students with all the necessary skills to prepare them for the industry. The college believes that students also need soft skills to excel in their careers; therefore, the college provides necessary soft skills training to enhance their leadership quality, communication skills, and presentation skills.VisionDivya Gyan's vision is to establish the college as a renowned educational institution in the field of IT and management. We want our students to become professional and responsible citizens of society who can compete globally in their chosen area.

name: Nepal College of Information Technology (NCIT)
description: Nepal College of Information Technology (NCIT) is located at Balkumari, Lalitpur. It was founded in 2001 A.D. with affiliation to Pokhara University and offers Bachelor's and Master's programs - BE, BCA, ME, MSc, and MCIS. The engineering degrees in this college are approved by the Nepal Engineering Council. The colleges functions with a commitment to provide high-end state of the art IT related education in the country. it acknowledges that learning is a lifelong process, and the educational foundation that it provides for its students is one on which one can build a lifetime of curiosity, professional success and responsibility. Nepal College of Information Technology (NCIT) is a pioneer private institution providing engineering education in Nepal. It is renowned for excellence in training and research, while maintaining close and mutually beneficial links with various sectors. The college provides excellent higher education opportunities and nurtures individual talent using applicable knowledge that fully supports ongoing social changes.Qualified and experienced faculties are fully dedicated to their teaching. The college has a state of the art infrastructure to foster academic excellence. Moreover, it provides vital non-credit inputs including research and project work, supplementing the regular courses to meet the diverse learning needs of its students and improve their employability.The College is also an authorized training partner of CISCO, Red Hat, and Microsoft. It provides related training and conducts preparatory examinations leading to internationally recognized certifications from these renowned institutions. NCIT has MOUs with the Microsoft Innovation Center and many reputed multinational and local companies for internships and training programs.NCIT envisions an institutional role for itself beyond academic boundaries. It takes the aspirations and future success of its students as pathway to nation building.

name: NCTTM - IST College
address: Gyaneshwor, Opposite to German Embassy, Kathmandu
description: International School of Tourism and Hotel Management (IST College), affiliated with Tribhuvan University, was established in 2004 A.D. with the aim of producing world-class human resources to meet the growing demand of the hospitality industry by offering various academic degrees and training packages aligned with international standards.IST College focuses on developing practical, managerial, and communication skills and provides each student with the necessary knowledge for a successful career in the hospitality sector. It is recognized as a center of excellence in hospitality education, offering an enterprising and stimulating environment where students can grow and reach their full potential. The academic structure is designed to combine management theory with hands-on experience, ensuring an international perspective in teaching.Over the past 20+ years, IST has built a strong reputation as a provider of quality education in Nepal. Its graduates are pursuing higher education in countries such as the USA, UK, Australia, New Zealand, and various parts of Europe. Many are also working as mid-level managers in Nepal and abroad.In collaboration with Nepal College of Travel & Tourism Management (NCTTM), the first college in Nepal to offer academic degrees in travel and tourism for the past 24 years, IST also offers Bachelor in Hotel Management (BHM), Bachelor in Travel and Tourism Management (BTTM), and Master in Travel and Tourism Management (MTTM) programs under Tribhuvan University. Through this partnership, students can also earn the Certified Hospitality Professional degree from Tourism School Salzburg, Austria, which includes training in soft skills and industry-relevant knowledge essential for professional success.IST is affiliated with Salzburg University of Applied Sciences, Austria, and has built a strong network with academic and corporate institutions both in Nepal and internationally. It is QAA-certified by the University Grants Commission (UGC) Nepal, and has academic cooperation with the University of Central Lancashire, International College of Hotel Management (ICHM), Australia, Suan Dusit Rajabhat University, Griffith College, CDU, STS, SNHU, Shinawatra University, Dhurakij Pundit University, and Sanya Aviation & Tourism College, China.Both IST and NCTTM have agreed to implement a joint quality management system under shared ownership to ensure student development aligns with international standards. The team is committed to providing a supportive environment that nurtures capable, disciplined, and motivated individuals ready to excel in the global hospitality and tourism industry.Vision of ISTTo be a centre for excellence in hospitality education in Nepal, providing an enterprising and stimulating environment in which students can learn and develop their full potential.Mission Statement of ISTProduce the world class human resource to cater to the overwhelming need of the hospitality industries by offering various academic degrees by providing an educational environment that emphasizes critical thinking and decision making, reflection and creativity.Cultivate and nurture a learning environment that fosters an ethical, respectful, and culturally competent approach to customer service and with other hospitality partners. Respond to community needs through a variety of means, including collaboration with organizations and businesses.Develop practical, managerial, and excellent communication skills by providing each individual student with the know-how of a successful career in the tality industry.Goal of ISTTo achieve its vision and mission by combining management theory with practical experiences in the field of tourism and hospitality ensuring an international teaching approach.

name: Uniglobe College
description: Uniglobe College is established to be a center of learning in modern management education. The promoting team of Uniglobe College consists of academicians, researchers, entrepreneurs, and professionals who enjoy a considerable reputation both at home and abroad.Uniglobe College, in affiliation with Pokhara University, offers programs in Bachelor of Computer System and Information Technology (BSCIT), Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance (BBA-Finance), Master of Business Administration (MBA), and Master of Business Administration in Finance (MBA-Finance). The promoting team members of Uniglobe College are academically sound and they have proven track records of success in education entrepreneurship in Nepal. The team has considerable national and international experience and immense expertise for teaching, learnin,g and managing the educational institutes. The team established the college in 2009 with a vision to enlarge it as an internationally renowned and premier business school in Nepal.Uniglobe College management firmly believes that effective dissemination of knowledge and skills to students is possible only when the efforts of subject experts, learned teachers, and researchers are backed by the much-needed modern equipment and facilities. The college team is always committed to providing quality education that meets the needs of a competitive business environment.VisionUniglobe College aims to be a nationally and internationally reputed institution known for academic and professional excellence in research, management, and information technology, equipping students to contribute locally and globallyMissionTo develop managers, entrepreneurs, and market leaders through market-friendly, accessible, flexible, and innovative academic programs;To develop management graduates who would be able to grasp local, nationa,l and international business needs and serve accordingly;To develop researchers in the areas of management and economics. and information technology;To produce competent human resources in the area of computer and information technology.ObjectivesTo develop management graduates at various levels with sound management knowledge, skills, and values along with positive leadership qualities;To instill creativity and innovativeness in the students through motivational approaches of personalized nurturing guidance.To make learning and living at the college a wonderfully pleasant experience for our students to develop a strong sense of friendship and fraternity.To establish relations with universities, research institutes, and corporate organizations in Nepal and abroad for the enhancement of academic excellence, researc,h and professional work ability of the students;To produce self-motivated, innovative, and creative entrepreneurs and IT professionals so as to reduce the widespread unemployment in the nation.

name: Ace International Business School
address: Sri Ekata Marg, New Baneshwor, Kathmandu
description: Ace International Business School is presented on the shared Ace website, ace.edu.np, alongside Ace Institute of Management. Ace dates the institution to 1999.

name: Modern Nepal College
description: MODERN NEPAL COLLEGE (MNC), affiliated to Tribhuvan University (T.U.), is located at Sorhakhutte, Kathmandu, and offers Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS), and Master of Business Studies (MBS). The college is committed to developing the human resources essential to the country’s development by providing high-quality, professionally relevant education. MNC aims to uplift the quality of education to produce skilled manpower in the country through the vision of a renewed, rich, and experienced team of teaching faculty members and top-level management professionals. It is run by an excellent team of scholars, academicians, and stalwarts. It offers students applied business techniques and industry-based practical exposure.A team of experts is fully committed to preparing the MNC students to be competent enough to face the challenges of the 21st century. Quality education in an excellent educational environment is the college's main motto. Techniques and methods adopted by some selected nationally recognized teaching staff in a good environment have become a significant characteristic of the college.MISSIONThe mission of Modern Nepal College is to establish itself as an excellent educational center and to ensure the provision of an international standard of education within the home country.OBJECTIVESTo provide applied management and business studies to make the students highly competent in management and business affairs in the present global context.To promote a high degree of self-confidence, self-reliance, moral behavior, and dedication to duty in students' behavior and attitudes.To offer application and career-oriented educational programs of Tribhuvan University and other Universities.To develop students' skills in object-oriented business administration capable of understanding and solving practical business problems.

name: Kantipur College of Management and Information Technology
description: Kantipur College of Management and Information Technology (KCMIT) is situated on Basuki Marg in Mid Baneshwor, Kathmandu. Founded in 2000 A.D., the institution was established under Tribhuvan University's initiative to partner with the private education sector to deliver advanced education to Nepalese students.KCMIT was founded by a team of management educationists and IT professionals with extensive, long-standing experience in teaching and educational management. It holds the distinction of being the first Tribhuvan University college to launch and run the Bachelor in Information Technology Management (BITM) program.Presently, KCMIT offers BITM and BBA programs in affiliation with Tribhuvan University. From 2075 BS, KCMIT also launched BCA program with affiliation from Tribhuvan University. The student centric approach of the institution with academic facilities and resources are arguably the best in the nation and the college is committed to offer what promising future leaders truly deserve. BBA program of Tribhuvan University in 2004 was introduced as the result from the encouragement of the management team and with the growing demand of management graduated in the job market which was possible because of co-operative and enthusiastic IT experts, management educationists and dedicated faculty members necessary for quality education. Kantipur College of Management and Information Technology aims to establish a strong academic foundation, achieve outstanding examination results and engender a mature and independent attitude vital for taking advantage of life’s opportunities. The college is committed to nurture high quality education and development by creating a conducive environment where students and faculties’ activities are in synergy.Mission:To create an environment for the students that fosters future business leaders and IT experts who are committed to excellence and a clear sense of vision for the future. College aims to contribute significantly to nation-building by providing our graduates with the necessary skills and knowledge to drive change and make innovation for the nation with their enriched expertise.Vision:To be recognized as Nepal's premier institution for Business and IT education. The college strives to develop graduates who can skillfully seize national and international business and IT opportunities, leading the way in a competitive global economy, and to develop graduates who will visualize and skillfully grasp the opportunities of Business and IT.

Westcliff University was established to provide quality education for students wishing to enter the expanding fields of Business, Technology, and Education. Westcliff received its initial approval from the Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education in 1993 ( www.bppe.ca.gov ) and Westcliff University is accredited by the WASC Senior College and University Commission (WSCUC) , 1080 Marina Village Parkway, Suite 500, Alameda, CA 94501 510.748.9797, an institutional accrediting body recognized by the U.S. Department of Education (ED), and the Council on Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), a private nonprofit national organization that serves its members, students, and society through advocacy for the value and independence of accreditation, recognition of accrediting organizations, and commitment to quality in higher education.

Westcliff University College of Business programs are globally accredited by the Accreditation Council for Business Schools and Programs (ACBSP) (www.acbsp.org) , a standard of excellence with an accreditation process based on the Baldrige Education Criteria for Performance Excellence.

Westcliff has four colleges, the College of Business, the College of Education, the College of Technology & Engineering, and the Western State College of Law. The university offers graduate and undergraduate certificates and degree programs intended to prepare students for immediate entry and advancement in their respective industries. While some schools only teach theoretical concepts, the programs at Westcliff University prepare students for the practical and theoretical elements required in the job market today. The university equips students for personal, professional, and academic success through innovative, up-to-date, and high-quality programs.

At Westcliff University, the faculty and academic leadership prioritize program quality. Students trust the faculty to guide them in acquiring the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary for success in their chosen fields, and the faculty takes this responsibility seriously. The curriculum is designed to allow students the opportunity to chart their own path, demonstrating their understanding and ability to apply critical concepts for success in their areas of study. Westcliff's faculty continuously develop their skills as educators to effectively connect with students of various learning styles, facilitate shared learning processes, and apply the most up-to-date methods of instruction. Moreover, the faculty at Westcliff are working professionals with an average of over 20 years of experience in their industries, and they pride themselves on bringing their wealth of real-world experience into the classroom to support student learning. The academic department of Westcliff University aims to ensure that every student at Westcliff receives the instruction, guidance, and support needed to meet their academic and future career goals.

Situated in New Baneshwor, Kathmandu, the Presidential Graduate School was founded in 2011, with the mission to establish itself as a benchmark for quality education in Nepal.

name: KIST College & SS
description: KIST College & SS, located in Kamalpokhari, Kathmandu, was established in 1995 and has since developed into a recognized academic institution for students pursuing +2, Bachelor's, and Master’s level programs. With a legacy spanning nearly three decades, the college focuses on providing a stable and intellectually stimulating environment. It currently serves a diverse community of over 1,600 students, combining academic rigor with a professional orientation.The college offers a comprehensive range of programs designed to meet various educational goals. At the secondary level, KIST provides NEB-affiliated +2 courses in Science and Management. Undergraduate offerings include the BBA, BITM, BIT, BBS, and the BSc in Microbiology. For postgraduate studies, the institution provides MBS, MSc Microbiology, and MIT. These programs are delivered by an experienced faculty dedicated to a student-centered and pragmatic teaching approach.The campus is situated in a peaceful setting next to the Kamalpokhari pond, offering ample space for academic and extracurricular activities. The infrastructure is purpose-built and secure, featuring well-equipped laboratories and a modern library complemented by an e-library. To make your stay convenient, the college offers well-managed transport, a cafeteria, and separate hostels for boys and girls. Its central location ensures easy access to regular public transport.Beyond the classroom, KIST emphasizes holistic development by organizing various events, sports, and co-curricular programs. The institution encourages students to engage in meaningful social service, fostering responsibility toward the community. By integrating academic rigor with career counseling, the college helps students refine their academic purpose and prepare for professional success. KIST remains committed to building capable, confident individuals equipped with the practical skills and knowledge necessary to navigate a dynamic and rapidly evolving world.VisionTo be the most sought-after college, renowned for its unwavering commitment to academic excellence.MissionTo provide a dynamic & welcoming learning environment to bring out the best personally & academically in its studentsTo set top standards so that our learners can transform themselves and shape their lives betterTo help students achieve professional quests and life goals in their chosen fields of studies, research, and professionsTo empower students to be effective scholars dedicated to lifelong learning & critical thinking for a positive impact on their futureTo foster a culture of innovation & entrepreneurship so as to have a marked change in the knowledge economy, industry, & societyValuesKind DisplayCompassion & EmpathyInnovative Introduce novelty & creativitySincereDemonstrate genuineness & honestyTrustworthyPossess reliability & trustworthinessInsightful Show understanding & perceptivenessAccountable Embody responsibility & transparencyNoble Personify principles & dignitySupportive Offer help and encouragement

name: GATE - Global Academy of Tourism and Hospitality Education
description: The Global Academy of Tourism and Hospitality Education (GATE College), is one of Nepal’s premier institutions in hospitality and tourism management. Established in May 2007, GATE has gained recognition as a forward-thinking and award-winning academy committed to developing future leaders in the world's most dynamic industry: tourism and hospitality.As an extension college of Kathmandu University School of Management, GATE focuses on academic excellence, linking education and employment, and impactful research. With a clear vision to become one of the top five hotel management colleges in South Asia within the next five years, GATE prepares students to become capable professionals and change-makers in the global hospitality sector.GATE was the first institution in Nepal to receive an international award at the World Hospitality Awards in Paris, winning Most Innovative Training Program in 2011 and becoming a finalist for Best Professional Success in 2015. The college has also received the National Food Safety Award from the Government of Nepal, reinforcing its commitment to academic quality, industry relevance, and professional standards.International credibility is further strengthened through its certified membership in the Ecole hôtelière de Lausanne (EHL) network. EHL is consistently ranked as the world's top hospitality management school, with campuses in Switzerland and Singapore. Since 2021, GATE has been part of this exclusive network, allowing students in Nepal to access Swiss-standard hospitality education locally at a significantly reduced cost. Students also benefit from academic mobility across EHL campuses and certified member institutions worldwide.GATE offers the Bachelor's in International Hospitality Management (BIHM), which is EHL-accredited and academically mapped to the Bachelor's degree of Tribhuvan University. This program provides full credit transfer opportunities within the Swiss Schools network and several other international universities. Student intakes are available in January or February and August or September.Another major offering is the Bachelor in Professional Hospitality (BPH), affiliated with Kathmandu University. This program combines classroom learning with 3.5 years of practical experience, following both full-time and apprenticeship models. It blends modern hospitality practices with Nepal’s indigenous culture, food heritage, and traditions, preparing students for both local and global career paths.GATE also offers vocational and professional programs, including the Diploma in Culinary Arts, Bakery Training, Cook Training, and Barista Courses. It offers the SIT30816 Certificate III in Commercial Cookery, a government-recognized qualification, in partnership with TAFE NSW (RTO 90003). Many of these programs are conducted in coordination with CTEVT Nepal, aligning with both national and international standards.GATE believes that education should not be limited to the classroom. The college employs a range of instructional strategies, including edutainment, experiential learning, and collaborative approaches. This teaching philosophy supports the holistic development of students and prepares them for real-world challenges.With over 9,000 alumni working in hospitality and related industries around the world, GATE continues to raise the benchmark for hospitality education in Nepal. Its award-winning programs, global partnerships, and commitment to innovation make it a trusted choice for students seeking meaningful and rewarding careers in the tourism and hospitality industries.VisionTo create a world-class platform for education and careers in hospitality and tourism, enabling GATE graduates to become highly qualified and sought-after professionals in today’s global market.Institutional VisionTo become one of the top 5 Hotel Management Schools in South Asia within 5 years.MissionTo support students’ learning and career aspirations by helping them unlock their potential and to establish a globally respected institution grounded in integrity, respect, and passion.Institutional MissionTo foster academic excellence, bridging education with employment opportunities, and conducting impactful research that advances the field of hospitality and tourism.Core ValuesThe core values of GATE College are Wisdom Focus, Service-Oriented, Potential-Driven, and Respect-Based. These principles shape its decisions, culture, and commitment to excellence in hospitality education.

name: Public Youth Campus
description: Public Youth Campus (PYC), a premier constituent campus of Tribhuvan University's Faculty of Management, holds an undisputed place in the historical development of management education in Nepal, having been established in 1971 (2028 BS). The campus is distinguished by a profound tradition of learning where teachers and students exhibit exemplary cooperation, understanding, trust, and commitment, creating an atmosphere often compared to ancient seats of scholarship. PYC is consistently lauded by academia for its commitment to maintaining a pure educational environment, shielded from political disruptions. Historically, the campus has consistently met the nation's fundamental business management manpower requirements, cultivating expertise in accounts, insurance, audit, commercial correspondence, franchise operations, trade, and administrative tasks. This focus has been instrumental in empowering Nepal's business sector and its international relations, particularly in the post-1950 democratic era, by filling a critical void in skilled human resources and evolving from the initial commerce education efforts.PYC has a magnificent learning legacy in which instructors and students have demonstrated remarkable mutual cooperation, understanding, trust, and devotion, almost evocative of ancient seats of learning. Academics frequently describe it as a TU-constituent campus where political or disruptive actions would have little impact on or damage its instructional atmosphere.MissionTo provide high-quality education through rigorous academic standards and practical experience, empowering students to excel in diverse business fields and positively impact society.VisionTo be a premier institution recognized for cultivating innovative and ethical leaders in management who contribute to sustainable development in Nepal and beyond.Key of SuccessTo empower students through a dynamic blend of innovative education, industry collaboration, and ethical leadership, fostering the next generation of skilled professionals in management.

Empowering hospitality leaders across the globe through world-class academic standards, hands-on training, and unprecedented industry placements.

name: SAIM College
description: South Asian Institute of Management (SAIM) is located at Old Baneshwor, Kathmandu. It is an independent academic institution established in 2005 to provide need-based management education.The college focuses on management development, research, and consultation to facilitate the growth and development of managers, entrepreneurs, and business leaders in South Asia as it is emerging as the most dynamic Asian regional economic center for global trade, investment, and technology innovation. SAIM offers MBA (Global Business) and BBA programs under affiliation with Pokhara University, established to provide world-class management education and training to meet the demands and needs of the nations, regionally as well as globally.One of the significant strengths of SAIM College is its faculty members, who are well-qualified and experienced with adequate exposure to their areas and remain constantly updated on their expertise through research, consulting, and training. The faculty aims to help the students explore the latest management thinking, so they gain knowledge, skills, and insight into all critical areas of general management. Inviting CEOs as visiting faculty from business houses and reputed academic institutions from home and abroad to share their experiences with the students and provide them practical insight into managerial problems is a common practice at SAIM.VisionTo be a reputed regional learning center recognized globally for excellence in its teaching and research in management and development.MissionTo develop managers, leaders, and entrepreneurs with a strong sense of integrity and commitment through the creation, preservation, and dissemination of knowledge keeping in perspective the South Asian values to serve best the interest of business, government, non-government organizations, and society at large. SAIM is dedicated to striving relentlessly in the academic domain to produce scholars and empower its graduates to attain leadership positions in South Asia and abroad.ObjectivesTo develop managers with sound management knowledge, skills, values, leadership qualities, and a positive attitude.To build relevant and practical curricula grounded on sound theory and based on regional case studies and experience sharing.To motivate students to bring out their best and foster creativity, innovation, and effective team building.To teach creativity and innovativeness in the faculty through continuing education, faculty development programs, consulting, and research.To forge an institutional and joint venture with reputed institutions globally.To foster close links with the business and academic community in South Asia and elsewhere.To make learning and living at the Institute a unique experience for all participants and provide them with a sense of camaraderie and friendship that embraces all cultures and religions.

name: Global College International
description: About Global College International (GCI), KathmanduGlobal College International (GCI) is a nationally recognized higher education institution in Nepal, dedicated to developing skilled professionals in business administration, management, hospitality, hotels, travel and tourism.With a student-centered academic culture, Global College International supports learners through modern infrastructure, industry engagement, and research-oriented teaching—making it a preferred choice for students searching for quality management education in Nepal.VisionThe primary vision of Global College International is to be a nationally and internationally reputed learning center, and a pioneer of global education recognized for academic excellence in teaching, research, and innovation in management studies, in addition to IT, Law, and other emerging disciplines, posting a high level of academic and professional significance in 21st-century local and global contexts.MissionGCI’s mission is to provide modern academic programs that are results-oriented and focus on students’ needs, so that every graduate may aspire to become a competent and qualified professional in today’s rapidly changing environment. We aspire to achieve excellence in our endeavor by providing:The best possible opportunities for learning and skills development.A creative and exciting partnership with our faculty, staff, students, a creative and exciting partnership with our faculty, staff, students, business sector, economic and development sector, legal sector, international sector, IT sector, and other sectors of career prospects.A welcoming, safe, and supportive learning environment.Within the above guidelines, GCI commits: To manage higher education comprising academic programs in information technology, humanities, and social sciences, including development economics, law, and other emerging disciplines that hold the highest scientific, technological, and socio-economic significance for developing global citizenship knowledge, skills, and values, along with positive leadership qualities.To develop skilled managers, entrepreneurs, legal experts, economists, development experts, IT experts, market leaders, and skilled professionals through market-friendly, accessible, flexible, and innovative academic programs.To develop graduates of Management, Development, Law, Information Technology (IT), and other emerging disciplines who would be able to grasp local, national, and international technological emergence and needs, and serve accordingly.To develop the graduates of Management, Economics, Law, Development, Information Technology, and other prospective disciplines who would be excellent researchers and innovators.To develop socially very responsible future citizens.ObjectiveThe main objective of Global College International is to prepare professional, research-oriented human resources capable of handling tasks effectively and efficiently in this changing global environment, across the social sciences and information technology. The specific objectives are:To manage higher education comprising academic programs in management, information technology (IT), economic development, law, international relations, and other emerging disciplines that hold the highest socio-economic significance for developing global citizenship knowledge, skills, and values, along with positive leadership qualities.To develop a physical, technological, and academic learning environment at par with the national and international standards.To provide students with a caring and conducive learning environment to bring out the best in them.To instill creativity and innovation in students through motivational approaches and personalized nurturing guidance.To motivate students and faculty to be involved in research and innovative learning activities.To make learning and living at college a wonderfully practicable, pleasant experience for all, and to develop a strong yet tender bond of friendship and fraternity.To establish relations with universities and management institutes of Nepal and abroad for program enhancement.

name: Prime College
description: Students' needs are met by the college's provision of the best directive teachers, academics, specialists, and faculty members. Unlike other colleges, Prime College offers facilitators who provide students adequate room to establish their own goals, explore their hobbies, and ensure that their route is eminent with their uttermost guidance at every step when needed.Prime's programs are unique in that they provide students with both theoretical and practical knowledge. Prime is recognized nationwide for its world-class academic programs, as well as its growing number of community and civic engagement activities.Similarly, Prime clubs are made up of active students. These five clubs encourage students to learn via experience by putting on their own activities. They help kids develop leadership skills, support them in receiving initiation, and improve their creativity and ingenuity. Prime Clubs have not only participated in events on campus but have also organized programs outside of campus.VisionPrime College will remain as a premier educational institution to impart Management and Technology education embracing the rapidly changing digital landscape with innovation, collaboration and lifelong learning strategies and empower students to become exemplary citizens.MissionThe College keeps up with the trends in the processes, methodologies and dynamics in IT and Management education equipping itself with advanced human and physical resources and runs effectively and vibrantly promoting social responsibility to attain its cherished goals.

name: Kantipur Engineering College
description: Kantipur Engineering College, a leading institute established in 1998 under the affiliation of Tribhuvan University, is situated in a peaceful and pollution-free location with a serene landscape best fitted for engineering education. The college boasts collaborations with over 50 universities across Europe and Asia along with 50+ national institutions, organizations, and industries, for developing engineering graduates capable of competing in the national and international arena. With a well-trained and experienced full-time academic team, the college also emphasizes research and innovation. The college has been attracting students from diverse backgrounds and throughout every part of the country, reflecting the essence of a mini Nepal. The institution prides itself on its rich history of education in Nepal, standing as a pioneer institute dedicated to shaping future leaders. The well-facilitated modern and safe complex with ample open areas and state-of-the-art resources employing the latest teaching methodologies make the teaching-learning process effective. These methodologies, which blend inductive and deductive approaches, ensure a student-centric learning process that broadens the knowledge horizon and fosters new insights. Finally, KEC aims to achieve a Quality Assurance and Accreditation (QAA) certificate, which solidifies its reputation for excellence in engineering education.Kantipur Engineering College is the oldest TU-affiliated college in Nepal. It has a strong Alumni Network and is doing exceptionally well in Nepal and abroad.KEC is dedicated to delivering outstanding education across various engineering disciplines. Currently, KEC offers BE programs in Civil Engineering (96 seats), Computer Engineering (96 seats), and Electronics, Communication & Information Engineering (96 seats). Plans are underway to introduce BE programs in Electrical Engineering and a Bachelor's degree in Architecture.Vision of KECServe the people of Nepal in order to enhance the infrastructure development of the country by imparting quality engineering education, carrying out applied research, and producing competent engineering manpower.Mission of KECDevelop the college as a center of excellence for engineering education in Nepal and South Asia.Objectives of KECKEC has been established with the primary objectives to:Produce proficient, qualified, and socially responsible engineering manpower required to face the challenges of the country in the new millennium.Develop the college as a research and resource center to initiate research activities to strengthen engineering potentialities and to solve problems related to the areas of engineering in the country.Provide opportunities to the citizens of Nepal willing to get engineering education in different fields at affordable cost.Launch different programs to integrate educational and developmental activities.Serve as a sustained center for imparting engineering education so as to update and upgrade the existing engineering manpower.Collaborations of KECNational and International LinkageKEC has a strong international linkage dating back to the college's establishment. It started by introducing the Civil and Industrial Engineering program at Polotsk State University, Belarus. Since then, KEC has collaborated with more than 50 European / Asian Universities and Industries as an outcome of several international projects, including East-West, eLINK, cLINK, FUSION, SmartLink, SUNSpACe, eACCESS, and YETIS. Through these international projects, the college has successfully provided hundreds of paid scholarships to students, faculty, and staff to pursue training and higher studies in several European Universities. With such international linkage, KEC has been focusing on different areas of collaboration, including the exchange of Faculty, Students, and Research Fellows, Joint Research Projects, Joint Conferences and Seminars, Sharing / Exchange of Information & Resources, and Staff Development. Recently, under the Erasmus+ SUNSpACe Project, KEC successfully trained more than 100 Nepalese farmers to implement smart farming practices in Nepal. Similarly, under the Erasmus+ eACCESS Project, KEC has installed a one-of-a-kind Power Electronics and Automation Laboratory in the college.KEC is also a partner of the SKIMA (Software, Knowledge, Information Management and Applications) network, which organizes SKIMA Conferences annually. KEC had an opportunity to organize SKIMA 2008 and 2015 in Kathmandu, Nepal. This year the 16th SKIMA Conference 2024 will be organized in Indonesia. To date, KEC has offered 130+ full scholarships to European and Asian Universities.KEC also collaborates actively with more than 50 national institutions, organizations, companies, and industries to support students in their personal and professional growth and develop themselves as competent engineering graduates in national and global scenarios.

name: PCPS College
description: PCPS College is a multilingual, diverse, multicultural educational institution that ensures intellectual, research and informed teaching. PCPS College is a constituent member of the LBEF Group with a legacy spanning over many years, ensuring a strong reputation for academic excellence. It offers students the opportunity to earn a globally accredited UK degree through its exclusive partnership with the esteemed University of Bedfordshire (UoB). PCPS College was established with a clear vision: to offer globally recognized degrees from a respected UK university within Nepal. This vision led to an extensive evaluation of universities in the United Kingdom, ultimately resulting in a successful partnership with the University of Bedfordshire. With over a century of academic excellence, the University of Bedfordshire is recognized for its modern and innovative approach to education and has been featured in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings in the 601-800 category for two consecutive years.PCPS College offers undergraduate programs in collaboration with the University of Bedfordshire, covering fields such as Information Technology, Business, Business Analytics, and Digital Marketing. These courses are designed to be career-focused, incorporating real-world learning experiences through internships, field visits, and project work.The college is equipped with advanced academic infrastructure, including modern laboratories, digital libraries, and an innovation hub. It also fosters strong community and industry partnerships and maintains an active network of global alumni. PCPS has built a growing legacy with over 2,000 alumni, a current enrollment of more than 500 students, and a graduate employability rate of 98 percent.The A-Level program is licensed to Lumbini International College, which is managed by Patan College for Professional Studies, extending its academic reach to pre-university education.MissionTransforming students with potential to amazing professionals.Collaboration and PartnershipsAWS Academy: Cloud computing certification and hands-on training through the AWS Student Certification Program.Programiz PRO: Coding platform partnership offering students access to real-world programming practice.IIDE The Digital School: Certification in digital marketing and industry-relevant digital skills.Google and Microsoft: Platform partnerships offering specialized training and global certification opportunities.Oracle Academy: Access to advanced computing courses and recognized certifications.Hackathons: Competitive events where students solve real-world problems using technology and innovation.Job Fairs: Organized with international partners to connect students with global employers and internship opportunities.Seed Fund Events: Startup support programs with expert mentorship and funding of up to NPR 1 crore.Industry Partners: Collaborations with Khalti, Codealogy, Genese, Riddhasoft, Veda, EKbana, Yarsa Labs, Quickfox, YoungInnovations, LogPoint, Sewa, and others.Tech Learning Partner: Code Himalaya offers practical training in AI, web and app development, as well as IT consulting.

description: CollegesNepal says Atharva Business College was founded in 2013 at Bansbari, Maharajgunj, Kathmandu, near the Australian Embassy, and is affiliated with Pokhara University. Edusanjal’s Pokhara University list uses the same place. The college site did not return readable text.

name: Kathmandu Don Bosco College
description:
Kathmandu Don Bosco College is the strategic partnership of Little Angels' College of Higher Studies (LACHS), Xavier Academy College of Graduate Studies (XACGS) and Kathmandu Don Bosco College. With a vision of becoming a leading institution and quality provider of education and research endeavors in the field of business management, Kathmandu Don Bosco College launched its undergraduate programs in 2000. After a decade long experience, it offered the Masters in Business Administration (MBA) program in 2010. The strategic partnership of three reputed colleges is to create future leaders, business professionals and entrepreneurs. This partnership will offer the students the opportunity of experiencing a unique educational experience, based on the varied, rich, interesting and enviable track record of the three colleges.Kathmandu Don Bosco College hopes to provide one of the most challenging and one of the best place for learning, to fully utilize the potential, latent in each of the student, so that they become successful in their chosen careers. The college will equip the students with the requisite skills to become self-made entrepreneurs. The new team of distinguished faculty members is keen to prepare graduates academically and intellectually to refresh their perspectives and rejuvenate their thinking and imagination in new teaching-learning environment in XA premises at Lazimpat. The courses are designed so as to encompass multidisciplinary approach to learning.Kathmandu Don Bosco College shall strive to provide graduates the opportunities to get exposure to international universities. Don Bosco is and will work closely with the federation of business houses of Nepal to provide first hand business experience to students.MottoKathmandiu Don Bosco lives by its motto "To Create Future Leaders with Imagination, Inspiration, Illumination and Insight."VisionTo contribute to human resources development in the field of business and management by imparting the best business education and practices, there by contributing to enhancing overall management education of the country. MissionTo offer the students an educational environment that enhances their minds and molds their personalities in a caring environment so that they become thoughtful, critical, innovative and responsible global citizens competent enough to make heir career in changing global business landscape.ObjectiveKathmandu Don Bosco wishes to be positive agents of changes in business education sector and seeks to make a difference in the lives of the business students by preparing them to compete in national and international business settings and enabling them to explore their vast hidden potentials.
