name: Herald International College
description: Herald International College (HIC) focuses on learning, knowledge creation, and applying that knowledge effectively. HIC offers Ten Plus Two (+2) programs in Science, Humanities, Management and Law, approved by the National Examinations Board (NEB).As a distinguished academic center, HIC is committed to providing high-quality education at an affordable cost for students pursuing higher education. The college equips students to tackle the challenges of today's rapidly evolving world.HIC aspires to be a center of excellence in its field. Under the mentorship of renowned academicians, the institution strives to empower students to meet the demands and challenges of the 21st century.MissionHIC aspires to contribute to the vibrant transformation and prosperity of Nepali society by making competitive human resources available in the fields of Science, Humanities, and Business Management.VisionTo produce human resources that can lead society and the country to transformation and prosperity through vibrant social, economic, and scientific activities.Beliefs at HERALDInculcating moral values in students.Imparting contemporary and globally relevant education.Proper blend of modern need-based education with moral values.Building confidence and a positive attitude in students so that they can lead their respective fields in the future.Ethos of HERALDAt Herald International College, we embrace humanism, nurture eudaimonia, foster personal growth, integrate animism, enhance life skills, and celebrate the delightful aspects of life, guiding each student toward holistic development and a heralded life.ValuesMoral Values:IntegrityRespectToleranceDiversityInclusionAcademic Values:ProfessionalismExcellenceReal-life LearningTechnological AdvancementCollaborationThe Significance of Plus Two EducationThe Plus Two level is a pivotal academic foundation for students aspiring to pursue higher studies in fields like medicine, engineering, management, and humanities, both in Nepal and abroad.Academic Excellence at Herald International CollegeHIC emphasizes maintaining high academic standards through a rigorous academic process. Below is an overview of the college's academic approach:Relevance: The curriculum is NEB-certified, with comprehensive coverage of over 31 subjects at the Plus Two level.Interdisciplinary Approach: The integration of interdisciplinary studies ensures a well-rounded education.Involvement: The teaching and learning process actively involves faculty, subject experts, alumni, and students."Herald, Excellence among the Excellence."

name: Nami College
description: Established in 2013, NAMI College is now an independent Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE) examination center. It has been offering the A Level program under the CAIE Board at its state-of-the-art premises located in Gokarneshwor-7, Jorpati, Kathmandu, Nepal.Situated in a peaceful suburb of Kathmandu, NAMI College is a fully co-educational institution. Its primary strengths are its seasoned faculty, small class sizes, and, most importantly, a friendly and caring approach to education.The college aims to establish strong academic foundations, achieve outstanding examination results, and foster a mature, independent mindset vital for students to seize opportunities in life. Its student-centric approach, complemented by world-class services, facilities, and resources, is arguably among the best in the country.NAMI College is excited to welcome a new generation of students, well prepared to embark on their educational journey.MissionTo empower individuals with fundamental academic knowledge, life skills, and values that foster a genuine love for learning, and prepare them to impact their own lives and the lives of others positively.VisionTo offer access to world-class education within Nepal, fostering human capital development among the youth and empowering them to become responsible individuals contributing to society, both locally and globally.Why Choose Cambridge A Levels at NAMI College?NAMI College provides the Advanced Level program, administered by Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE) from the University of Cambridge, UK. The A Level curriculum at NAMI is distinctive, offering both science and non-science (management/humanities) subjects, with a strong focus on practical application. Its approach involves project-based learning for all subjects, encouraging students to actively explore, experiment, challenge ideas, and take leadership roles in the learning process.NAMI places a high emphasis on providing a world-class education to its students, with particular focus on developing their creativity and critical thinking—skills essential for A-Levels education. The A Level programme is an advanced international degree designed for students who are inclined towards logical reasoning, handling analytical situations, and maintaining high academic standards.Cambridge programmes and qualifications have a proven reputation for being an excellent preparation for university, employment, and life. They provide a valuable international benchmark of learner performance.

name: Nepal Mega College
description: Established in the year 2011, Nepal Mega College is one of the educational institutions under the Mega Education Network. It was founded by a highly experienced team of teachers in association with educationists and vibrant entrepreneurs. As its motto, a mega centre of excellence, the college has witnessed outstanding academic performance, scoring excellent results in board examinations and achieving unparalleled success in competitive examinations for medicine, engineering, paramedical, and management courses. Due to its high standards, comprehensive facilities, and reputation for excellence, the college has attracted students from all over the country.To impart value-based education to aspiring youth, Nepal Mega College is committed to pursuing academic excellence earnestly. Nepal Mega College emphasizes equipping its students with highly regarded qualifications, skills, and experiences that will fulfill their career aspirations and enrich their future lives, preparing them for the challenges they will face in the years to come. Nepal Mega College has a dedicated team of teachers who are innovative, young at heart, and specialized in their field. They have stood the test of time. VisionNepal Mega College is a leading comprehensive research-intensive College known for inspiring and instilling the spirit of discovery, the ability to create ideas, problems, and a passion for improving the human condition- a college of choice where knowledge and human understanding converge. MissionNepal Mega College is a research-intensive College serving Kathmandu and beyond. Its mission is to explore, discover, create, and communicate knowledge while grooming individuals in leadership, innovation, critical thinking, and civic responsibility, and inspiring a passion for learning. Core Values Integrity and RespectDiligence and ExcellenceInclusiveness and Diversity Value PropositionNepal Mega College is guided by principles of ethics, treats others with deferential regard, and is civil in its interactions.The College works hard and tirelessly to pursue its goals and achieve outcomes of the highest quality.It honors the individual. It celebrates differences and uses them to create unity.Nepal Mega College offers an accessible, affordable, high-quality education, relevant to an evolving, technological, knowledge-driven world, in a research-intensive environment.

name: Liberty College
description: Liberty College, from its inception, shares a common commitment of Pro-Ed Limited to delivering quality education within a benchmark framework, orienting education towards a skills-focused approach as a fundamental condition. Founded in 2004, Pro-Ed Limited is a publicly incorporated company of a group of scholars, educators, researchers, entrepreneurs, and scholarly communities of high social recognition. The company is governed by the board of directors (BoDs). Pro-Ed Limited is the holding company of Liberty College (POU affiliated) among more than half a dozen of the academic institutions, including Valley View English School, Global College of Management (TU affiliated), Global College of Management (under NEB), Global School of Science (NEB), Global College of Social Science and Technology (GCSST), Uniglobe SS/ College (NEB), and Uniglobe School-Kamaladi. Each institution under Pro-Ed Limited delivers education in Science, Business, Hospitality, Information Technology (IT), and Law education. Schools under Pro-Ed Limited serve as feeders for higher education programs, delivering premium quality standards to new generations.Pro-Ed is committed to preparing every single institution under its holding as a centre of academic excellence in service to the community of youth with quality education, research, and innovation for quality career outcomes.Under the corporate holding, Pro-Ed Limited owns a number of benchmark academic institutions equipped with world-class infrastructures built in with adequate facilities and interiors with proven quality to support modern education systems, technologies, enriching resources, managerial, and mentorship support from expert faculty and professionals holding a track record in their field.Liberty College under Pro-Ed Limited is a prioritized centre of academic excellence committed to preparing a youth workforce that is brilliant to cope and thrive through emerging challenges in local and global markets. Through two decades of academic journey, Pro-Ed Limited has been successful to set an image and create a distinctive mark with its prodigious identity as an owner and powering organization committed to managing modern education benchmarks that are designed to preparing our youth with new capabilities who are sent to the local and global market in the category of skilled workforce enriched with 21st century as well as global citizenship skills.Vision of Liberty CollegeTo be a centre of academic excellence, an expert academic profile renowned for quality-driven teaching, learning, and research dedicated to delivering time-tested and contextually relevant education in Management, hospitality, and IT with a 21st-century career focus.Mission of Liberty CollegeDelivering market-friendly, accessible, flexible, and innovative academic programs in management, hospitality, and ITDevelop skilled workforce, efficient and prospering entrepreneurs, hospitality, and IT experts, and socially valuable civilized citizens; andPrepare communities of youth with sound expertise who would be able to grasp local, national, and international opportunities, and contribute substantially to the growth of local and global society.Objectives of Liberty CollegeThe main objective of Liberty College, with its BBA, BBA-F, BHM, and BCSIT programs, is to impart quality education towards skilled professionals and able citizens equipped with positive aptitude, attitude, and values.

name: Nesfield International College
description: Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, Nesfield International College (NICOL) currently runs BA, BBS, BHM, BCA, BBM, and MBS programs. The college aims to produce qualified, sincere, and dedicated human resources who not only memorize subject matter but also make rational and responsible decisions to adapt to a diverse social environment.NICOL started with two university programs, BBS and BA, from a rented building at Prayagpokhari, Lalitpur. It later moved to its present location at Batukbhairab, Lalitpur. The BHM program was introduced in 2010, followed by MBS in 2014, and both BBM and BCA in 2018, reflecting the college's steady expansion over more than a decade.So far, Nesfield College has produced over 1,200 graduates in the market. Apart from academic activities, students receive personality development training and exclusive internship programs, including opportunities in Japan for Hotel Management students. The college also publishes a research journal, "The Batuk," which has been in circulation since 2015, providing a platform for faculty and guest researchers to share their academic work.NICOL has also been QAA-certified, reflecting its commitment to maintaining quality assurance standards in higher education.VisionTo be a premier center of learning that empowers students to become globally competent professionals, lifelong learners, and responsible citizens.MissionTo deliver quality education that fosters academic excellence, ethical values, social responsibility, mutual respect, and a spirit of collaboration among students.CurriculaNesfield International College follows the curricula prescribed by Tribhuvan University, ensuring a balanced blend of theoretical knowledge and practical learning that meets contemporary academic and professional standards.Future PlansCommitted to addressing the growing demand for skilled human resources, Nesfield International College plans to introduce additional academic programs, including B.Sc. CSIT, BIT, MBM, MBA, MA Economics, and semester-based BASW. The college is also pursuing collaborations with international universities to enhance academic opportunities and global exposure for its students. Furthermore, it is actively working toward obtaining Quality Assurance and Accreditation (QAA) certification from the University Grants Commission (UGC) to strengthen its commitment to academic excellence and institutional quality.MottoTogether We Can

name: Cosmos College of Management and Technology
description: The mission of Cosmos College of Management and Technology is oriented towards equipping students with the skills and knowledge necessary to become exceptional engineers, technologists, managers, and professionals, positioning them to contribute significantly to their nation's progress. The college places a strong emphasis on nurturing innovation, developing leadership qualities, and refining crucial management skills essential for adapting to the constantly evolving professional domain.Since its establishment in 2001 A.D., the institution has consistently generated adept professionals who exhibit not only participation but also excellence in the global job market. To realize this objective, the college diligently implements strategic plans, utilizing a team of extensively qualified and adept teaching faculty and staff members to deliver education in a comprehensive and inclusive manner. The courses, accompanied by inventive pedagogical methodologies, are intricately crafted to offer students a comprehensive learning encounter that seamlessly integrates theoretical knowledge with hands-on practical learning.This distinctive approach equips students with a sturdy foundation, nurturing their careers from the foundational learning phase to real-world job exposure. Cosmos College takes immense pride in its provision of a variety of bachelor's level programs encompassing Information Technology, Civil Engineering, Electronics and Communication, Architecture, BBA, and Computer Engineering. Each program is aimed at empowering students for success within their respective fields.VisionTo be the preferred provider of a diverse and progressive educational environment that will enrich the lives of our students, employees, and community.MissionTo develop globally competent human capital through career-focused quality education;To provide an educational environment that emphasizes critical thinking and decision making, reflection, and creativity;To provide progressive and accessible opportunities;To prepare our students to be responsible citizens.ValuesQualityInnovativeness.Professionalism.Integrity.Exposure.

name: The British College
description: Founded in 2011, The British College offers world-class education for aspiring students in Nepal, providing internationally recognized qualifications from its two partner British universities: the University of the West of England (UWE) and Leeds Beckett University (LBU). The British College is also a Recognized Teaching Center (RTC) of the University of London.The college has successfully established a distinctive identity as a pioneering global institution in Nepal, offering reputable UK degrees and courses that are relevant to the current job market and enhance every student's employability. The British College aims to provide students with a global learning experience and worldwide opportunities.The college is further defined by its local-to-global approach to delivering its degrees and courses, which are staffed by tutors and administrative personnel from both the UK and Nepal. In this way, The British College provides quality education that encourages students and staff to be globally minded, a notion further supported by the involvement of multinational companies in its student exchange programs and internships.The British College also believes that supporting and interacting with the local community is an integral part of student life. The college is committed to achieving excellence in its research and upholding the highest standards of integrity.Vision To be a world-class college in Nepal, offering high quality British and international qualifications that equip our graduates with the broad knowledge, skills, and values they need to become creative entrepreneurs and achieve success in the global job market.MissionTo transform lives by making high-quality British education affordable and accessible for students from all regions of Nepal.To further develop the current portfolio of qualifications with new partners and qualifications – ensuring wrap-around student support and employability skill development opportunities;To work closely with industry partners, particularly in Kathmandu, to develop employability links and offer internships;To use the Industry Advisory Board contacts to broaden the reach of TBC and enhance the student experience.To encourage student mobility by providing study trips to our sister colleges: The Woolwich College (London & Dubai);To develop research opportunities, particularly in partnership with education and industry partners.Partner UniversitiesUWE Bristol UWE Bristol is one of the popular universities in Britain, with almost 30,000 students from over 140 countries worldwide. To accommodate this wealth of national and international students, UWE boasts over 3000 staff members, who work together to facilitate a total of 600 courses. As well a range of short courses, UWE offers both undergraduate and postgraduate degrees - two of which the college is proud to offer at TBC. The BBA (Hons) and the MSc in International Business Management (MIBM) are both awarded by the University of the West of England, and by joining one of them its students could have the opportunity to be a part of the 96% of UWE Bristol graduates who are in work or further studies six months after graduating.Leeds Beckett UniversityWith a history dating back to 1824, Leeds Beckett is a world-class university that was featured in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2019. The University works with a host of businesses to ensure their research and courses are contemporary, rich, and relevant, and meet the career ambitions of their students. Their reputation for excellence is reflected in their 23,000 strong student body, which is made up of students from 143 countries worldwide. LBU offers the opportunity to select institutions around the globe to teach their courses, and the college is very proud to be one of them. TBC thus offers the BSc (Hons) Computing, BSc (Hons) Hospitality Business Management, MBA (Graduate), MBA (Executive), and MSc Information Technology which are all awarded by Leeds Beckett University (LBU).

name: Southwestern School of Management and Technology
description:
The Southwestern Group, established by a team of distinguished academicians, researchers, planners, and professionals from both national and international arenas, is committed to delivering world-class education in Management at the plus two, undergraduate, and graduate levels. The group’s vision is to offer academic programs that meet and exceed global standards of business education, preparing students for success in the dynamic and competitive world of management.Since its inception, providing quality education in hospitality, hotel management, and business studies has been at the core of Southwestern's mission. Alongside the collective vision of the founding members, who are trained and deeply rooted in the field of management, it also aims to provide the younger generation with opportunities through these courses, owing to its global demand and practical applicability. Driven by a shared vision, the founders took thoughtful, well-measured steps to establish an institution that focuses on delivering meaningful, high-quality education with lasting impact.This vision materialized in the form of Southwestern School of Management and Technology (SWSMT), a premier institution in management and business studies in Nepal. It is designed to provide all the essential components of a modern, internationally aligned management education. SWSMT offers state-of-the-art infrastructure, an experienced and knowledgeable faculty, visits from renowned industry experts, and guidance from seasoned education professionals.SWSMT’s unique approach emphasizes personalized student development in hospitality and business management. Each student at SWSMT is equipped with practical skills, critical thinking abilities, and an entrepreneurial mindset essential for the global management industry. With a clear roadmap for individual growth and hands-on learning experiences, Southwestern School of Management and Technology ensures that its graduates are prepared to excel in the global marketplace.MissionSuccessfully pass on the ability to grasp the real meaning of quality education to make it visible through applied research and practice.VisionTranscend the loyalty towards the ‘aspirants to become the real managers’, and deliver to them their pride of making the right choice of us!

Listed by Purbanchal University. Approved programs: BBA-192, BHM-96, MBA(Fall)-33; BIT-48

name: Gateway College of Professional Studies
description:
Gateway College of Professional Studies, the professional institution established in 2008 has been offering BHM (Bachelor of Hotel Management) course targeting the career oriented students to acquire skill, knowledge and attitude as required by the ever changing business environment.Observing the need of short term vocational course allowing students to enter the industry with required knowledge and skill and further taking a fast track study approach to join bachelor degree abroad, Gateway introduced Advance Diploma in Hospitality Management (ADHM) from the year 2017.The primary purpose of GATEWAY is to promote the highest professional standards of education in the field of hotel management studies. It benefits the students, faculty members, and entire industry being a bridge in professional career development and improvement of industry standards.The college believes in inculcating proper attitude, developing skills, sharing knowledge as required by the ever growing and dynamic industry.GATEWAY has the international aspect and level of hospitality business study and exposure, combined with the practical side of on campus and off campus training that not many of hotel school can provide.VisionTo become leading learning center which strives on providing world-class training and education by using contemporary techniques to enable students meet the challenges of dynamism of the industry.MissionTo provide a learning experience in a conducive environment for students, making them realize their full potential to become successful individuals who would contribute positively to society.To groom the students professionally for the various industries worldwide.To provide personalized attention to our students in an open and equal opportunity environment.To support the hospitality industry through various programs designed to advance the aptitude of working professionals.To create and enhance value for all our stake holders.Here in Gateway CollegeDriving talents and motivating students is a team of experts in the respective field.Learning takes place in state-of-the art classrooms and virtual classroom in the real time environment.On-campus practical experience, frequent industry visit, regular in house events and IndustrialExposure are usual matters which matters a lot in career.The college just do not make students a good professional but a overall good human being.

Listed by Purbanchal University. Approved programs: BHM-96, MHHM-33; B. Tech. in AI-48

name: Universal College
description: UNIVERSAL College, located in Maitidevi, Kathmandu, is a distinguished educational institution for higher studies established in 2054 B.S. by a team of visionary professionals in Nepalese academia.The college's journey began with a solitary TU-affiliated BBS program in 2054 B.S., which has since expanded to include highly sought-after programs such as BBA, B.A., BSW, and M.A. (English). These program expansions testify to the quality of education provided by the college and highlight the success achieved by Universalians in the job market and in their personal lives.This success has been made possible by the college's distinguished faculty, acclaimed nationally in diverse fields including finance, management, commerce, IT, research, and social sciences. Many faculty members have demonstrated their expertise through authorship, policy research, and entrepreneurship, among other accomplishments. This team of experts is dedicated to transforming students into competent leaders who uphold the values of truth, justice, and peace in all aspects of life. The high standard of the faculty is further evidenced by the outstanding results of the students at all levels.Additionally, the college's highly disciplined environment, excellent physical facilities, smart academic activities, and various sporting events motivate students to enthusiastically engage in their tasks and remain active during college hours. As a result, learning at UNIVERSAL College is enjoyable rather than a mere academic requirement.Furthermore, the college encourages each student to become a job creator rather than a job seeker and to take on the role of a successful designer of the future. Upon graduation from UNIVERSAL College, students are expected to enter the larger world with a lifelong passion for learning and a commitment to making the world a better place.Vision of UCTo help students acquire and develop necessary knowledge, skills, values & leadership qualities relevant to the 21st century and beyond in diverse disciplines for their personal and professional growth.Mission of UCThe mission of the college is to attract industrious students from all backgrounds to serve a meritocratic Nepal; inspire them to be just and ethical citizens; train them to be wise and principled leaders, and help them become what they promise to be by developing positive attitudes towards thinking, collaboration, leadership, problem-solving and decision-making by widening their horizons to think globally but still rooted in Nepal’s heritage, history and culture.Objectives of UCThe main objective is to impart quality education in fields of Science, Management, Humanities, Social Sciences and IT and expand students' intellectual and spiritual horizons, underscope the nobility of humanity's never-ending search for truth, beauty and compassion. The other objectives are to:Prepare students to take-up middle level managerial positions in the business sector.Develop student's skills in object-oriented Business, Social Sciences & IT Management fields and make them leaders, who are capable of understanding and solving practical business problems creatively.Provide professional IT education with a blend of various IT fields such as design, development, an programming digital marketing and so onPrepare students to proceed onto postgraduate level study in Business Administration and Information Technology.Provide life-long education & training that produces smart and skillful graduates, capable of sustaining individual career success within a global economy.

name: Sagarmatha College of Science and Technology
description: Sagarmatha College of Science and Technology, established in 2011 and located in Sanepa, Lalitpur, is a higher education institution affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Established to meet the growing demands of the IT sector, the college offers undergraduate programs, specifically the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc CSIT) and the Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA). These courses are structured to prepare students for diverse pathways in the technology field.The college operates as an academic community where faculty members, staff, and students collaborate to support a deeper understanding of technology. It is dedicated to fostering a personal commitment to lifelong learning, intellectual growth, and the core values of technical education. Through its curriculum, the institution strives to offer a total educational experience that spans the classroom, college campus, and the wider community. This approach is designed to help students develop essential competence, character, leadership qualities, and the creative and analytical skills required in an increasingly complex society.In addition to academic coursework, Sagarmatha College of Science and Technology strives to maintain an intellectual environment that supports scholarly activities and creative endeavors. To complement theoretical learning, the college regularly organizes various events, workshops, and co-curricular programs. These initiatives provide students with practical exposure, helping them bridge the gap between academic knowledge and industry requirements while encouraging civic responsibility and individual growth.VisionTo be the center of excellence in IT education, research and innovation for the advanced and sustainable society.MissionTo provide quality education that combines theoretical knowledge with practical skills, fostering critical thinking and creativity.To foster a vibrant learning environment that encourages innovation, research and entrepreneurship empowering students and faculties to contribute to the Knowledge development and dissemination.To cultivate partnerships with industries, government agencies, and international institutions to enhance collaboration and experiential learning.To promote lifelong learning among faculty staff and students through continuous professional development programs and industry-oriented training.To contribute to the sustainable development of the society by addressing the industrial needs infrastructure challenges, and environmental concerns.To instill a sense of social responsibility and cultural sensitivity, among students, preparing them to be responsible citizens and global leaders.GoalAcademic ExcellenceResearch and InnovationIndustry CollaborationEthical and Responsible GraduatesStudent-Centric LearningCommunity EngagementContinuous ImprovementInternationalizationAlumni Network

name: Samarpan Academy Institute of Crisis Management Studies
description: The Institute of Crisis Management Studies (ICMS), Samarpan Academy, is located ideally at Dhumbarahi - 4, Kathmandu. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University’s Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences. It is a center for academia, focusing on the management of crisis resulting from both natural and man-made hazards, as well as providing professional knowledge and training in counseling psychology and Computer Application. ICMS offers two unique masters courses – Master of Arts in Crisis Management Studies (MCMS) and Masters in Counseling Psychology (MCP) as well as Bachelor's in Computer Application (BCA). The MCMS advocates for a holistic approach in understanding how to effectively manage and take measures to resolve, adapt to and mitigate crisis- related issues both in the national and international contexts. The MCP focuses on social, emotional, educational and developmental concerns within the crisis setting.The ICMS also offers training, simulation exercises and field visits, not only as part of the curriculum but as practical exercises for a range of different governmental and non-governmental organisations and initiatives. The specialized nature of the ICMS extends to its purpose built grounds, computer facilities, and online learning experiences to inspire students to forward themselves and the subject.Students are engaged in intensive fieldwork, case studies and independent research. ICMS equips its students with the necessary skills to pursue further scholarly research and practically apply the knowledge gained in class within their future careers. Mission:ICMS strives to achieve excellence and be a world-class education provider. The modules relating to MA Crisis Management are designed in such a way to help to shape the intellectual, moral, and crisis management leadership necessary for meeting both natural disaster and human made global challenges.The modules in the MA Counseling Psychology course related to Counseling Psychology, aim to help practitioners improve well-being alleviate distress, to resolve crisis and increase capacity. The course pays particular attention to emotional, social, education, development and organizational concerns.Vision:To provide a platform for the pursuit of scholarly and practical inquiry in a challenging and stimulating program which supports academic excellence in a new and important field of academic discourse.Objectives:To conduct an interdisciplinary program for a better understanding both the fields of crisis management and counseling psychologyTo prepare students for professional positions in the various fields of crisis management counseling psychologyTo prepare professionals who can respond to a range of uncertain, ever evolving crisis management complexitiesTo prepare managers who can evaluate alternative approaches and make critical decisions that facilitate crisis response and recovery operationsTo prepare highly ethical professionals who will work within the boundaries of crisis management to ethical, legal and regulatory standardsTo provide an opportunity for students to engage in significant and appropriate research within the field of crisis management and counseling psychologyTo prepare qualified, knowledgeable, skillful, and ethical counselors equipped with the skills to work in a variety of settingsTo offer courses with the priority of meeting the educational and personal needs of its students, based on a scientist-practitioner model, with an emphasis on empirical research and evidence-based practicesWhy Study Crisis Management?Vulnerability and Preparedness: Nepal's location makes it vulnerable to multiple hazards, including earthquakes, landslides, and floods. A crisis can strike at any time, and effective disaster management strategies are essential to minimize loss of life, infrastructure, and the economy. By studying crisis management, professionals can actively contribute to creating resilient communities that are better equipped to respond to and recover from disasters.Addressing Institutional Gaps: There is a significant lack of institutional preparedness in Nepal, both at the government and community levels. As disasters become more frequent and severe due to climate change, skilled crisis managers can bridge this gap by implementing disaster-sensitive policies, strengthening preparedness programs, and ensuring that institutions are capable of withstanding crises.Building a Disaster-Sensitive Culture: For long-term sustainability, Nepal needs to cultivate a culture that values disaster preparedness, response, and recovery. Crisis management professionals play a key role in fostering this mindset among communities, individuals, and businesses. This shift is essential for the future, as it will help people anticipate risks and act proactively in the face of danger.Scope for Employment: Crisis management is not limited to government roles or non-profit organizations. The scope extends to private businesses, humanitarian organizations, and sectors such as health, logistics, and education. Skilled professionals are needed to handle crisis communication, emergency response planning, business continuity, and post-disaster recovery efforts. As Nepal continues to experience economic growth, businesses will increasingly rely on crisis managers to mitigate the risks of natural disasters and other crises that could disrupt operations.Growing International Demand: In addition to domestic opportunities, crisis management is a field that offers global opportunities. As the world grapples with issues such as climate change, pandemics, and security threats, crisis management experts are in high demand worldwide. This provides Nepali graduates with the chance to work in international organizations, NGOs, and multinational companies dedicated to disaster preparedness and humanitarian assistance.Samarpan Academy’s Institute of Crisis Management Studies (ICMS) in Dhumbarahi, Kathmandu, offers a unique opportunity. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, ICMS runs the only Master’s in Crisis Management Studies program in Nepal. This two-year program is designed to equip students with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills to manage disasters and crises effectively.What sets the ICMS program apart is its multidisciplinary approach, which combines teaching methodologies from diverse fields, including management, sociology, psychology, and environmental science. The course content covers everything from disaster preparedness and risk assessment to post-disaster recovery and humanitarian assistance.

name: Namuna College of Fashion Technology
description:
Namuna College of Fashion Technology (NCFT) is Nepal’s first Fashion College and the initiator and pioneer of academic fashion education in the country. NCFT introduced Nepal’s first ever Bachelors course in Fashion with the Bachelor of Fashion Design program of 3 years (6 Semesters) in 2002 in affiliation with Purbanchal University. In 2016, NCFT launched Nepal’s only Bachelors course in Fashion of 4 years (8 semesters) with the Bachelor of Fashion Design and Management (BFDM) program in affiliation with Purbanchal University.

Namuna in context of fashion in Nepal conjures up a remarkable history going back to more than 4 decades. It was all set in motion by our Founder Principal, Gyani Shova Tuladhar, a name synonymous with fashion in Nepal.

Our Bachelor of Fashion Design and Management (BFDM) program is the 1st and only Bachelors course of 4 years (8 semesters) in Fashion in Nepal and is an upgrade on our Bachelor of Fashion Design (BFD) program.

One of Nepal’s most awaited and acclaimed fashion extravaganzas, our Graduation Fashion Shows have been organized with the main title “Journey Of Fashion” by graduating designers of the final semester since 2005.

Our graduates deliver high value to many organizations of Nepal as career professionals. The entrepreneurial zeal of our graduates has also made them fashion entrepreneurs and employment creators.

Active professionally in fashion for more than five decades, Mrs. Gyani Shova Tuladhar is a trailblazing fashion designer, entrepreneur and academician. So instrumental have her efforts been in elevating the entire fashion sphere of Nepal that it would not be inappropriate to consider her as the Grande Dame of Nepali fashion.

name: Kadambari Memorial College
description: Established in 2005, Kadambari Memorial College stands as a pioneering institution in Nepal, singularly dedicated to the field of social work. Affiliated with Purbanchal University, the college was founded on the profound belief that true societal progress is rooted in the promotion and protection of human dignity and worth. This guiding principle has shaped its mission to cultivate skilled and compassionate social work professionals equipped to address the nation's evolving social challenges.The college's inception was a direct response to the pressing societal needs that emerged in the aftermath of Nepal's decade-long conflict. A collective of visionary scholars, including Dr. Bala Raju Nikku, Dr. Pranita Bhushan Udas, Ms. Pradipta Kadambari, and others, recognized the urgent demand for professionally trained social workers to support vulnerable populations such as single-parent families, orphans, and traumatized individuals.Academic Programs and Educational PhilosophyKadambari Memorial College began its journey by introducing the Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) program, a pioneering initiative in affiliation with Purbanchal University. Over the years, it has solidified its position as the only college in Nepal exclusively offering social work programs. In a significant expansion of its academic offerings, the college introduced the Master of Social Work (MSW) program in 2023, further solidifying its commitment to producing highly skilled professionals in the field.The educational philosophy at Kadambari is transformative, aiming to empower students with a robust foundation of values, wisdom, and the principles of humanity and social justice. The curriculum is designed to foster critical thinking, planetary awareness, problem-solving skills, and innovation. This approach ensures that graduates are not only academically proficient but are also prepared to make a meaningful and positive impact on society.A Hub of Expertise and Community EngagementThe college boasts an experienced faculty with a wealth of theoretical and practical knowledge in social work, social sciences, and indigenous wisdom.[3] These faculty members are not only educators but are also active contributors to the development and revision of the social work curriculum at Purbanchal University, playing a vital role in shaping the future of social work education in Nepal.In its pursuit of excellence, Kadambari Memorial College established the Sutra Centre for Development Education and Research, a non-governmental organization that shares its commitment to professional education and research for equitable social progress. The college also emphasizes community engagement through initiatives such as "College with Community," which addresses environmental stewardship, disaster response, and traffic management.With a steadfast focus on quality education, Kadambari Memorial College aspires to become a national institute of excellence in social work in Nepal. Its dedicated team of faculty and management is passionately driving this vision, committed to shaping the future of social work education and contributing to the creation of a more just and equitable society.VisionKadambari Memorial College's vision is to be an institution of excellence in higher education, responding to changing social contexts, innovating and integrating knowledge and skills to create a people-centered, sustainable, and just society that promotes and protects dignity, equality, social justice, and human rights for all. MissionKadambari Memorial College's mission is to promote the delivery of professional social work education as a means to develop ethical, committed, and skilled social workers capable of leading social change to promote the well-being of marginalized and disadvantaged individuals, groups, and communities, thereby establishing a dignified, equitable, and just society.GoalsTo nurture professional social workers who provide quality service to the oppressed and marginalized sectors of society and improve their well-being for sustainable development.To prepare entry-level and master level social workers for generalist and specialized practice in multi ethic, multicultural contexts with global knowledge and competency in social work, and the ability to work locally with understanding and solving complex social problems within the values and ethics of professional social work.To reduce inequalities in the opportunity of access to social work education and provide quality social work education in Nepal.To build international linkages to create a platform for exposure, exchange, and experiences of students and faculty in social work practice, and contextualize the global practices of social work education in Nepal.

It was established in February 2001 with the aim of providing advanced research degrees in the Humanities and Social Sciences, with English Studies at the heart of the academic experience.IACER is committed to fostering a vigorous and distinctive campus community, and it prides itself on the diversity of the students’ academic and professional backgrounds. IACER believes that this diversity enriches the educational experience at IACER, creating a rich intellectual and communal environment wherein the college interacts with, and learn from, those who possess values, abilities, and opinions that differ from its own.IACER is the first institution to offer the M.Phil in English program in Nepal, and it also offers a semester-based M.A. in English. IACER understands the academic flexibility is a crucial element in today's global learning environment. It offers an interdisciplinary course that blends traditional inquires with contemporary issues, and students are asked to engage not only with literary texts but also with immediate and imminent socio-political concerns like globalization, conflict transformations, gender relations, and the environment. The small class sizes ensure that students get individualized attention in this pursuit, and seminars and guest lectures facilitated by professors from all around the globe expose students to existing debates in world education. IACER is a creative and invigorating space where contemporary issues in the Arts and Social Sciences are debated in and out of the classroom and strives forward for the pursuit of academic excellence and intellectual freedom.The institute, with its very nature of courses, provides scholars with platforms to develop their area of specialization, instead of opting for specialized graduate programs from the outset. Once equipped with the concepts and methods of Human and Social Sciences, a student can focus on a particular field of study. Institute of Advanced Communication, Education, and Research (IACER) believes that specialization does not begin with hoodwinking epistemic, pragmatic fields of university education. Furthermore, IACER believes that a student should always be given choices to move from one discipline to another instead of blocking his or her goals and objectives of scholarship.MISSION STATEMENTIACER is committed to providing an interdisciplinary academic experience that transforms students and equips them for a lifetime of learning. It offers students the concepts and tools required to engage with issues of local and global concern and prepare them for professions that are in demand in an increasingly interdependent world.DISCIPLINARY FocusMaster’s program incorporates the study of literature and cultural discourses. Consequently, students are oriented towards both English Studies and studies of various cultural notables like Race, Ethnicity, Class, Nation, Gender, and Conflict. M. Phil. program covers wide-ranging topics from the Humanities and Social Sciences, which enable them to comprehend the vocabularies, concepts, and methodologies with a wider sense of proportion. Such interdisciplinarity equips them to carry on disciplinary research of their interest.OBJECTIVESIACER is devoted to excellence in writing and research, teaching, and learning to help students push the boundaries of knowledge so that they enable themselves in highly competitive world of professionalism.

name: DAV College
description: D.A.V. College, an affiliated institution of Tribhuvan University, has stood as a prominent center of education in Nepal since 2003. The college has been a driving force for academic excellence, offering diverse programs for both undergraduate and postgraduate students in the field of management. The institution's core focus lies in providing a well-rounded education that nurtures the mind, body, purpose, spirit, and meaning of its students. This commitment is underlined by its goals of broadening perspectives, fostering global leadership, stimulating innovation, and contributing to societal progress.D.A.V. College provides a range of degree programs, including BBA, BBM, BBS, and MBS. Its reputation for academic prowess resonates nationwide. Over the course of sixteen years, the college has established a tradition of pairing alumni with upper division students. This interaction, coupled with exposure to seasoned professionals from various domains, equips students with robust professional networks, priming them for success as they prepare to transition from the college to the professional world. The college's daily academic routine incorporates impactful practices such as mind mapping, incubation and management labs, alongside hosting national and international conferences, publications, and linguistic proficiency programs. These offerings cover a wide spectrum of guidance, ranging from personal connections and comprehension of contemporary business dynamics to cultural sensitivity, resume refinement, and interview strategies.Furthermore, D.A.V.'s global partnerships with institutions like Jain University, Bangalore, Sharda University, Delhi, and FIIB, Delhi, provide students with valuable international exposure through avenues like student and faculty exchanges, joint research initiatives, training programs, short-term courses, and publications. The college's collaborations with industries present opportunities for students to translate their theoretical knowledge into real-world experiences through internships, employment, research funding, shared corporate social responsibility projects, and insights from industrial experts.In addition to these enriching opportunities, the college extends skill development training in areas such as Public Speaking and Emceeing, Personality Development, Advanced Excel, SPSS, Business Plan Workshop, Accounting, Banking, Research Seminars, Harvard Business Review insights, Image Enhancement for the Job Market, and Career Symposium participation. Moreover, the institution focuses on honing skills necessary for effectively navigating case studies, preparing reports, and delivering presentations, which are integral parts of daily classroom interactions. This comprehensive approach readies students to excel in diverse global scenarios across three pivotal dimensions: Organizational, Interpersonal, and Leadership.VisionTo be center of excellence that inspires to be a global citizen while nurturing the Human Values.MissionInspire to innovate and develop through management techniques. Spearhead entrepreneurship for sustainability. To inculcate values that foster Nepalese culture. To ingrain the abilities and skills to survive, adapt, improvise and excel in the Global world.

Its rigorous, student-centered instructional methods leverage the latest smart board and multimedia tools. The institution is committed to inspiring, encouraging, and guiding students to achieve their dreams of a fulfilling and rewarding career, equipping them to lead successful and happy lives. Ritz graduates emerge with the skills necessary to excel in a competitive world, confidently meeting the challenges of the 21st century and providing leadership in the global market.VisionIt envisions revolutionizing education by setting new benchmarks for excellence in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Engineering, and Computer Application in Nepal.MissionIts mission is to provide globally recognized, exemplary education and training that prepare students for successful careers; to lead in fostering collaborative and professional relationships with industry, organizations, and institutions; and to enhance the College's management effectively.Goals: Students Success Educate and graduate students with excellent knowledge and skills necessary to sustain & succeed in a competitive environmentAcademic Excellence Foster positive learning and a high-quality, educational curriculum aligned with the institute’s missionFaculty Development Enhance staff quality by launching workshops and training programs for continuous growthFiscal Strength Continuously improve the college's financial position through diversification and resource enhancementSmooth Operation Outgrow technological operations, create a suitable infrastructure, to provide a supportive learning, teaching, and working environmentCollaborate with National and International Parties Maintain a collaborative relationship with the international university community and business communities

name: Bluebird Secondary School and College
description: Bluebird Secondary School and College has consistently upheld a commitment to academic excellence and holistic development. Since its inception, both Bluebird Secondary School and Bluebird College have worked to elevate educational standards by delivering analytical and practical knowledge through Team Bluebird, a group of experienced and dedicated educators.Together, the institutions focus on producing not only academically competent and career-ready individuals equipped to face global challenges, but also responsible, ethical citizens grounded in strong spiritual and moral values. Bluebird prepares students to navigate and contribute meaningfully to the evolving political, social, cultural, and economic landscape of both the nation and the world.VisionBluebird is a learning community that fosters diversity, collaboration, and innovation.MissionBluebird caters to the needs of the 21st-century learners, who initiate change.MottoMeaningful learning matters

name: K and K International College
description: K and K (Kanti and Kunja) International College, an affiliate of Tribhuvan University, is one of the premier academic institutions of the nation. Located at New Baneshwor, Kathmandu, the College caters to the academic as well as co-curricular needs of its students and provides support with the state of the art facilities in every possible way, so that students can learn and blossom in a pleasant and stimulating atmosphere.Moving with the pace of time, K and K has earned its reputation by producing a generation of highly competent students, well-equipped with skills, knowledge, and values to succeed in life. Today, the college boasts of its quality graduates, finding very good position in society and their respective fields. The motto of K and K International College is Plan, Participate, and Lead. Today K and K International College boasts of its quality graduates, finding a very good position in the society and their respective fields.The College presently offers quality education in Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS), Bachelor of Social Work (BSW), Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) and Bachelor of Arts (BA) in the Bachelor's Level and Master of Arts (MA) in Psychology, MA in Rural Development, MA in Gender Studies, and MBS programs under Tribhuvan University.Mission:The present mission of K and K is quite explicit; it has been striving to the best of its capacity to make students able to plan for their future, participate in all the sectors in building their career, and lead the masses in order to achieve peace, development, and prosperity for all.LocationNestled at the heart of Kathmandu, it is located at New Baneshwor in front of the International Convention Centre. The college is accessible from Patan, Bhaktapur and from all the major parts of Kathmandu city. name: Rajdhani Model College
description: Rajdhani Model College is a premier business college affiliated with Pokhara University. The college offers Bachelor in Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor in Hotel Management (BHM) and Bachelor of Computer System & Information Technology (BCSIT) at undergraduate level and Master in Business Administration (MBA–Evening Shift) at graduate level. It was founded by a team of seasoned academicians and professionals who have a proven track record in educational management and leadership. The college aims to set a new benchmark in the business education by delivering the best curriculum that withstands the 21st century needs.By instilling managerial competence in its students, fostering and inter-disciplinary approach in teaching, nurturing entrepreneurial and leadership skills, and coping with rapid technological change, the college has ranked among the best b-schools in Nepal within a short span of time. Keeping with the objective of access and excellence, our programs combine both quality and affordability.The college enjoys a most preferable location of Old Baneshwor, which is accessible from all parts of Kathmandu valley. As soon as you enter the college, you will find yourself in the midst of serene, pleasant and scenic environment with adequate infrastructures that contribute to lively academic ambience.VisionStrive to be amongst the top business schools in the nation through a delivery of pragmatic curriculum that suits the global market needs.MissionTo develop professionals, managers and leaders who can contribute to the growth of corporate Nepal.ValuesHonesty and IntegrityAdherence to RegulationMutual RespectContinuous LearningPersonal Accountability

name: Bright Academy
description: ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) is a globally recognized professional accounting qualification, recognized in 180+ countries. It serves as a prestigious standard signifying professional excellence in the field and provides opportunities for career advancement.Bright Academy is an ACCA education provider established in 2023. Bright Academy is located in Baneshwor, Kathmandu, and has four other branches: Biratnagar, Butwal, Chitwan, and Birgunj. With a foundation built on academic excellence and a student-centric approach, the academy aims to provide students with a learning experience that integrates knowledge and practical application.Bright Academy offers comprehensive training across three levels of ACCA education:Applied Knowledge (First Level)Applied Skills (Second Level)Strategic Professional (Final Level)The institution delivers its curriculum through the following flexible learning modalities:Physical ClassExperience Nepal’s best ACCA learning environmentLearn face-to-face with top ACCA facultiesAccess resources and study materialsNetwork and collaborate with other students for better learning outcomesAccess computer labs and study spacesThese classes are perfect for students: Who prefer physical classroom learningWho enjoy direct interaction with tutors and other studentsAnyone looking for a structured study routineVirtual ClassLearn at Bright Academy's institutions across Nepal virtuallyLearn virtually at study centers in Biratnagar, Bharatpur, and Butwal.Access resources and study materialsMake friends, network, and collaborate with other students in your localitySave on your travel, food, and lodging expenses.These classes are perfect for students: Students who prefer to study at their own location.Students who enjoy direct interaction with tutors and other studentsStudents who don’t want to spend more on travel, food, and lodging.Live Online ClassAttend live online classes from anywhereStudy remotely from anywhere; all you need is a good Internet connectionAccess to the top ACCA faculties of NepalStay engaged and ask questions in real timeStudy from anywhereThese classes are perfect for students: Students outside Kathmandu ValleyWorking professionals balancing studiesAnyone looking for quality education remotelyRecorded ClassStudy at your own time and location.Study in your own preferred location and time.Access to the top ACCA faculties of NepalStay focused and undisturbed.Study at your own paceThese classes are perfect for students: Students who cannot commit to a fixed time of studyWorking professionals who want flexible study hoursAnyone looking for quality education remotely

name: MU Institute of Cooperation and Development
description: MICD Office at Nayabato, Dhobighat, Lalitpur offers the Master in International Cooperation and Development (MICD), a Kathmandu-based postgraduate program of Mid-West University in partnership with the international network CDN in Pavia, Italy.The Mid-West University (MU), established by the MU Act of 2010, has offered the Master of International Cooperation and Development (MICD) through the Graduate School of Humanities and Social Sciences since 2013. The course was initiated with academic and technical assistance from the University of Pavia in Italy. It is a part of the Cooperation and Development Network (CDN), a UNESCO-accredited network of post-graduate education programs in cooperation and development. The post-graduate program of CDN, hosted by five universities: Bethlehem University-Palestine, Kenyatta University-Kenya, Mid-West University-Nepal, Universidad De San Buenaventura Cartagena-Colombia, and University of Pavia-Italy, spans four continents: Africa, Asia, Europe, and South America.The Master's in International Cooperation and Development (MICD) is a postgraduate, multidisciplinary program that aims to equip students with the competencies and skills necessary to contribute to varied areas of development and humanitarian response in Nepal and the international context. The Master’s Program is designed to equip learners with both the academic background to approach development critically and the project management skills needed by NGOs, development agencies, and public institutions.MISSIONBecoming an international hub of scholars and professionals engaged in academic excellence and research in the field of development cooperation.ObjectivesTrain and equip participants to meet the highest professional standards for effectively managing and leading development projects.Impart to students academic and practical knowledge and the required skills to interpret multi-dimensional issues of development interventions, approaches, and modalities.Prepare skilled professionals in international cooperation and development for public institutions, non-governmental organizations, and other development projects.

name: Model Institute of Technology (MIT)
description: Model Institute of Technology (MIT) stands as a hub where innovation and technology intersect to nurture the leaders of tomorrow. Affiliated with the esteemed International American University (IAU) in the USA, MIT offers an extensive range of forward-looking programs. Its undergraduate offerings include BBA, BIT and BCS programs, all meticulously crafted to pave the way for the success of its students.For those looking to elevate their expertise, MIT provides a range of postgraduate offerings. These encompass MBA, MIT and MCS programs, all aimed at instilling the confidence to navigate the intricacies of the contemporary business and technology landscape.At MIT, the learning experience is immersive, encompassing engagement with real-world challenges through case studies and skill refinement via hands-on computer training. Students also have the opportunity to collaborate seamlessly with their peers in group presentations and cultivate an in-depth understanding of their chosen field through term papers. Beyond the classroom, guest lectures featuring industry experts from IT, banking, insurance, and corporate sectors provide invaluable insights.Moreover, educational field visits offer practical insights, bridging the gap between theory and practice. Becoming part of the MIT community means embarking on a journey of academic excellence and holistic growth. Here, knowledge is celebrated, innovation is fostered, and students are empowered to thrive in an ever-evolving world. The future for MIT students begins at this intersection where inspiration meets innovation.VisionOur Vision is to establish new standards in Nepal's education system, leading to being the first choice of students among the International degree-providing institutes in Nepal and the graduate's only recommendation.MissionOur mission is to provide a quality world-class education with state-of- the-art facilities and services being an exemplary institute to lure the student's choice and apply innovative approaches in transforming the community through transforming the lives of graduates as socially responsible leaders with a sustained future.

name: Gurukul CA
description: Gurukul CA is one of Nepal’s leading institutes for Chartered Accountancy education, recognized for its consistent academic results, experienced faculty, and student-focused learning environment. Officially accredited by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nepal (ICAN), the institute offers complete coaching support for all levels of the CA qualification under both ICAN and the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).Founded by Chartered Accountants Meghraj Aryal, Mukul Bhatt, and Arun Aryal, Gurukul CA has grown from a single centre in Bagbazar into a nationwide network serving aspiring Chartered Accountants across Nepal. Students can pursue Foundation, Application, and Advisory level preparation under either the Nepali or Indian CA pathway without needing to switch institutes.The institute’s teaching approach focuses on conceptual clarity, exam readiness, and practical understanding. Classes are conducted by practicing Chartered Accountants and subject specialists who bring professional expertise directly into the classroom. Gurukul also develops its own in-house study materials designed to simplify complex topics into structured, exam-oriented content.To make CA education accessible beyond Kathmandu, Gurukul offers both physical classroom instruction and online learning facilities with recorded video backups available to students. Its centres are located in Bagbazar and Baneshwor in Kathmandu, as well as Chitwan, Biratnagar, Rupandehi, Parsa, and Kaski, with a combined capacity of over 2,000 students.Gurukul CA also emphasizes educational accessibility through its annual Scholarship Entrance Examination conducted across all branches. The examination offers merit-based scholarships, including fee waivers of up to 100 percent, while also ensuring guaranteed discounts for eligible participants. The initiative reflects the institute’s belief that financial limitations should not prevent deserving students from pursuing a CA career.With a decade of experience, nationally recognized results, and a commitment to preparing students for professional success, Gurukul CA continues to be a trusted destination for Chartered Accountancy education in Nepal.

name: Maharishi College
description: Maharishi College, a prominent institution affiliated with Far Western University, Nepal's second-largest university, is centrally located in Kathmandu’s New Baneshwor area. Managed by the Techspire College team, it is renowned for its commitment to academic excellence. The college offers a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs, meticulously designed to meet the evolving demands of today's job market.The institution prides itself on several key strengths:Excellent Academic Programs: Maharishi College offers high-quality, comprehensive, and current educational programs.Experienced and Dedicated Faculty Members: The college boasts a team of seasoned, committed faculty members who bring a wealth of knowledge and practical experience to the classroom.Preparation for Future Careers: A core mission of the college is to equip students with relevant skills and knowledge to prepare them for their future careers.Transformative Experience for Personal Growth: Beyond academics, Maharishi College aims to provide a transformative experience that fosters personal growth and development.Tech Learning Management: The college utilizes advanced technology in its learning management systems to enhance the educational experience.Specializing in Computer Science and Information Technology, Maharishi College provides a robust foundation in the dynamic digital landscape through its Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc. CSIT) program. Furthermore, the college caters to business-focused students with its Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) and Master of Business Administration (MBA) programs. These programs are designed to cultivate critical thinking, leadership, and entrepreneurial skills, ensuring that graduates are exceptionally well-prepared for successful careers in the corporate sector.MissionTo provide a transformative educational experience that prepares students to excel in their chosen fields and contribute to society. The college is dedicated to fostering a dynamic learning environment that promotes intellectual growth, critical thinking, and practical skills development.VisionCommitted to creating a global reputation as a leading institution for higher education. The college aspires to go beyond conventional education, offering innovative, cutting-edge programs that incorporate the latest advancements in technology and industry practices.

name: Apollo International College
description: Apollo International College says it opened in 2010 in New Baneshwor, Kathmandu, under the KMC Educational Network, and is affiliated with Pokhara University. The old link apollo.edu.np is a study-abroad consultancy and was not used.

name: Liverpool International College
description: Founded in 2068, Liverpool College (NEB Registration No. 27172) began its academic journey in the 2068/69 session. The inaugural year saw strong enrollment in grade XI across the Science, Management, and Humanities streams, with a gender ratio of 60% boys and 40% girls. Since then, the number of new students each academic session has remained relatively stable. The college conducts classes in two shifts: the morning shift starts at 6:30 A.M., while the day shift begins at 11:00 A.M.The key to Liverpool College’s success lies in the student experience, which emphasizes developing essential soft skills for various sectors, including the public and private sectors, academia, multinational companies, and small local businesses. Each year, Liverpool College admits approximately 1,000 high school graduates, the majority of whom are SEE graduates from the Kathmandu Valley, along with a significant number of students from other districts nationwide.VISION Deliver unparalleled education in Nepal by integrating cutting-edge technology with affordable tuition fees, empowering individuals to maximize their potential to the fullest extent.MissionTo connect students with top mentors globally, ensuring hands-on learning that fosters real-world application and a growth mindset for global success.Core ValuesAt Liverpool International Secondary School/College (LISS), we uphold excellence, integrity, innovation, student-centered learning, and diversity. We strive for high academic standards, foster ethical values, encourage creativity, prioritize student growth, and embrace inclusivity to shape future global leaders.

name: Universal Engineering and Science College
description: Established in 2000 A.D. in Chakupat, Patan, at the heart of Kathmandu Valley, Universal Engineering & Science College (UESC) has emerged as a distinguished institution of higher technical education in Nepal. Affiliated with Pokhara University, the college offers a diverse range of programs including B.E. Civil, B.E. Computer, Bachelor of Architecture, M.Sc. in Transportation Engineering, and Master of Science in Construction Management. Guided by an unwavering commitment to academic excellence, UESC continues to expand its academic offerings each year, striving to bring quality education across multiple disciplines under one roof. The college boasts a strong foundation of infrastructure, featuring well-equipped laboratories, state-of-the-art computer facilities, and richly resourced libraries stocked with an extensive collection of books and journals. Beyond regular academic programs, UESC also conducts specialized professional courses designed to equip students with practical, industry-relevant skills. Through this holistic approach, the college remains dedicated to nurturing competent, innovative, and industry-ready professionals who can contribute meaningfully to Nepal's engineering and construction sectors.VisionTo develop UESC as the Nepalese Academic Center of Excellence (NCoE) in Engineering Education, Research, and Development Consultancy of international standards.MissionTo produce streams of competent and globally competitive engineers by building and continuously advancing a faculty of teachers and researchers, supported by modern laboratories, information management systems, learning resources, and Internet of Things (IoT) — with UESC students and faculty members serving as the driving force.GoalTo establish Universal Engineering and Science College (UESC) as one of the leading learning centers in Nepal through education, research, training, and consulting services in the field of science and engineering.The college aims to:Continuously enhance the teaching and learning standards by strengthening policies and legal frameworks.Improve curricular, co-curricular, and extracurricular teaching, learning, and evaluation procedures.Promote research, consultancy, and extension activities.Upgrade infrastructure and learning resources.Enhance student support services, data and information management systems, and ensure transparent communication with all stakeholders inside and outside the college.

name: Nepal Engineering College (nec)
description: Nepal Engineering College (nec) is one of Nepal's pioneering private engineering institutions, established in 1994 by a group of visionary academicians and professionals to provide quality technical education and contribute to the nation's development. As a not-for-profit institution registered with the District Administration Office, Bhaktapur, nec has played a significant role in advancing engineering education in Nepal.The college offers a wide range of Bachelor's and Master's degree programs in engineering, technology, and related disciplines under Tribhuvan University. Undergraduate programs are conducted at its spacious Changunarayan, Bhaktapur campus, while postgraduate programs are offered through the Center for Postgraduate Studies in Prayag Pokhari, Lalitpur. It also runs a Bachelor of Civil Engineering for Diploma Holders program at Satdobato.VisionThe vision of nec is to evolve as the center of higher learning, excelling in academics, through continued engagements in education, research, and outreach as three integrated functions of the college.Mission Providing the youth with the best opportunities and environment of learning to help them attain high level of academic standard, scientific temper, technical and professional competence and life-skills.Train and develop youth as total person, ready to serve the society and people to transmit the cultural heritage and improve their quality of life.Inculcate the values to appreciate the need for ethical standards in personal, social and public life, to become leaders, to be a voice to influence the society and the nation, and to uphold just social orderSpread across 210 ropanies (10.69 hectares), the main campus provides a peaceful learning environment equipped with modern academic facilities. NEC continues to emphasize academic excellence, innovation, practical learning, research, and professional development, preparing graduates to meet national and global engineering challenges.

name: Shivapuri College
description: Shivapuri College has an official website that matches this record: https://www.shivapuricollege.edu.np/.

name: ISMT College
description: Established in 2011, ISMT is dedicated to enhancing higher education in Nepal by providing internationally recognized and industry-relevant qualifications. In academic partnership with the University of Sunderland, UK, and Pearson Edexcel, UK, ISMT is redefining higher education with a bold vision of bridging the gap between academia and industry.ISMT's commitment to academic excellence is evident in its inclusive and cost-effective educational approach, which maintains international standards while embracing core local values. The institution nurtures a holistic learning environment that encourages active student engagement through project-based work, interactive discussions, presentations, and a variety of assessment methods. In addition to academics, ISMT offers a wide range of extracurricular activities, including sports clubs, workshops, boot camps, and special interest groups. These help promote the development of technical expertise along with essential interpersonal, managerial, and leadership skills.At ISMT, students have the unique opportunity to earn prestigious UK qualifications without leaving Nepal, thereby gaining a competitive edge in the global job market. The institution's dedication to fostering a supportive and inclusive learning environment ensures that graduates are well-prepared to make meaningful contributions to their communities, their nation, and the world at large.Academic partnership with the University of SunderlandISMT College conducts its degree programs in collaboration with the University of Sunderland, United Kingdom. This well-regarded UK university is known for combining academic excellence with outstanding student support and pastoral care. The university offers a broad, high-quality educational experience and delivers its academic programs in multiple countries worldwide.The University of Sunderland has earned several accolades over the years. It was named the Best New University in the UK by The Guardian in 2001 and ranked first for Best Student Experience by Times Higher Education in 2005.
