name: Global School of Law
description:
Global School of Law, affiliated with Purbanchal University and located in Baneshwor, Kathmandu, Nepal, offers a comprehensive BALLB (Bachelor of Arts and Bachelor of Laws) program under the academic umbrella of Global College, one of Nepal’s most reputable educational institutions for its academic excellence. A BALLB degree provides students with a blend of knowledge in both the liberal arts and legal fields. Global School of Law (GSL) aims to provide quality education through legal programs operated within a student-centric framework that prepares every graduate to make a difference at the local and global levels. BALLB at GSL is run in a highly facilitated educational environment under the direct supervision and management of senior professors and academicians with track records in legal education, court practices, legal research, and mentorship. GSL is a renowned institution that houses a pool of expert academicians, deputed to support Law programs in day-to-day management, and works closely with a professionally adept team of legal practitioners engaged in different roles.The faculty members of GSL are competent, dedicated, and renowned in the field of Law, and are equally well-trained to deliver law education in the 21st century.GSL leverages its locational advantage to build networks and offer its students and faculty career prospects, including the opportunity to practice law and gain practical exposure to legal practitioners, courts, and corporates requiring legal assistance from experts and law students on a mutual basis. The BALLB program is structured to equip students with the skills and knowledge required to succeed in the legal profession, both nationally and internationally, and to have a deep understanding of broader social, economic, and political issues that shape the law.VisionThe primary vision of Global School of Law (GSL) is to establish itself as a reputed center of learning and a pioneer in higher education, recognized for academic excellence in teaching, research, and innovation in legal studies, anchored in the academic and societal demands of the 21st century.MissionGlobal School of Law is committed to:Delivering the best possible opportunities for learning and skills development in legal education;Fostering dynamic partnerships among faculty, students, and the broader legal, economic, and development sectors;Providing a welcoming, safe, supportive learning environment nurtures academic and professional growth.

Listed by Purbanchal University. Approved programs: B.A. LL.B.-60

name: GoldenGate International College
description: GoldenGate International College, founded in 2007, is centrally situated in Battisputali, Old Baneshwor, Kathmandu. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, the institution delivers an extensive selection of Bachelor’s and Master’s degree programs, demonstrating continuous growth in academic opportunities over the past sixteen years.With comprehensive infrastructure, the college offers a sports complex, an on-site canteen, and modern amenities designed for practical learning. Alongside its primary academic curriculum, the institution is associated with the Advanced College of Engineering and Management (ACEM) and Cosmos Engineering College. It actively prepares students to face diverse global challenges by hosting regular events and professional development initiatives. By balancing academics and extracurricular pursuits, GoldenGate International College provides a structured environment for students to achieve their professional ambitions.MissionThe mission of GGIC is to work towards establishing it as a reputed institution in terms of its excellence in quality by imparting international standard education for the students. It is with this pious objective, that a team of seasoned faculty members with national and international exposures in their respective fields, along with successful managers and entrepreneurs, have joined hands and initiated this endeavor.VisionThe vision of GGIC is to create and develop it as a center with all its excellence for knowledge, skills, and applications of established and emerging areas of Science, Management, Humanities, and others to address the dynamism of the changing world and related sectors.Commitment “Your Aspiration is Our Assurance.”GoldenGate International College (GGIC) provides the students with unique opportunities not only to explore where they want to be for the next few years but also to help them become the person they aspire to be in the future. Therefore, the institution will not leave any stone unturned to make the students internationally accredited.PhilosophyYoungsters need learning that is challenge-based, highly individualized, and socialized to prepare them for the complexity of the future. GoldenGate is dedicated to providing methods of instruction that guarantee students have the knowledge and abilities to direct both their own and their communities’ destinies.GoldenGate's PrincipleThe GGIC’s guiding principle is to construct and grow it as a center of excellence for knowledge, skills, and applications of both established and developing fields of science, management, humanities, and other fields to address the dynamism of the changing global environment and connected industries.Key of SuccessThe students at GoldenGate International College (GGIC) are given the exceptional opportunity to discover their long-term goals as well as to develop into the people they hope to become. In order to ensure that the pupils receive international accreditation, the institution will stop at nothing.

name: Reliance College
description: Established in 2062 BS, Reliance College is a leading institution affiliated with Tribhuvan University, offering a range of undergraduate and graduate programs that meet today’s academic and career needs. The college offers BA, BBS, BCA, BASW, and MBS, combining strong academic foundations with practical skills for real-world success.At Reliance College, education goes beyond the classroom. Experienced faculty use interactive teaching methods to build critical thinking, leadership, and problem-solving skills. Each program balances theory and practice, ensuring graduates are ready for professional challenges.Modern facilities further support learning. Smart classrooms, a well-stocked library, advanced computer labs with high-speed internet, and well-equipped science labs create an engaging academic environment. Hostel facilities, an infirmary, a hygienic cafeteria, and reliable transportation ensure a safe and comfortable campus life.Students also benefit from regular workshops, training sessions, and real-world exposure that build career readiness. A variety of extracurricular activities like basketball, volleyball, badminton, chess, yoga, and educational trips promote the overall development of students as well.Operating under Reliance Education Network (REN), Reliance College is part of a trusted educational group serving 5,000+ students with the support of 500+ faculty and staff. The college remains committed to producing capable graduates ready to excel in their fields and contribute to society.Objectives:To produce students of above-average abilitiesTo develop the moral character, self-esteem, and sense of responsibility in the studentsTo encourage the blossoming of utmost originality, innovation, and creativity in the performance of the products of the CollegeTo provide well-qualified and dedicated teachers who inspire a joy of learning for its own sakeTo prepare the students to build their career with greater confidence for their glorious futureTo create a conducive and cozy environment for each child i.e. one or more than one ways to help them foster in the best possible ways

name: Kantipur Valley College
description:
Kantipur Valley College (KVC), established in 2002, is located in the educational hub of Kumaripati, Lalitpur. Affiliated with Purbanchal University, the college offers a range of academic programs in management and applied sciences. The institution is dedicated to offering a holistic and progressive education, aiming to produce graduates who are socially responsible, intellectually capable, and prepared to meet the evolving demands of their respective industries.The college offers several specialized programs, including the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), BTech in Biotechnology, Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT), Master of Business Administration (MBA), and Executive Master of Business Administration (EMBA). These programs are designed to cultivate leadership skills and strategic thinking for those pursuing roles in the business sector. Additionally, KVC provides a B-Tech in Biotechnology, a program structured to prepare students for professional careers in research laboratories, hospitals, and industrial units. The curriculum focuses on bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application, ensuring students gain the hands-on experience necessary for the modern job market.KVC maintains a multicultural and co-educational environment, attracting students with diverse backgrounds from across the country. The learning atmosphere is designed to be open-minded and supportive, encouraging students to face professional challenges with confidence. Alongside its academic offerings, the college organizes various events and programs to support the overall development of its students. By focusing on academic discipline and industry relevance, Kantipur Valley College provides the resources and support students need to achieve their career ambitions.Vision:To be a college of choice in Applied Science and Management for a sustainable future.Mission:The college provides holistic education that nurtures excellence in research & teaching to meet market & stakeholders’ expectations. The college will accomplish this mission by:Providing students with the necessary knowledge, skills and abilities to enhance career opportunities.Advancing knowledge in the academic and professional communities through research, performance and scholarly activities.Giving support and leadership to the various communities that we serve through direct access to the college’s pool of expertise.Objectives and GoalsTo create for students of KVC an additional avenue of self-employment and also benefit the industry by providing them with suitably trained persons.To prepare students in order to explore opportunities being newly created in the Management Profession at Field.To provide an adequate basic understanding of management education to the students.To give adequate exposure to operational environment in the field of Management.To inculcate training in the use of modern technology for the benefit of all parties concerned.

Listed by Purbanchal University. Approved programs: BBA-96, MBA(Fall/Spring)-33/33, EMBA (Fall/Spring)-30/30; B. Tech. (Biotech.)-48, BIT-48

name: Kapan Campus
description: Kapan Campus, established in 2069 B.S., is a community-driven institution situated in the prime location of Budhanilkantha Municipality-10, Kapan. Before its establishment, the local area lacked a public institution for higher education, compelling many students to face financial constraints and limited accessibility while pursuing studies elsewhere. Recognizing this need, local residents, educators, academicians, and social leaders collectively founded the campus to make higher education accessible.Initially established under Tribhuvan University, the institution was formally restructured as a constituent campus of Bagmati University in 2082 B.S., marking a major milestone in its academic governance and long-term sustainability.Kapan Campus offers market-driven, practical academic programs, including Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) with Digital Skills, Bachelor in Information Technology (BIT), Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc CSIT), and Bachelor in Business Administration (BBA). The curriculum focuses on practical instruction to ensure students gain skills relevant to real-world opportunities.With a multicultural, inclusive, and co-educational environment, the campus nurtures students into responsible, competent individuals. Alongside academics, the institution regularly organizes events and programs to support holistic student development and prepare graduates to contribute nationally and globally.VisionKapan Multiple Campus intends to be a prestigious community-based institution of higher education of Nepal, committed to academic excellence by providing access to educational opportunities at an affordable cost in multiple disciplines of knowledge to the people and continue efforts envisioning to be a community based model university of Bagmati Province.MissionThe Kapan Multiple Campus is established by the community and committed to provide affordable access to higher education in multiple disciplines for the people of Kathmandu and the country. Campus aspires to be educational hub of the capital city of Nepal through regular emphasis on academic autonomy, program extension in technical and non-technical disciplines, and continue to be an accredited institution of higher education in Nepal.ObjectivesTo provide quality education for the best future.To counsel every student for better future and career.To facilitate world class education for the challenging career.To serve the local people and communities with quality education from all over nepal.

name: Hillside College of Engineering
description:
Established in 2012, Hillside College of Engineering is a technical education institution affiliated with Purbanchal University. Located centrally in Balkumari, Koteshwor, Kathmandu, the college is easily accessible to students across the Kathmandu Valley. A team of academicians and professionals from engineering, science, and management disciplines founded it to meet Nepal's growing demand for skilled technical human resources. Notably, Hillside was the first Purbanchal University-affiliated college to introduce a Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical Engineering.The college provides both undergraduate and graduate academic programs. At the bachelor’s level, it offers Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, and a Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT). At the postgraduate level, the institution runs Master of Science (M.Sc.) programs in Electrical Power Engineering and Construction Management.Hillside College of Engineering emphasizes applied learning through modern teaching methods, project work, and regular field visits. The college features an active Research and Development Academy with student-run centers, dedicated teaching assistants for continuous student support, and strong industry linkages. Regular interaction sessions with researchers, scientists, academicians, and entrepreneurs further help students gain practical insights and prepare for professional engineering careers.VisionTo achieve the highest standards of excellence in engineering education and technical research.MissionTo support national development by establishing a center of excellence in engineering education and research that responds to the needs of society.ObjectivesPromote creative thinking, self-motivated learning, and a strong research environment.Develop competent, confident, and industry-ready engineering professionals.Nurture socially responsible, globally competitive graduates through high-quality instruction and modern learning techniques.Foster a collaborative academic community focused on innovation, discovery, and knowledge transfer.

Listed by Purbanchal University. Approved programs: BE Civil-96, BE Electrical-48, M.Sc. CM-20, M.Sc. EPE-20, BE Computer-48; BIT-48

name: Himalaya College of Engineering
description: Himalaya College of Engineering (HCOE) in Nepal, affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU), was established in June 2000 AD. Its mission is to deliver high-quality engineering education and produce skilled engineers who play a pivotal role in the nation's development. HCOE offers Bachelor of Engineering programs in Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Bachelor of Architecture, along with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc CSIT) from the Institute of Science and Technology.The college is managed by a capable team of seasoned professionals and academicians with extensive experience in the education sector. In May 2007, HCOE became part of the KMC Educational Network, resulting in program expansions and increased strength for the college.Situated in Chyasal, Lalitpur, HCOE is easily accessible from all directions. The campus spans an area of 19 and a half Ropani and features a seven-story main building along with five laboratory buildings. The college strictly adheres to the academic and administrative standards set by IOE (Institute of Engineering).To enhance the teaching-learning process, HCOE regularly conducts seminars, workshops, and training sessions throughout the semesters, complemented by field visits, project work, and practical experiences. The college is committed to providing quality education aligned with the current demands, aiding students in achieving their professional and educational aspirations. Graduates from the BE programs have demonstrated their professional competence in computer engineering, electronics and communication, civil engineering, and architecture sectors. HCOE students have consistently achieved top scores in IOE semester examinations, earning recognition both nationally and internationally.In addition to academic excellence, HCOE places a strong emphasis on extracurricular activities. It hosts inter-college and intra-college sports competitions annually. Notably, its robotics team secured first place (Grand Prix) in an inter-engineering college competition in Kathmandu in 2065. HCOE students have also participated in Tech Fest organized by IIT Mumbai, India, in 2011 and 2013, showcasing their talents. The college's robotics club actively engages in various robotics competitions within Nepal, further enhancing the students' holistic development.MissionThe mission of the College is to deliver quality engineering education and produce professional graduates that enables its products to face new challenges of the country, and also to compete in the modern world by implementing short-term, medium-term, and long-term strategic plansVisionThe vision statement of HCOE is to establish itself as one of the foremost centres of learning in the field of science and engineering through accompanying multiple educational programs of engineering and fostering research, training, and consulting services.ObjectivesTo enhance the technological capabilities of the country through quality education for students and produce qualified, skilled, and competent engineers required for the nation.To promote quality engineering education through different training programmes, research work, material testing research labs, and various consultancy services of engineering in the future.To produce quality engineering experts and managers as highly qualified human resources by offering MSc degrees in various engineering and science disciplines in the future GoalsThe strategic goals of the college are:To enhance academic excellenceTo attract and graduate outstanding studentsTo integrate modern technology with teaching-learning and research activitiesTo ensure quality education at an affordable price for all, with special attention to educationally disadvantaged and marginalized groups, including indigenous communities, females, etc.

name: ISMT College, Pokhara
description:
A warm welcome to ISMT Pokhara. ISMT Pokhara, in partnership with the University of Sunderland, UK, is dedicated to delivering internationally recognized, industry-relevant education at an affordable cost. Our mission is to empower students with the knowledge, skills, and opportunities to build a successful future.

At ISMT Pokhara, we offer a dynamic and innovative learning environment where education is delivered through modern, creative teaching methods and assessments. Studying here is more than earning a degree—it’s an opportunity to grow personally, develop critical thinking, and unlock students’ potential. Our student-centered approach ensures that they are at the core of everything we do.

We are committed to providing a transformative educational experience that prepares them for rewarding careers. Our UK-accredited programs are designed to meet global industry standards, equipping them with practical skills, problem-solving abilities, and a spirit of innovation. Beyond academics, we strive to make a positive impact on communities by fostering applied learning that connects classroom knowledge to real-world challenges.

Our state-of-the-art campus in Pokhara offers a supportive and inspiring environment, with modern facilities designed to enhance your academic journey. At ISMT, education extends beyond textbooks—we encourage curiosity, creativity, and the confidence to make a difference in the world.

Join ISMT Pokhara and take the first step toward a brighter, more prosperous future.

ISMT was established in 2011 with a mission to deliver internationally recognized qualifications.

name: Lakshya CA
description: Lakshya CA is a distinguished educational institution in Nepal, dedicated to the professional development and academic success of the next generation of Chartered Accountants. Built on a foundation of academic excellence and steadfast ethical values, the institute provides a nurturing environment that equips students with the skills to become financial leaders, entrepreneurs, and impactful change-makers.The institution offers a comprehensive learning experience that meticulously blends rigorous preparation for the ICAN CA Syllabus 2025 with individualized mentoring and practical exposure. Every class, workshop, and session is structured to be both intellectually enriching and professionally empowering, ensuring that students are not only prepared for their examinations but are also ready to thrive in the global financial landscape.At the core of Lakshya CA is a vibrant community of aspiring professionals. This community is guided by a team of highly experienced faculty members and bolstered by a strong network of dedicated alumni, committed parents, and strategic industry partners.By fostering a culture of collaboration and integrity, Lakshya CA ensures that the path to professional certification is more than just a goal—it is a shared journey of growth and transformation.MissionThe mission of Lakshya CA is to empower aspiring Chartered Accountants by delivering a transformative education strictly aligned with the ICAN New Syllabus 2025. The institution is dedicated to nurturing analytical thinkers, ethical professionals, and confident leaders through a combination of result-oriented teaching, practical exposure, and personalized mentorship.Lakshya CA aims to foster a learning environment where dedication meets innovation, ensuring that students are thoroughly prepared to excel in their examinations and their future professional lives.Core ValuesLakshya CA operates under a set of core values that define every aspect of its educational ecosystem:Excellence: The institution pursues the highest academic standards through integrity and unwavering dedication.Innovation: By embracing modern and relevant learning strategies, the school prepares students for the complexities of a dynamic professional world.Discipline: The institute cultivates a focused, resilient mindset necessary for success in the demanding field of Chartered Accountancy.Commitment: Lakshya CA remains fully devoted to the success of its students, providing comprehensive support from foundational concepts through to the final examinations.Empowerment: The institution inspires students to envision ambitious goals, think creatively, and step boldly into their professional futures.Educational PhilosophyThe educational philosophy at Lakshya CA is student-centered and deeply rooted in discipline, innovation, and personalized guidance. The institution maintains the belief that every aspiring Chartered Accountant possesses the inherent curiosity, resilience, and potential to excel when supported by the right learning environment.The teaching methodology at Lakshya CA seamlessly blends conceptual clarity with practical exposure, ensuring that students are both exam-ready and career-ready. The school provides a supportive, focused, and motivating learning space designed to encourage initiative, accountability, and continuous growth at every stage of the CA journey.

name: Xavier College of Interdisciplinary Studies
description: Xavier College of Interdisciplinary Studies (Xavier CIS), strategically located in Basundhara near the Ring Road, is committed to empowering students with the knowledge, skills, and values needed to excel as tomorrow’s leaders and professionals. The college offers a comprehensive range of academic programs, including the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc CSIT), Bachelor of Arts & Bachelor of Legislative Law (BALLB), and Master of Business Administration (MBA). Through an industry-oriented curriculum and a strong emphasis on academic excellence, the institution equips students with the knowledge, skills, and competencies required to thrive in an increasingly competitive global landscape.Xavier CIS distinguishes itself through its commitment to experiential learning and academic rigor. Guided by a team of highly qualified and experienced faculty members, students are encouraged to move beyond theoretical concepts and engage in practical, hands-on learning experiences that prepare them for real-world challenges. The college further supports student success through dedicated career guidance, job placement assistance, and a range of scholarship opportunities, ensuring that quality education remains accessible to deserving and talented individuals.In collaboration with HRIT Academy, Xavier CIS fosters a dynamic and enriching learning environment that promotes innovation, critical thinking, and interdisciplinary growth. With modern facilities and a student-centered approach, the campus serves as a vibrant hub for academic and personal development, making it an ideal destination for students seeking a holistic and future-focused educational experience.

name: Aryan School of Engineering and Management
description: Purbanchal University’s management faculty lists Aryan School of Engineering and Management in Kathmandu.

name: Luminous College of Advanced Studies
address: Dhapasi, (Near Gande International Hospital), Tokha, Kathmandu
description: Located in Tokha-6, Kathmandu, Luminous College of Advanced Studies is a premier institution of higher learning affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University. The college offers industry-oriented programs, including the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), BSc Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc CSIT), and Master of Business Administration (MBA), with a commitment to delivering quality education that is academically rigorous, professionally relevant, and globally competitive.At Luminous College, education is viewed as a transformative journey rather than merely the pursuit of a degree. The institution is dedicated to nurturing principled leaders, critical thinkers, and compassionate individuals who are prepared to navigate the complexities of an ever-evolving world. Guided by its inspiring philosophy, "Learn, Lead, Illuminate," the college creates an environment where curiosity is encouraged, knowledge is applied with purpose, and learning inspires positive change.The academic experience at Luminous seamlessly blends theoretical foundations with practical exposure, enabling students to develop professional competencies, leadership qualities, and innovative mindsets. Through experienced faculty, student-centered learning approaches, and a culture that promotes creativity and collaboration, the college empowers learners to realize their potential and excel in their chosen fields.With a strong emphasis on research, innovation, and continuous improvement, Luminous College of Advanced Studies aspires to become a nationally and internationally recognized center of academic excellence. By fostering original inquiry, ethical values, and lifelong learning, the institution strives to transform aspirations into achievements and prepare graduates to make meaningful contributions to their professions and society.MissionTo empower students through high-quality education that integrates academic excellence, practical skills, innovation, and leadership values, preparing them to succeed in a dynamic global environment and contribute responsibly to society.VisionTo become a leading institution of higher learning in Nepal, recognized for academic innovation, research excellence, ethical leadership, and transformative educational experiences that develop future-ready professionals and responsible global citizens.

name: V.S. Niketan College
description: Established in 1981 AD (2038 BS) by late academician Dr. Babu Ram Pokharel, V.S. Niketan College is a pioneering institution under the V.S. Education Foundation with a distinguished legacy of academic excellence spanning more than four decades. The institution is renowned for its commitment to quality education and has produced graduates who have excelled in medicine, engineering, banking, business, administration, and various professional sectors in Nepal and abroad.The college provides a dynamic learning environment supported by modern infrastructure, experienced faculty members, technology-integrated teaching methods, and student-centered academic practices. It emphasizes holistic development by nurturing students' intellectual, social, moral, and psychological growth and preparing them to become disciplined, responsible, and innovative professionals.V.S. Niketan College offers the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) programme, a career-oriented undergraduate degree designed to develop competent business professionals and future leaders. The programme combines theoretical foundations with practical learning approaches through case studies, group discussions, project work, presentations, field visits, and internship opportunities. It equips students with managerial competencies, analytical thinking, leadership qualities, and decision-making skills required in today's competitive business environment.VisionTo be a leading center of academic excellence that delivers world-class, value-based education and develops competent, innovative, and socially responsible professionals capable of meeting national and global challenges.MissionTo provide need-responsive, quality, and career-oriented education through progressive and relevant academic programmes.To foster intellectual, social, moral, and psychological development among students.To cultivate leadership, managerial competence, critical thinking, and practical skills through experiential learning.To create an inclusive and supportive learning environment that encourages lifelong learning, innovation, and professional growth.To prepare graduates who can contribute meaningfully to business, industry, society, and national development.

name: Hrit Academy (College)
description: Hrit Academy, established in 2003 A.D., is located at Basundhara Chauki, Kantimarg, Kathmandu. The institution is built on an ethos of collaboration and support, aiming to provide quality, value-based education. Its primary mission is to develop professional, disciplined individuals prepared to adapt to the latest developments and challenges in their respective fields.The college integrates modern technology into its curriculum and encourages students to engage in research and innovation. By aligning its programs with global standards and incorporating professional personality development, Hrit Academy prepares students for a competitive world. The campus features an earthquake-resistant academic block where discipline, dedication, and devotion are considered fundamental to student success. Students are expected to maintain decency and decorum to foster a cooperative learning environment.Academically, the institution offers digitalized classrooms, an extensive library, and modern teaching methodologies supported by experienced faculty. Hrit Academy also emphasizes holistic growth through a variety of extracurricular activities, including Tai-chi, meditation, and music. Furthermore, the college provides expert career counseling, internship opportunities, and inclusive scholarship programs designed to support deserving students from diverse backgrounds, including those from rural areas and government schools, ensuring equitable access to industry-relevant education.MissionTo create, integrate, and impart quality, value-based education to every student.To develop highly capable, professional, and disciplined individuals who can compete in a global environment.To provide student-centered, technology-driven learning that remains aligned with evolving industry needs.To promote research, innovation, and critical thinking among students.To instill professional ethics, discipline, and personality development for real-world readiness.To empower every Hritian to face the challenges of a competitive world with confidence, competence, and integrity.VisionTo become a leading academic institution in Nepal, recognized for academic excellence and disciplined education.To shape responsible citizens and competent professionals prepared to thrive in an ever-changing global landscape.To establish a center of excellence founded on collaboration, support, and strong institutional values.To nurture well-rounded individuals who embody ethics, innovation, and leadership.To inspire students to contribute meaningfully to society at both national and global levels.

name: Vibrant College
description: Vibrant College offers a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (CSIT) and a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA), each with a duration of four years. The programs are delivered by a team of expert faculty and are supported by modern laboratories, providing a career-focused learning environment.

name: School of Public Policy (SPP)
description: The School of Public Policy is an institution dedicated to reimagining higher education in Nepal by fostering a learning environment that cultivates critical thinking, creativity, and purposeful leadership. The school offers a Master of Public Policy (MPP) program, designed to provide a homegrown alternative for students seeking an education grounded in intellectual rigor and social responsibility.The curriculum adopts an interdisciplinary approach, integrating Public Policy, Law, Economics, and data-driven analytical tools. By aligning with international academic frameworks while addressing Nepal’s specific social and governance realities, the program prepares students to handle local policy challenges with a global perspective. The school focuses on developing actionable skills, enabling aspiring professionals to contribute effectively to policy development and public sector transformation.Students are supported by a distinguished faculty comprising academics and professionals who bring practical insights into the classroom. To assist learners throughout their academic journey, the institution provides comprehensive support services, including pre-application counseling, webinars, and dedicated helpdesks. With a commitment to academic excellence and ethical values, the School of Public Policy encourages students to become socially responsible individuals who can address real-world challenges with integrity and innovation. Through this model, the school aims to empower young people to contribute to a prosperous and resilient nation.

name: Global College of Technology
description: Global College of Technology (GCT), located in Baneshwor, Kathmandu, is an institution dedicated to providing higher education in Information Technology and Business. Guided by the motto "Global Thinking Starts Here…", the college operates through Transnational Education (TNE) partnerships with internationally recognized universities, such as the University of Huddersfield in the UK. This collaboration enables students in Nepal to pursue globally accredited degrees that are designed to meet current industry standards.The college currently offers a BSc (Hons) in Information Technology and a BSc (Hons) in Computer Science. Within the Computer Science program, students can specialize in Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Cyber Security. The curriculum focuses on advanced digital technologies, cybersecurity, and information systems, ensuring that graduates develop the technical skills and global competence required for the modern workforce.GCT follows a student-centered academic model that prioritizes personalized learning and practical application. The teaching methodology includes interactive sessions, blended learning, and AI-based simulations. To support this approach, the college is equipped with smart classrooms and AI-supported laboratories featuring robotics and machine learning tools. The faculty comprises experienced academics from both Nepal and the UK, providing students with a blend of local context and international expertise.In addition to its academic programs, Global College of Technology organizes various events and extracurricular activities to foster innovation and professional growth. Since its establishment, the college has maintained a focus on balancing academic learning with real-world application. By providing a modern learning environment and maintaining strong academic partnerships, GCT prepares its students to navigate the challenges of the evolving technological landscape.VisionTo be a global leader in higher education, nurturing ethical, innovative, and globally ready professionals equipped to lead and thrive in an infinitely connected, technology-driven world, making a meaningful impact.MissionTo empower the next generations with world-class education in IT with AI and Cybersecurity, and globally emerging technologies and streams in fostering innovation, global competence, and the skills to solve 21st-century challenges.ObjectivesDeliver internationally accredited, industry-relevant programs through global partnerships.Ensure career readiness via internships, research, and mentorship from global experts.Foster global citizenship through cross-cultural learning and ethical reasoning.Promote excellence with continuous skill development, research, and innovative resources.

name: Kathmandu College of Technology
description: Kathmandu College of Technology (KCT), formerly known as Samajik College, is located in Lokanthali, Bhaktapur, Nepal. The college offers Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc CSIT), Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS), and Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) in affiliation with Tribhuvan University.Kathmandu College of Technology (KCT) is established with an aim to significantly contribute to shape the career of +2 graduates in the field of IT and Computing. The college, Samajik College understands the advancement of computers and Information Technology which continues to have a profound impact on lives, and addresses the need of technically competent graduates to provide appropriate computing solutions that industry requires and it is committed to helping students develop skills, knowledge, and attitudes that help them pursue opportunities in IT and Computing.Kathmandu College of Technology (KCT) provides fully equipped and specialized computer laboratories right from the beginning of your choice. The College will also teach students soft skills, problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and industry relevant additional IT courses apart from teaching the curricula designed by the University. Most importantly, the course taught offers both theoretical and practical applications where students are encouraged to apply their classroom instructions. Emphasis is placed on helping students to develop skills, knowledge in technical areas that have practical value in the workplace.KCT provides its students with a combination of leading-edge theory and technical knowledge plus hands-on practical experience to prepare our students for a successful career as an IT professional in Nepal and around the world.MissionThe mission of the Kathmandu College of Technology is to expand human knowledge and benefit society through research integrated with education. It prepares students to investigate the most challenging, fundamental problems in technology while educating outstanding students to become creative members of society.AimKathmandu College of Technology aims to teach, train, guide, and motivate students to effectively make their way into a challenging and rewarding IT and computing career.Core valuesInstitutional values influence how Kathmandu College of Technology makes and carry out decisions, and how we interact with internal and external constituencies. The core values are:DedicationHonourRespectTrustResponsibility

name: Janamaitri Campus
description: Janamaitri Campus (JMC) was established in 1991 AD at the initiative of academicians, intellectuals, and social workers residing in the Kuleshwor area. The campus has been extending its services for the last three decades, proving it as a pioneering academic institution with a difference. In its continuous journey of quality enhancement, the campus reached a new dimension with the formal certification, Quality Assurance and Accreditation (QAA), from the University Grants Commission (UGC). As the first QAA certified campus in Kathmandu Valley, the campus has been accelerating its motion in the assistance, guidance and supervision of the UGC and in the active participation of its esteemed stakeholders.As a non-profit community campus, the campus is dedicated to serving the people, society, and the nation by imparting quality education. Conducive academic environment, mutual understanding, high regard for social values, and practice-based education are some of the notable features of the campus. The campus has ensured quality education despite a low initial investment, thanks to the dedication and commitment of students, faculty members, and the entire management. Since its establishment, JMC has contributed to enhancing access to education for all by offering scholarships to socially marginalized and economically disadvantaged students, students with disabilities, and meritorious students to ensure inclusiveness in education. The campus has given high priority to the optimal use of available resources to promote academic excellence. The campus has acquired around 2,200 sq.m. of land and constructed a four-story building with modern learning resources. The wide extended physical facilities have been possible in continuous support of the UGC and with the contribution of the management committee, the faculties, and the non-teaching staff. The entire mission of the campus is guided by the vision for developing JMC as a deemed university in the foreseeable future.Vision To develop JMC as a deemed university by making it a center of academic excellence for meeting the emerging challenges of modernization and globalization”Objectives:To instill in students’ questioning spirits, a sense of responsibility, and a learning attitude.To impart quality education through practical classes.To encourage a sense of self-discipline, confidence and to develop a multidimensional personality.To enable the students to achieve academic excellence so as to cope with all the complexities of life.To ensure a sense of brotherhood, cooperation and mutual understanding.

name: St. Xavier's College, Maitighar
description: St. Xavier's College, located at Maitighar, Kathmandu is an educational institution of higher learning established in 1988 AD. Since its very inception the College has been offering quality education and has contributed to the development of the nation through the production of highly qualified human resources.St. Xavier's College, Kathmandu is managed by the Nepal Jesuit Society. Jesuits began their educational work in Nepal in 1951 with the opening of St. Xavier's School, the Godavari, followed by St. Xavier's School, Jawalakhel and St. Xavier's School, Deonia. Other schools run by Nepal Jesuit Society are Moran Memorial School, Maheshpur and St.Xavier's, Sadakbari.Currently, St Xavier's College offers 13 different programs. It runs A-level Non-Science and Science under Cambridge Assessment International Education and Ten Plus Two (10+2) program in Science under the affiliation of National Examination Board (NEB).In Bachelor level with affiliation from Tribhuvan University, St Xavier's College offers B.Sc Physics, B.Sc Microbiology, BSc CSIT, Bachelor of Information Technology Management (BITM), Bachelor of Arts (majoring in Social Work and English) and Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) program.St. Xavier's College also offers Masters programs in Microbiology (MSc Microbiology), Physics (MSc Physics) and Masters in Business Studies (MBS) under Tribhuvan University.St.Xavier's College seeks to foster competence, creativity, and innovative spirit, throughout and beyond the years spent in College. At the end of their studies at St.Xavier's, students are expected to enter the larger world with socially responsible goals, a lifelong appetite for learning and the desire to better the world. Students are also likely to be prepared to use their God-given talents not only for personal fulfillment but also for service unto others.St. Xavier's College promotes constructive student-teacher contact and encourages students to develop their full leadership potential. The intelligent pursuit of excellence and a variety of activities that students are exposed to in College are intended to produce moral leaders who will champion the values of truth, justice, and peace.MissionTo cultivate compassionate, innovative leaders who excel in service, uphold justice, and transform the world.VisionTo nurture holistic individuals who excel intellectually, spiritually, and socially, contributing positively to society and the world.ObjectiveTo develop global citizens who embody academic excellence, moral integrity, spiritual wisdom, social and environmental responsibility, and emotional health.

name: Pulchowk Campus | Institute of Engineering
description: Institute of Engineering Pulchowk Campus is an constituent campus of Tribhuvan University. Under Institute of Engineering there are four constituent campuses and ten private colleges. Pulchowk Campus is the central campus of the Institute of Engineering. It is established in 1972 (2029 B.S) as one of the constituent campus of the Institute of Engineering and is situated at the heart of the Lalitpur city at Pulchowk.Currently, Pulchowk Campus offers bachelors courses, master’s courses and Ph. D. programs in different areas of engineering. It caters Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering (48 Seats ), Architecture Engineering (48 Seats ),Computer Engineering (96 Seats ), Civil (144 Seats), Electronics, Communication and Information (48 Seats ), & 48 Seats in a Electrical Engineering.This campus is well equipped with necessary laboratories with great strength of faculties and staffs, separate buildings for academic and administrative purposes has become the center of excellence of engineering education in Nepal.Pulchowk Campus has unique and globally recognized image in the engineering field. Pulchowk campus is not only offering B.E. programs but also conducting M.Sc. in engineering on various disciplines as well as Ph.D. programs also. Every year IOE conducts an entrance examination for Bachelor of Engineering B.E. and M.Sc. programs. Eligible students from all over the world, aspiring to study engineering appear for this exam and only the students in merit basis get the chance to study in Pulchowk Campus.Over the past few years the toughest competition in entrance exam is among the students to get enroll into Pulchowk Campus. Students studying in the Pulchowk Campus are considered to be very competitive. Engineers, who have studied there, are performing well in their respective areas as well as their performance in further study is also outstanding.

In the presence of Late King Mahendra, Late Dr. Heinrich Lubke, President of Federal Republic of Germany inaugurated Technical Institute (TTI) on 29th of Falgun 2023 B.S.(13th March 1967). The Technical Training Institute(TTI) offered midlevel manpower course in mechanical engineering, automobile engineering, electrical engineering and mechanical drafting beginning.

With the assistance from the Government of Federal republic of Germany, Technical Training Institute Project (TTIP) was established in Nepal in 2019 B.S.(1963 AD), with the sole objective of producing trained tradespersons and technicians needed for the development of the country. TTI started three years vocational training in Mechanical, Automobile and Electrical trades for S.L.C. graduates from 2022 B.S.(1966 AD) to 2024 B.S. (1968 AD) At the meantime, the three years course in Mechanical Drafting was transferred to Pulchowk, IOE.

Thapathali Campus, formerly known as Technical Training Institute (TTI), was renamed and became part of Tribhuvan University (T.U.) as the Institute of Engineering in 1973 AD. In 1977 AD, the campus introduced a two-year proficiency certificate level (PCL) course for SLC students. In 1987 AD, it started offering three-year diploma courses in Mechanical Engineering and Automobile Engineering. In 2002 AD, diploma programs in Electronics Engineering and Computer Engineering were added.

Inauguration by Late King Mahendra B.B. Shah and German Chancellor Dr.Heinrich Lubke

name: Institute of Management Studies (IMS)
description: Institute of Management Studies (IMS)affiliated was established in 2004 and is one of the pioneer institutions in preparing individuals for professional careers in business management and liberal sciences. Committed to our motto "Educating the Global Generation", we invite aspiring students to join this challenging academic community where the strength of our faculty and the ability of students synergies to create a bright career for young people.VisionThe vision of the Institute of Management Studies (IMS) is to provide transformative and dynamic learning experiences that enhance students’ knowledge, skills, and competencies, promoting intellectual growth and nurturing entrepreneurial potential to contribute meaningfully to society.MissionIMS is dedicated to delivering innovative, student-centered education through a collaborative community of educators, scholars, and industry practitioners. The institution aims to empower students, faculty, and partners to shape a responsible and sustainable future for business and society by instilling in them the skills, knowledge, and ethical values essential for lifelong success.ValuesThe Institute encourages students to appreciate the wonders of the world, recognize the strengths of others, and value the contributions of those who came before. It supports individual growth and nurtures a spirit of generosity.The Institute strives to foster a culture that promotes collaborative teamwork, respectful and kind communication, open-mindedness, and recognition of each member’s contributions.It emphasizes the importance of collaborative partnerships with both internal and external stakeholders to enhance outcomes in student learning, research, and service.The Institute values a learning community that embraces diversity in both individuals and ideas.It remains firmly committed to honesty, accountability, and transparency, and consistently acts in the best interests of all its stakeholders.

name: Milestone International SS/College
description: Milestone International SS/College, established in 2009 under the management of the Himal Educational Foundation and Research Centre Pvt. Ltd., has built a strong reputation as one of Nepal’s leading academic institutions. Founded by a group of experienced educationists, the college was created with a vision to deliver quality education paired with practical skills and values essential for today’s dynamic world.Over the years, Milestone has become a center of excellence, known not just for its academic strength but also for helping students grow in creativity, confidence, and overall development. The college offers a vibrant learning environment where students are encouraged to think critically, explore their interests, and prepare themselves for real-life challenges. Whether enrolled in Science, Management, or Law, students benefit from a balanced academic experience supported by modern infrastructure, a motivated teaching team, and interactive learning methods.Beyond the classroom, Milestone provides students with opportunities to engage in internships, field visits, research activities, and innovation-driven clubs. These experiences help bridge the gap between theory and practice, guiding students toward clear academic and career goals.While the college follows a set of policies to maintain discipline and accountability, it does so with a student-friendly approach. Communication with parents is welcomed, and a culture of support and structure is maintained throughout a student’s academic journey. Milestone strives to create an environment where learning is meaningful, personal growth is encouraged, and each student feels prepared for their journey ahead. The Vision of the college is to become a model institution for higher studies by equipping students with practical skills and training that boost self-confidence, self-reliance, and open doors to better opportunities in both national and global arenas. The mission of the college is dedicated to developing capable, independent, and forward-thinking individuals. It promotes critical thinking, research skills, and adaptability to prepare students for the challenges of a fast-changing world and help them become responsible professionals and citizens.

name: Pashchimanchal Campus | Institute of Engineering
description:
Admissions for BE Batch 2083 are now open/in progress. For further details and updates, please visit the Admission Portal.

Pokhara is not only a famous tourism destination but also an academic hub. It has many prestigious educational institutes students from different parts of Nepal have gathered to seek knowledge and learn technology. Scholars from different parts of Nepal as well as overseas are contributing to the academic endeavors of Pokhara. Paschimanchal Campus is one of the leading institutions of this area. It is an institution of national and international renown.

The scenic Paschimanchal Campus, formerly also known as Western Region Campus (WRC), is located in the northern part of mega-scenic city of Pokhara. It enjoys the continuous roaring music of Seti River flowing….

Since its inception in 1981 (2038 BS) under the Institute of Engineering, Tribhuvan University, Pashchimanchal Campus has evolved into a premier destination for engineering excellence. From its roots in diploma-level training to its current status as a QAA-accredited institution, the campus offers a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs, including Civil, Electrical, Computer, and Geomatics Engineering. Notably, our specialized Master’s programs in fields like Rock and Tunnel Engineering and Geospatial Engineering are unique to this campus, reflecting our commitment to providing cutting-edge education that meets both national and international standards.

Our institution prides itself on a culture of innovation, research, and digital transformation. Guided by a dedicated faculty, we aim to produce highly skilled professionals who are not only technically competent but also deeply committed to ethical and moral standards. Our alumni continue to drive sustainable development and modernization across government and corporate sectors worldwide. We invite aspiring students from across the country to join our vibrant academic community, utilize our state-of-the-art laboratory facilities, and build a successful professional career that contributes meaningfully to the nation’s progress……

name: Maharajgunj Medical Campus
description: Maharajgunj Medical Campus (MC) at Maharajgunj, Kathmandu is one of the nine campuses of the Institute of Medicine (IoM). Since its upgradation to the status of a campus of IoM from the Auxiliary Health Workers' School in 1972, Maharajgunj Medical Campus has, during the span of just over two decades, played a significant role in conducting academic programmes for the development of different categories of Human Resources for Health (HRH) in Nepal. Of the twenty-nine academic programmes that the IoM runs to date, thirty four consisting of eighteen postgraduate, four undergraduate and three certificate programmes (about ninty percent of the educational activities of the IoM) are being conducted at MC. The programs offered by Maharajgunj Medical Campus are BASLP, B.Sc MLT, B. Optometry, BDS, B. Pharmacy, BPH, B.Sc MIT, M.Phil Clinical Psychology, M.Sc. Clinical Biochemistry, M.Sc. Clinical Microbiology, MD Biochemistry, MD Clinical Pharmacology, MD Clinical Physiology, MD Dermatology, MD Forensic Medicine, MD Internal Medicine, MD Microbiology, MD Paediatrics, MD in Anesthesiology, MD in General Practice, MD in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, MD in Ophthalmology, MD in Pathology, MD in Psychiatry, MD in Radiodiagnosis, MDS Orthodontics, MS Clinical Anatomy, MS in Clinical Otorhinolaryngology and Head and Neck Surgery, MS in General Surgery, MS in Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery, MSc Medical Imaging Technology, Master in Public Health (MPH) and Master of Public Health Nutrition (MPHN).In its endeavor to create competent and diverse Human Resources for Health. HRH, ranging from a Primary health Care worker to a Medical Specialist for rendering primary to tertiary health care in the country. MC has indeed taken a long stride in the field of medical education in Nepal.The establishment of Tribhuvan University Teaching Hospital (TUTH) in 1983 near to MC premise, made the fact very clear imparting medical education does require a teaching hospital for facilitating teaching-learning activities effectively. With the establishment of TUTH, MC acquired the full status of the First Medical School in Nepal. Since then, MC not only became responsible for imparting medical education but also started to provide tertiary health care to all those coming to THTH. The faculty of medicine here played a dual role- that of a medical teacher and a medical specialist.

name: Kathmandu University School of Medical Sciences
description: Kathmandu University (KU) is an autonomous, not-for-profit, self-funding public institution established by an Act of Parliament in December 1991. It is an institution of higher learning dedicated to maintaining the standard of academic excellence in various classical and professional disciplines. The mission statement of the University is “ to provide quality education for leadership ”. The vision is “ to become a world-class university devoted to bringing knowledge and technology to the service of mankind ”. The University aspires to serve the nation by fulfilling the needs of the society through the motto of taking knowledge and skills “from the campus to the community.”  The University’s broadly perceived signature features include autonomous administration, financial self-sustenance, regular maintenance of the academic calendar, sustained trust of the international academic community, optimum contact between faculties and students and student-friendly environment, among others. Similarly, the University’s graduates are widely known for attributes such as substantive exposure to the industry and the community, research competence, technological literacy, moderate to high-level communicative competence, teamwork and leadership spirit and global compatibility. The Senate is the apex body of the University. It comprises University authorities, dignified educationists, government secretaries, donors, mayors of local municipalities, teacher representatives, student representative, and representatives from affiliated institutions and industries. The Prime Minister, who is the Chancellor of the University, chairs the Senate. The Minister of Education is the Pro-Chancellor. The Executive Council and Academic Council develop internal policies and programs to run the University. The University’s Board of Trustees, which comprises renowned personalities including the founding fathers, is entrusted with the responsibilities of advising long-term plans and generating and managing of resources. The University operates through seven Schools: (i) School of Arts, (ii) School of Education, (iii) School of Engineering, (iv) School of Law, (v) School of Management, (vi) School of Medical Sciences and (vii) School of Science. At present, the University offers more than 200 long-term and short-term academic programs and courses from intermediate to Ph.D. levels. As of June 2023, the University has produced 41,275 graduates. Student fees cover 60% in KU’s financial management. The same percentage of student fees goes into salary and allowances. Other sources cover 40%, whereas the government support is 10%. A total of about 10% of the students studying in the University at various levels receive scholarships apart from educational loan facilities and other sponsoring schemes from different organizations. KU runs academic programs most of which are credited for being introduced for the first time in the country. Business Administration, Pharmacy, Environmental Science, Biotechnology, Human Biology, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Geomatics Engineering, Development Studies, Social Work, Technical Education, Media Studies, Civil Engineering with Specialization in Hydropower, Landscape Management and Heritage studies, Doctor of Medicine (DM) in Gastroenterology, DM in Neurology and MS by Research in Glaciology count among the pioneering programs in Nepal. The University marked the year 2016 as its Silver Jubilee Year. On the occasion of the Silver Jubilee celebrations, Prof. Dr. Ram Kantha Makaju Shrestha, the then Vice-Chancellor, brought forward a vision document, Silver Jubilee Initiatives – Vision 2030 , which pledges thrust for quality, innovation, equity, identity, impact and global engagement. These initiatives, founded on the University’s key achievements for 25 years in quality education, will remain instrumental towards achieving the status of a world-class university. Listen to KU Anthem: Listen to National Anthem: Our Mission

name: Kathmandu University School of Science
description: Kathmandu University School of Science was started in July 1992. The mission of the School of Science is to produce scientific manpower of high caliber in order to attain academic excellence and continuously develop research facilities to benefit both individuals and institutions. It also aims at providing consulting services to the public at large. It has altogether four departments. They are Environmental Science and Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy and Natural Sciences (Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Mathematics). It offers Bachelor in Pharmacy, B.Sc in Computational Mathematics, B.Sc Applied Physics, B.Sc in Environmental Science, B.Sc Human Biology, B.Sc Computer Science, B.Tech Biotechnology, and B.Tech Environmental Engineering in Bachelor's Level. Similarly it offers Master in Pharmacy, M.Sc in Environmental Science, M.Sc Environment, M.Sc Physics, and Natural Resources, M.S by Research in Glaciology in Masters level, M.Tech Biotechnology in Masters Level and Masters of Philosophy (M.Phil) in Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics and Environmental Science. Mission: The mission of the School is to produce scientific manpower of high caliber in order to attain academic excellence and continuously develop research facilities to benefit both individuals and institutions. It also aims at providing consulting services to the public at large.

We are very honored to welcome you all to the School of Engineering (SoE) at Kathmandu University, Nepal. As the country's first autonomous, not-for-profit, self-funding public institution in Higher Education in Engineering programs, the School of Engineering paved the way and is now a world-class engineering school that proudly represents our country in the global arena.

name: Kathmandu University Centre for Buddhist Studies
description: Kathmandu University - Centre for Buddhist Studies at Rangjung Yeshe Institute offers a unique academic education, undergraduate and graduate, leading to Bachelor of Arts (BA) and Master of Arts (MA) degrees in Buddhist Studies with Himalayan Language.The programme, located in Boudhanath, Kathmandu, Nepal, is structured as an intensive immersion into Buddhist Philosophy, Tibetan Language and other areas relevant to the study of Buddhism and the Himalayan region.For visiting students, the Centre for Buddhist Studies hosts study-abroad programs in Buddhist philosophy and language and conducts intensive summer programs in Tibetan, Sanskrit, and Nepali, and Buddhist studies.Contact AddressKathmandu University - Centre for Buddhist Studies at Rangjung Yeshe Institute P.O. name: School of Management | Purbanchal University
description: Purbanchal University, School of Management (PUSOM) formerly known as Management Campus is established by the Purbanchal University Act 1994 with a mission to establish as a leading university of academic excellence. The main objective of School of Management is to contribute to the development of efficient and capable manpower for the business, government, and social sectors. Presently School of Management is offering four programs namely Ph.D. in management, M.Phil in management, MBA & BBA in Masters and Bachelor Level.Contact AddressPurbanchal University, School of Management Tinpaini Biratnagar

name: School of Management  | Kathmandu University
description: Established in August 1993 as a premier management development institute under Kathmandu University, Kathmandu University School of Management (KUSOM) pioneered high quality and market responsive Graduate Management programs (MBA, EMBA and MSM) that are widely recognized as a passport to successful professional management career. It has produced over 650 high quality management graduates who are managing leading organizations across all sectors - with passion and professionalism.KUSOM also pioneered Undergraduate Management programs (BBA, BBIS and BHTM) through partnership with the private sector management development providers.KUSOM initiated Post Graduate Diploma in Security Management (PGDSM), first ever such program in the South Asia, to meet the need of highly trained security managers for better security environment in industry, business and development sectors. KUSOM has recently launched Diploma in Management (DipM) leading to Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) which is practice-oriented and industry- relevant management education program.The university has also been offering Research degree program in Master in Philosophy (MPhilM) in Management and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Management programs.Mission and VisionKUSOM leads the way, as it did in the past, to professionalize management and to build successful management careers. KUSOM is and keeps you - ahead in management.The mission of the School is to improve the practice and profession of management for development through creating quality and relevant opportunities for learning, knowing, discovering, and applying the best in management. The vision of the School is to become one of the top twenty management schools in South Asia by 2022 while continuing to be the leader in management development in the country.Within these areas, the School aims to achieve the following goals:Preparation of professionals for career in managementProfessional enrichment of change leaders and entrepreneursSupport for organizational changeGeneration and dissemination of management knowledgeContinuous improvement in institutional performance and image. Contact AddressKathmandu University School of ManagementPost Box No: 6250Pinchhe Tole, Sasatanchha, Balkumari, Lalitpur, Nepal

name: School of Development and Social Engineering | Pokhara University
description: The Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences is one of the three functioning faculties of Pokhara University at present. Pokhara University has offered three Masters and a Bachelor program under the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences: Master in Population, Gender and Development (MPGD); Master of Arts in English; and Master of Philosophy in English (M. Phil) and BA in Development Studies. The Master in Population, Gender and Development Programme and BA in Development Studies are the only constituent program of the University.The Master in Population, Gender and Development Programme was initiated in 2003 with a Post-Graduate Diploma (PGD) leading to a Master s Degree. name: Kathmandu University Technical Training Center
description: Kathmandu University (KU) is an autonomous, not-for-profit, self-funding public institution established by an Act of Parliament in December 1991. It is an institution of higher learning dedicated to maintaining the standard of academic excellence in various classical and professional disciplines. The mission statement of the University is “ to provide quality education for leadership ”. The vision is “ to become a world-class university devoted to bringing knowledge and technology to the service of mankind ”. The University aspires to serve the nation by fulfilling the needs of the society through the motto of taking knowledge and skills “from the campus to the community.”  The University’s broadly perceived signature features include autonomous administration, financial self-sustenance, regular maintenance of the academic calendar, sustained trust of the international academic community, optimum contact between faculties and students and student-friendly environment, among others. Similarly, the University’s graduates are widely known for attributes such as substantive exposure to the industry and the community, research competence, technological literacy, moderate to high-level communicative competence, teamwork and leadership spirit and global compatibility. The Senate is the apex body of the University. It comprises University authorities, dignified educationists, government secretaries, donors, mayors of local municipalities, teacher representatives, student representative, and representatives from affiliated institutions and industries. The Prime Minister, who is the Chancellor of the University, chairs the Senate. The Minister of Education is the Pro-Chancellor. The Executive Council and Academic Council develop internal policies and programs to run the University. The University’s Board of Trustees, which comprises renowned personalities including the founding fathers, is entrusted with the responsibilities of advising long-term plans and generating and managing of resources. The University operates through seven Schools: (i) School of Arts, (ii) School of Education, (iii) School of Engineering, (iv) School of Law, (v) School of Management, (vi) School of Medical Sciences and (vii) School of Science. At present, the University offers more than 200 long-term and short-term academic programs and courses from intermediate to Ph.D. levels. As of June 2023, the University has produced 41,275 graduates. Student fees cover 60% in KU’s financial management. The same percentage of student fees goes into salary and allowances. Other sources cover 40%, whereas the government support is 10%. A total of about 10% of the students studying in the University at various levels receive scholarships apart from educational loan facilities and other sponsoring schemes from different organizations. KU runs academic programs most of which are credited for being introduced for the first time in the country. Business Administration, Pharmacy, Environmental Science, Biotechnology, Human Biology, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Geomatics Engineering, Development Studies, Social Work, Technical Education, Media Studies, Civil Engineering with Specialization in Hydropower, Landscape Management and Heritage studies, Doctor of Medicine (DM) in Gastroenterology, DM in Neurology and MS by Research in Glaciology count among the pioneering programs in Nepal. The University marked the year 2016 as its Silver Jubilee Year. On the occasion of the Silver Jubilee celebrations, Prof. Dr. Ram Kantha Makaju Shrestha, the then Vice-Chancellor, brought forward a vision document, Silver Jubilee Initiatives – Vision 2030 , which pledges thrust for quality, innovation, equity, identity, impact and global engagement. These initiatives, founded on the University’s key achievements for 25 years in quality education, will remain instrumental towards achieving the status of a world-class university. Additionally, the School strives to nurture educational leaders capable of instigating positive change at all levels of education – from tertiary to secondary and primary. The development professionals produced by KUSOED are expected to be pivotal in driving transformation within their respective fields.Brief History of KUSOED1997: Kathmandu University School of Education (KUSOED) was established. It began with the aim of improving the quality of education in the schools of Dhulikhel Municipality through an in-service teacher training program. Initially, it was a UNESCO-supported project known as the 'Quality Education Project.'1998: KUSOED launched postgraduate and in-service teacher training programs.The academic program in Educational Leadership commenced, with 4 MPhil students and 2 PhD students. MPhil students were supported with Japanese (Hashimoto) scholarships. The Ministry of Education provided scholarships to four persons every year for MPhil and PhD students from 1999 to 2005 A.D.2000: PGDE programs in English Education and Educational Management were launched for secondary level teachers.2001: KUSOED was granted affiliation to the Training Institute for Technical Instruction to run B. Tech. Ed.2002: The Primary School Teachers' Training Program began in collaboration with Rato Bangala School and Bank Street College of Education. PGDE in Mathematics Education for Secondary Teachers was launched.2003: The one-year MEd program in English Language Teaching (ELT) was introduced.2004: The two-year MEd program in English Language Teaching (ELT) was launched.2005: MPhil and PhD programs in Development Studies were introduced.2006: The MEd Program in Mathematics was launched.2006: The 1-year PGD Program in Environment Education and Sustainable Development began in collaboration with Oslo University College, Norwegian University of Life Sciences, Norway, and the University of Dhaka.2007: The Department of Educational Leadership and the Department of Curriculum and Instruction were established.The MEd program in Educational Management was launched.2008: The two-year MEd Program in Environment Education and Sustainable Development was started in collaboration with Oslo University College, Norwegian University of Life Sciences, Norway, and the University of Dhaka.2009: The PGDE program in Early Childhood Education (ECE) began in collaboration with ECEC and NLA (Norwegian Teacher Training Institution).2011: The MPhil in Curriculum & Instruction program was commenced. The MEd program in Educational Management via Distance/Online mode was launched. The MPhil in Mathematics Education was introduced.2012: The Department of Education Leadership was restructured as the Department of Education Leadership and Development Studies. The PhD in Curriculum & Instruction was launched.2013: The MPhil in English Language Education (ELE) was introduced.2014: The M.Ed in Educational Leadership was launched. The Masters in Sustainable Development was introduced.2018: The MTVET Program was launched.KUSOED received Quality Assurance and Accreditation (QAA) from the University Grants Commission (UGC), Nepal.

The year 2011 also saw the resumption of the M Pharm program (Natural Products Chemistry) and the launch of a new major in Clinical Pharmacy, with the most recent course addition being Physiotherapy.VisionThe University has fully understood that it has to partake and contribute in raising the living standard and improving the quality of life of the people to bring about the permanent peace, prosperity, and wellbeing in the country by contributing to create gainful employment opportunities, raising production and productivity, removing the drudgery on work with the promotion and use of indigenous, local and appropriate technologies by promoting and using sustainable energy and by changing the social psychology of the people towards sustainable development goals and social justice.MissionThe mission of Pokhara University is to develop as a Centre of Excellence for Higher Education by excelling in teaching and learning, research and publication, and outreach activities; contributing to the national development process by producing job market-oriented, responsible, productive, service-oriented, and committed human resources; and linking the university system with the community services.Goal and ObjectivesUnveil the strength of learners through the extension of programsDevelop highly equipped labs to enhance education and experimentationPrepare creative and research-oriented scientists in the field of basic, as well as applied sciences, produce well-qualified and skilled graduates to fulfill the national and international demand Contact Address: Pokhara University School of Health and Allied Sciences, Pokhara University, Dhungepatan, Lekhnath, Nepal.
