name: Nepalgunj Nursing Campus
description: The school of nursing was first established in Kathmandu in 1956 under the direction of the Health Service, Ministry of Health. The first batch of this school had enrolled only 15 students. The expected proficiency of the produced manpower was illness-oriented. Principally, this was a hospital-oriented curriculum that was in effect between 1956 and 1986. This curriculum aims to prepare nurses to effectively meet the health needs of the people of Nepal. With the introduction of the new educational system in 1972, nursing education was brought under the Institute of Medicine, Tribhuvan University. After that, a major revised curriculum based on primary health care was introduced in 1987, and it was again updated in 2006. The aim of this programme was to prepare competent and self-reliant nurses who could care for individuals, families, and communities.Nepalgunj Nursing Campus is the only constituent nursing campus of the Tribhuvan University, Institute of Medicine, located in Lumbini, Karnali, and Sudurpaschim provinces. The campus is located in Nepalgunj sub-metropolitan city (SMPC); ward no - 10, in close proximity with Bheri Hospital.The Ministry of Health established the ANM training school in 1969 in Nepalgunj. The school, over a 17-year period, produced 406 ANMs. In 1987, it was upgraded to Proficiency Certificate Level (PCL) nursing campus. Since then, it has produced 1153 staff nurses. Currently, 116 students are pursuing education at various levels.Seeing the need for middle-level manpower in nursing, a 2-year Bachelor of Nursing (BN) programme was started in 2011, which was revised to a 3-year Bachelor of Nursing Science (BNS) from 2013. After the phase out of PCL Nursing, a 4-year B.Sc. Nursing was started in 2021.VISIONAdvancing the nursing profession and changing lives through academic distinction, knowledge, innovation, and continuous progress in the application of qualitative globalized services to every sector of nursing that ensures quality health care for all people.MISSIONTo serve the people of Nepal by:Producing qualified and passionate manpower in the nursing sector.Providing opportunities for aspiring students to pursue higher education in nursing science.Serving as a model institution for nursing education in Nepal.Positively influencing health care in Nepal by providing nurses with problem-solving skills and a sense of compassionate care.Enhancing professionalism in nursing.GOALThe goal of the Nepalgunj Nursing Campus is to prepare and produce registered nurses to be a professional healthcare practitioner who provides compassionate care, which is based on scientific evidence, and who serve as the link between the patient (individual, family, community, or population) and the healthcare environment across the lifespan.OBJECTIVESGeneral objectivesTo provide standard nursing education to the eligible candidates (both females and males) of Nepal, especially from Lumbini, Karnali, and Sudurpaschim provinces, to meet the primary health care and holistic needs of people.Specific objectives Focus on those we serve, especially our students.Advance innovation and excellence in teaching to support student success.Promote excellence in research and creative endeavours. Produce nursing Human Resources at par with international standards.Develop self-reliant Nurses in the field of modern Nursing.Securing the financial future through efficient management, channeling external funds, and building a strong endowment.

description: The School of Mathematical Sciences, Tribhuvan University (TU SMS), is committed to helping the learners not only know and understand the modern world but also make them able to combine the development of knowledge and practical skills in solving real-world problems encountered in various disciplinesTribhuvan University has quite recently taken up this as a challenge and has decided to run Bachelor and Master Degree Programs in Mathematical Sciences (B.Math.Sc. and M.Math.Sc.) that will help produce at least a critical mass of experts with sound knowledge of fundamentals of mathematics, statistical and analytical capability, and fluent computational skills.MissionThe School of Mathematical Sciences, Tribhuvan University (TU SMS), is dedicated to supporting students not only in understanding the modern world but also in developing the ability to combine knowledge and practical skills in solving real-world problems encountered in various disciplines of education. SMS TU provides an open, caring, and multicultural learning environment built on the core values of integrity, responsibility, and dignity.VisionSMS TU shares the vision of developing an intellectually vibrant community of students and faculty, together engaging in research, teaching, and learning that advances knowledge in diverse areas of mathematics and supports current progress in science. It is designed to provide students with extensive and diverse knowledge in the Mathematical Sciences, offering a unique interdisciplinary learning environment for high-quality education and research through the blending of three disciplines: mathematics, statistics, and computer science, and strives to become a center of excellence.Actuarial Science and Its Global ScopeActuarial Science is the discipline that applies mathematical and statistical methods to assess risk in insurance, finance, and other industries and professions. Actuaries are expected to have a detailed understanding of economic, financial, demographic, and insurance risks, and possess expertise in developing & using statistical & financial models to inform financial decisions. The role that an actuary can perform in each of these sectors can be quite varied, including product pricing, financial modeling, valuations, risk management, conducting peer reviews, designing social security schemes, and advising on the premium to be charged, among others.Career Opportunities:A career in Actuarial Science involves the application of mathematics, statistical knowledge, and skills in risk assessment, as well as the evaluation of financial products such as insurance and investments. An actuary typically works in the following fields: · Life Insurance · General Insurance ·Health Insurance · Reinsurance Companies ·Pension Funds · Consultants · Investments · Government · Academics ·Risk Management.Scopes of Actuarial Science in NepalThe field of actuarial science in Nepal is gradually gaining popularity and recognition. The last few years have seen significant activities in the Nepalese insurance sector. Both life and general insurers have increased their market presence, and the penetration rate of insurance has been growing, most notably following the devastating 2015 earthquake. Although there are a total of 40 insurance companies (19 Life Insurance, 20 Non-Life Insurance, and 1 Reinsurance) operating in Nepal, a large portion (approximately 90 percent) of Nepal’s population does not have access to insurance services, creating a lucrative market for insurers. Besides, the situation is high and dry when it comes to actuaries. Nevertheless, insurance companies are struggling to attract qualified human resources and make an aggressive move in the domestic market. One reason for the low-qualified workforce is the lack of university-level courses in insurance in the country. For example, the absence of a course on actuarial science has resulted in a severe shortage of actuaries for the insurance companies. There are no actuaries in the country, and insurance companies are required to pay high remuneration for foreign actuaries to carry out the actuarial work.

name: Valley College of Technical Sciences
description:
Valley College of Technical Sciences (VCTS) is a health sciences college located in Sitapaila, Kathmandu, Nepal. Established in 2008 AD, VCTS operates through the Department of Public Health and the Department of Pharmacy.

The college is affiliated with Purbanchal University (PU) and offers two four-year undergraduate programs: Bachelor of Public Health (BPH) and Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm). Its academic setting combines classroom study with practical, laboratory, field-based, research, and professional learning components included in the respective university curricula.

The Bachelor of Public Health (BPH) is a four-year program organized across eight semesters.

Its academic areas include public health, epidemiology, family health, nutrition, environmental and occupational health, health education, public health statistics, research, health economics, health management, and field-based practice. The curriculum combines theoretical study with laboratory, classroom, and field-based components across different semesters.

The Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) is a four-year, eight-semester undergraduate program.

The Purbanchal University curriculum carries 168 credits covering theory, practical study, seminars, project work, and professional internship. Major areas include basic sciences, basic medical sciences, pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacognosy, pharmacology, pharmaceutics, hospital and clinical pharmacy, and community pharmacy.

name: Central Department of Nepalese History, Culture and Archaeology | Tribhuvan University
description: Established in 1959 as the Department of Culture, the Department of Nepalese History, Culture, and Archaeology facilitated learning subjects like Philosophy, Religion, and Indian History. The department was again renamed Ancient History, Culture and Archaeology and provided Bachelors (B.A) and Intermediate (I.A) level programs. The Central Department of Nepalese History, Culture and Archaeology, Tribhuvan University today offers Masters level as well as PhD level programs under the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences. The academic program under the department and research projects cover the areas of Culture, Archaeology, Traditional Art, and Architecture along with specialized subjects namely, Numismatics, Museology, Iconography, Paleography, Epigraphy, and Tourism. The students under the department will undertake many cultural projects and will be involved in archaeological excavations in different historical, cultural, and archaeological sites around the country. Students and scholars alike will have the opportunity to explore the communities of Nepal and identify how the cultural and historical factors shape their identity in the process. The students under the department vie for positions in government institutions namely, Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, Department of Archaeology, National Museums. name: Department of Gender Studies: Tribhuvan University
description:
Gender Studies has over the last 20 years raised a palpable feminist consciousness and allowed us to develop a nuanced perspective on gender. In a way, the major objective of the program to produce graduates with perspectives on both gender and feminism – ie. the ability to put women at the center of questions about social structures, and the ability to analyze the relationships between men and women is continuously being achieved.

Masters in Gender Studies was established in July 2009 upscaling the Post Graduate Diploma in Women’s Studies that was running as a one-year degree program since September 1996.It is under the auspice of the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences at Tribhuvan University.

Masters in Gender Studies was established in July 2009 upscaling the Post Graduate Diploma in Women’s Studies that was running as a one-year degree program since September 1996.It is under the auspice of the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences at Tribhuvan University.

Gender Studies focuses on complex interplay of gender with other social, political, cultural, and economic identity markers to answer important questions that exist in politics, society, and economics. Gender Studies emerged in response to those unsolved, partial answers to social problems that were brought forward by various disciplines. Since it incorporates issues and questions from various disciplines that pertain to gender, the program is intensely interdisciplinary.

Women’s Studies as an academic program is gradually gaining a foothold in Nepali academia. In 2009, Gender Studies was introduced as a formal two-year Master’s program for the first time in the country.

Gender discourse in academia started long before Women’s Studies was introduced in Nepal in 1996.There is a link between the emergence of feminist consciousness among some Nepali women and the institutionalizing of gender discourse in academia. Before 1950, feminist consciousness was largely limited to individual levels. Therefore, individual women like YogmayaNeupana, Yogmaya Koirala and Chandra Kanta advocated for women’s right to education. During the later phase of the Rana regime, however, women started to raise voices collectively against discrimination.

As an autonomous entity under the Institute of Medicine, CDPH now oversees admissions and the teaching of the Bachelor of Public Health (BPH), Master of Public Health (MPH), Master in Health Promotion and Education (MHPE), Master in Public Health Nutrition (MPHN), and PhD in Public Health programs. The management of the library in this campus is not satisfactory. Although it has very golden history, however, there are not sufficient reference books and materials at present. There are a total of 56,358 books and some numbers of journals, magazines, theses in the campus library. Due to lack of skilled manpower and various reasons, challenges have also arisen in the management of textbooks and reference books. The number of textbooks and reference books is being added on the basis of number and needs of students. When the curriculum is changed, there is a situation where the old books do not work and it is difficult to manage the new books. However, the campus is trying to manage the students as much as possible.

The campus runs different academic programmes and administrative tasks from the Main Building at Lahare Pipal.  Campus in Lahare Pipal area is at the heart of Tansen. Lahare Pipal Campus area includes, six buildings with one Conference hall The campus is rich in land holding and spacious environment. There are different indoor and outdoor sports facilities in the college area for the students.

name: PAHS School of Nursing  (Lalitpur Nursing Campus)
description: Patan Academy of Health Sciences School of Nursing, formerly known as Lalitpur Nursing Campus (LNC), was established in 1959 and became independent from United Mission to Nepal (UMN) in January 2004. LNC is an institute with a mandate to work towards developing compassionate and competent professional nurses to meet the health needs of the entire Nepalese people.In 1959, LNC was established by UMN to prepare professional nurses for the former Shanta Bhawan Hospital. At that time LNC was called as Shanta Bhawan Nursing School. In 1972 when HMG introduced the new education system in the country, all the higher educational institutions came under the Tribhuvan University (TU.). Thus, this campus also academically came under and became a part of T.U., Institute of Medicine (IOM). Then, LNC was affiliated with TU, IOM for academic activities, and management, as well as finance, remained under UMN. With the successful program of LNC, the LNC Board of Directors was established in December 2003. The present status of the LNC is a constituent of TU, IOM. The Board of Directors is responsible for the management and financial aspects and the academic policy implemented through TU, IOM, as before. The graduates of LNC are serving in various healthcare sectors all over the world. name: College of Natural Resource and Management-Tikapur
description: College of Natural Resource Management, Tikapur, Kailali (CNRM) is the newly established constituent college of Agriculture and Forestry University (AFU) under Faculty of Agriculture (FOA), Rampur, Chitwan. The CNRM was approved by the special Senate meeting of AFU was held on 18th April 2017 in the chair presided by Rt. Hon. Prime Minister and Chancellor Mr. Puspa Kamal Dahal of AFU as Constituent College. The college is situated in Tikapur, which is the renowned in the country for a well-planned specious city. This city is located in Kailali district of Province No. 7 and it is 620 km away in the west from the Union Capital Kathmandu, 14 km in south from national highway Mahendra Rajmarg and 14 km north from India. It is surrounded by Karnali River in East, Janaki Rural Municipality in North, India in South and Bhajani Municipality in West. Approx. 122.12 sq.km. land range comes under the Tikapur Municipality. As per the Census (2011 A.D) total population 76,114 (36,245 Male and 39,869 Female) residing in this city. The climate is normal during spring, hot during summer and cold during winter season. The total students are 52 including 10 girls. Currently, College of Natural Resource Management, Tikapur, Kailali (CNRM) is running under the premises of Birendra Bidya Mandir Multiple Campus (BMC), Tikapur, Kailali. The Total spaces of 4 rooms are contributed by this BMC where office, laboratory, classroom and library facilities are accommodating. Currently, college is in establishment phase facing many constraints in terms of financial, physical and human resources. At this stage support in any form by any of the local, national and international organisation will be highly commendable.

name: School of Public Health  |  Karnali Academy of Health Sciences
description:
Karnali Academy of Health Sciences (KAHS)  has been established in October 20, 2011 (2068/07/03), by an Act of parliament of Nepal by upgrading existing Karnali Zonal Hospital at Jumla. The goal of KAHS is to enable an access in Quality healthcare services and education for the people of backward (Pichhadiyako) areas in affordable cost by establishing health institute at Jumla and KAHS working district to produce skilled health professionals to deliver quality health care services and conduct health researches. The backward areas (9 districts) mentioned in act of KAHS are  Karnali Zone : Humla, Jumla, Kalikot, Dolpa, Mugu districts,  Bheri Zone : Jajarkot district,  Seti Zone : Bajura, Bajhang & Achham districts and remaining districts of  Karnali Pradesh  Includes Surkhet, Dailekh, Rukum and Salyan according to federal system of Nepal.

The Nepal government owned Karnali Zonal hospital and started its services as  Karnali Academy of Health Sciences, Teaching hospital  from 17th Kartik, 2069. From the very beginning the teaching hospital has started outpatient, inpatients, diagnostic services (Lab, X-ray, USG, ECG etc) and operation theatre in existed facility. The services have been upgraded and expanded its scope of services in health care and academy each year.

There are 10 districts (Jumla, Dolpa, Humla, Mugu, Kalikot, Rukum-west, Jajarkot, Salyan and Surkeht) in Karnali Province. Karnali is the largest province of  Nepal  with an area of 24,453 km2 (% of total area). The population of the province is 1,701,800, (% of total population) which is least in ranking of province. The province is surrounded by  Gandaki  province in east,  Province No. 5  in south-east, and south, province No. 7 is in west and  China  in north.

There is high mountains land in north and mid hills. There is a Kubi Gangri, Changla and Kanjiroba Mountain in north. The  Shey Phoksundo National Park  with  Phoksundo lake  is the largest national park of Nepal and  Rara lake  is the largest lake of Nepal which are located in Karnali Pradesh.  Karnali River  is the biggest river of the province and longest river of Nepal. 

Karnali Academy of Health Sciences prepares the next generation of health professionals and leaders to become vital contributors to the delivery and advancement of health care to those who are marginalized and living in backward areas. Our mission is accomplished through educational excellence, innovative research, evidence-informed patient-centered care, public health advocacy, and collaborative community engagement.

KAHS is an autonomous health sciences university that visualize at providing interdisciplinary leadership for new directions in health promotion and wellness, as well as illness care and disease prevention at all levels, in the community and beyond through innovation in education, practice, research, and scholarship for Nepalese students, especially targeting to those who reside in backward and rural area as well as those who are socially marginalized. It will be a national centre for providing health services, prestigious centre for biomedical and health system research, centre for excellence in implementing complete total human development through \\\'health\\\' as main agenda in its neighboring teaching districts.

name: Birgunj Public College
description:
Birgunj Public College (BPC), established in 2057 BS, is a well-known management college located in Panitanki, Birgunj-9, Parsa. It provides quality education from +2 to master’s level, offering programs like BBS, BBA, BITM, MBS, and MBA. BPC focuses on academic excellence, leadership development, and modern, practical learning.BPC initially offered only plus-two in Management. Today, it has expanded its program from a bachelor's degree, BBA, BBS, BITM, and BIT, to a master's degree, MBA, and MBS. It offers BBS, BITM, and MBS in affiliation with Tribhuvan University and BBA, MBA, and BIT in affiliation with Purbanchal University. Additionally, it offers a professional management course-ACCA, designed to equip students with the skills necessary for a competitive global market.BPC is committed to producing sound academic human resources to meet the needs and expectations of society and the nation as well. The dedicated and devoted faculty members, the cooperative administrative staff, and the conscious management committee have made this institution a center of excellence in imparting quality education to young minds who envision a better world. BPC is committed to upholding its ideal, “Teaching is not a Profession but a Mission,” for the overall enhancement of learners who are the nation's future assets. With such hope and confidence, BPC has its own premises built at Panitanki, Birgunj for MBA, BBA, MBS, BBS, and for the Plus Two programs, it has expanded its wing at Kanya Vidyalaya Bhawan. BPC is also planning to get its own premises built for Plus-Two in the near future.MissionAt BPC, the mission is to develop principled and insightful leaders who can transform organizations and the society we live in, through innovative education, research, and networking.ValuesBPC is guided by core values that guide its mission. It promotes integrity, excellence, and respect for individual and intellectual differences. Embracing diversity and inclusiveness, BPC fosters a supportive learning environment. With a global outlook, the college prepares students to succeed in a connected and evolving world.

Strengthen ties with national and international institutions, as well as undertake collaborative and participatory research, workshops, and seminars. Develop the college into a center of academic excellence in order to promote long-term economic viability and mutual respect among people of all ethnic and socioeconomic backgrounds.

name: NATHM-Bardibas
description: In 1972, the Nepal Academy of Tourism and Hotel Management (NATHM) was established by the Government of Nepal, originally known as the Hotel Management and Tourism Training Centre (HMTTC), with the assistance of UNDP and ILO. The main goal was to generate a skilled workforce to cater to the developing tourism and hospitality sector in Nepal. NATHM introduced the first-ever Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM) program in Nepal in 1999, and subsequently, the institution was renamed NATHM. In 2003, the academy launched the Bachelor of Travel and Tourism Management (BTTM) program, and in 2011, recognizing the demand for highly skilled professionals in the rapidly growing tourism and hospitality industry, it introduced the Master of Hospitality Management program.NATHM is affiliated with Tribhuvan University for all of its academic programs. In addition to offering undergraduate and graduate programs, NATHM also provides numerous short-term training courses in tourism and hospitality, such as Tourist Guide, Trekking Guide, River Guide, Food Production, Food and Beverage Service, and Barista training.NATHM not only provides in-house training but also conducts mobile outreach training courses on Homestay Management, Local Guide, Small Hotel and lodge Management, among others, throughout Nepal.Due to the high demand for these courses, NATHM has decided to establish branches in all seven provinces of Nepal starting from 2020. Currently, three branches have already commenced their operations in Birtamod of province number one, Bardibas of province number two, and Nepalgunj of Lumbini Province. This expansion of NATHM is expected to widen its reach and enable a significant portion of the Nepalese population to benefit from the courses offered by the institution.VISIONTo be established as a preferred destination for tourism and hospitality education in the SAARC region.MISSIONNATHM as the pioneer national institution dedicated to human resource development for tourism and hospitality sector in Nepal, will facilitate and produce quality human resources by improving and expanding educational, training and research opportunities. It will thus be a 'Center of Excellence' for national and international students.

Besides, either by browsing through net or simply by sending SMS through cell phones, students can also pull exam notices, exam routines or any other important messages. name: Maharshi Law College
description:
Maharshi Law College, affiliated with Purbanchal University, Nepal, is dedicated to delivering high-quality legal education, preparing students for impactful careers in the legal field. The institution aims to cultivate a new generation of legal thinkers, professionals, and leaders equipped to address the evolving demands of modern law and justice systems, both within Nepal and internationally.Currently, the college provides a comprehensive 5-year integrated BA LLB program, a dual-degree course encompassing a Bachelor of Arts (BA) and a Bachelor of Laws (LLB). This undergraduate program is meticulously designed to establish a strong academic foundation while fostering practical legal skills. Through a well-structured curriculum, students acquire an in-depth understanding of legal reasoning, constitutional principles, human rights, criminal and civil law, and international legal systems. They also develop critical thinking, logical argumentation, and confident presentation skills—abilities crucial for success in any legal profession.In the near future, Maharshi Law College plans to introduce a Master of Laws (LLM) program, in collaboration with The University of Law, a globally recognized institution in legal education. The LLM program is designed to offer advanced legal knowledge and specialization opportunities for graduates seeking to deepen their expertise or pursue academic and research careers.Maharshi Law College is committed to molding its students into future judges, lawyers, legal advisors, academics, human rights defenders, and policy advocates, not only in Nepal but also on the international stage. The college anticipates taking pride in its graduates as they become role models in their communities, making significant contributions to the legal profession, the justice system, and society at large.The college is strategically situated in Kupondole, Lalitpur, a central area within Kathmandu Valley. This prime location offers unparalleled access to Nepal’s major judicial bodies, including the Kathmandu District Court, the High Court at Patan, the Supreme Court of Nepal, and the Special Court. This proximity provides students with exceptional opportunities for internships, court visits, legal aid programs, and practical exposure to real legal proceedings.At Maharshi Law College, the institution is driven by a mission to provide an outstanding academic environment led by a team of experienced professors, practicing lawyers, and legal scholars. The college is dedicated to academic excellence, ethical legal practice, and the empowerment of students through knowledge, mentorship, and opportunity.VisionMaharshi Law College envisions becoming a premier center of legal education, research, and innovation in Nepal and beyond.We aspire to nurture a generation of legal professionals who are:Academically Excellent – Equipped with deep legal knowledge and analytical skills.Ethically Grounded – Guided by integrity, fairness, and a strong sense of justice.Socially Responsible – Dedicated to serving society and defending human rights.Globally Competent – Capable of engaging with international legal systems and diverse legal traditions.Innovative Leaders – Prepared to address emerging challenges in law, policy, and governance.MissionMaharshi Law College is committed to providing quality legal education, practical training, and ethical guidance in Nepal and beyond.We strive to prepare a generation of legal professionals who are:Professionally Competent – Skilled in legal reasoning, research, and advocacy.Ethically Responsible – Guided by integrity, fairness, and respect for the rule of law.Socially Conscious – Dedicated to serving society and promoting justice for all.Critical Thinkers – Capable of analyzing complex legal and societal issues with clarity.Lifelong Learners – Adaptable to evolving legal systems, global challenges, and professional growth.

Lumbini Buddhist University (LBU), from the birth place of Gautam Buddha, Lumbini, is an autonomous and public institution of higher learning committed with the mission to educate the people of Nepal and enrich the global learning community through the application of core Buddhist values and to promote the World Peace.

The first World Buddhist Summit held in Lumbini from 30 th November to 2nd December,1998 organized by Lumbini Development Trust, proposed to establish an International Buddhist University in Lumbini, the birthplace of Gautam Buddha, to impart standard education on Buddhist Philosophy, Literature and Culture, etc.. Subsequently the Lumbini Declaration, issued on the concluding day of the Summit, requested the Nepal Government to take immediate action in this direction. Accordingly, Lumbini Development Trust constituted a seven-member Preparatory Committee with Prof. Dr. Tulasi Ram Vaidya as convener and Ven. Sudarshan Mahasthavir, Ven. Ngawang Hoser Lama, Rev. Pt. Badri Ratna Bajracharya, Prof. Mohan Prasad Lohani, Prof. Tri Ratna Manandhar and Mr. Min Bahadur Shakya as members.

The Proposal of establishing Lumbini International Buddhist University was thoroughly discussed in various meetings at different stages to justify the need for establishment of Lumbini International Buddhist University. Eventually a meeting presided over by Hon. Deepa Kumar Upadhyaya, the then Minister of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation formed “Proposed Lumbini International Buddhist University Main Preparatory Committee 2061″ on 3rd Kartik 2061 B.S. with Hon.Bharat Shah, the Member of Parliament as Convener and Prof. Dr. Naresh Man Bajracharya, Expert on subject matter and the then Head of Central Department of Buddhist Studies, Tribhuvan University as Member-Secretary.

Finally, on 14th Marga 2061 B.S. Lumbini Buddhist University was formally established with the promulgation of an Ordinance which was declared on 16th Marga 2061 B.S. at the 2nd World Buddhist Summit held in Lumbini. Subsequently the Main Preparatory Committee meeting held on 23rd Marga 2061 B.S. took six important decisions including renaming of committee as “Lumbini Buddhist University Main Preparatory Committee 2061″ Later in 2062 B.S., the Parliament approved the Ordinance with modifications as Lumbini Bauddha Vishwavidyalaya Ain 2063 (Lumbini Buddhist University Act 2063).

name: National Medical College
description:
“Service to mankind is service to God”. With much excitement with this noble idea, I started my professional career as a Surgeon with the Government Health Sector of Nepal way back in the year 1983. Later on, I established the first Nursing Home in the private sector at Birgunj in the year 1985 as I felt this would give me more opportunities to serve the society much better. During all these days, I have noticed that the health sector in Nepal has been hard hit with the vast deficit of health manpower. Similar situation also prevail in most of our neighboring nations....

I feel greatly honored to hold the position of Principal of this premier Medical College. As a founder faculty member since the inception stage (2001 AD). I am highly delighted to witness the commendable growth of National Medical College as a world class center of Medical & Nursing education and research. Our Institution has unique architectural campus having excellent academic atmosphere. This institute has great commitment to provide top class medical education and quality research to the students with the help of eminent and experienced teachers. We have adequate number of teacher...

I am delighted to extend a warm welcome to each of you to our esteemed National Medical College and Teaching Hospital (NMCBir). As the Managing Director, it is both an honor and a privilege to lead this renowned institution dedicated to excellence in medical education, patient care, and community service. Our Medical College stands as a beacon of learning, innovation, and collaboration. We are committed to nurturing the next generation of healthcare professionals, equipping them with the knowledge, skills, and compassion necessary...

National Medical College was established in the year 2001, promoted by the “National Medical College Company Pvt. Ltd.” under the Chairmanship of Prof. Dr. Jainuddin Ansari, an outstanding surgeon who has earned national and international credentials for the promotion of Medico-Social services. National Medical College is one of the best medical colleges in Nepal, in fact the number one among all medical colleges in terms of infrastructure, academic facilities and modern sophisticated medical equipments.

The attention of National Medical College and Teaching Hospital, Birgunj, has been drawn to the serious allegations and remarks made today in the House of Representatives by the Honorable Member of Parliament, Mr. Rahbar Ansari. In this regard, the college administration clarifies the following points: A Quarter-Century Legacy of Excellence: Operating under the affiliation of Tribhuvan University (TU) since 2001, National Medical College has been delivering quality medical education and healthcare services for nearly 25 years. The institution functions under continuous monitoring and regulatory oversight by authorized bodies, including the Medical Education Commission (MEC), Tribhuvan University, Institute of Medicine (IOM), Nepal Medical Council (NMC), and the Ministry of Health and Population. Rebuttal of Unsubstantiated Claims: To date, no competent regulatory authority or government entity has substantiated or reached any official conclusion confirming the allegations raised by the Honorable Member of Parliament. Commitment to Transparency and Scrutiny: The institution remains fully prepared for any fact-based, impartial, and transparent examination and is committed to providing all necessary records, documentation, and details to the relevant regulatory authorities. Call for Responsible Public Discourse: In sensitive sectors such as medical education and healthcare, public statements should be grounded in verified facts, documentary evidence, and official findings from authorized agencies. Unverified and baseless assertions risk inciting unwarranted confusion, distress, and mistrust among students, parents, physicians, staff, and the patient community. National Medical College and Teaching Hospital reiterates its steadfast dedication to maintaining its institutional heritage, safeguarding the standard of medical education, ensuring high-quality and safe clinical care, protecting student welfare, and strictly adhering to all regulatory guidelines.

Have any complaints or suggestion? Just tell us. We are here to help you with everything.

name: Sahid Narayan Pokharel Ramapur Campus
description: Sahid Narayan Pokharel Ramapur Campus is a leading Public campus situated in the western part of Nepal in Lumbini Zone at Rupandehi district, 17 km west from Butwal and 18 km north from Lumbini, the birth place of Gautam Buddha. It has its own land and buildings in the centre location of Sainamaina, the newly formed historical municipality on the lap of beautiful churia hills near the Eastwest Highway.SNPRC was established in 2060 B.S. under Tribhuwan University with a view to open door to higher education for the students of Rupandehi and neighboring districts. The main aim of SNPRC is to provide access to higher education for the under privileged, marginalized, deprived, indigenous people like Janajati, Madeshi, Dalit etc.It was started with 19 students in small rooms of Ramapur Higher Secondary school. SNPRC has undergone surpassing growth with 675 students and considerable physical facilities at present. It has occupied a prominent place in the educational sphere of the region as well as in the whole country. Its leading programs include BBS, B.Ed. and M.Ed. This campus has been successful in producing competitive academic human resources to compete in national and international sector which proves its excellent academic quality.Mission:The mission of the campus is to provide access to higher education for the people of the surroundings with emphasis to Dalit, Janajati, Women, Madeshi and other marginalized groups. SNPRC aspires to be an accredited institution of higher education through focused efforts on the development of human resources, quality education, physical infrastructure and program extension activities.Vision:Campus will attempt at enhancing the quality of education as per the need of the community, country, and the globe. The campus aims to be a nationally recognized educational institution through sustained efforts towards quality education, emphasis on all-round development of the students and dedication for serving the community.Objectives:To enhance activities to promote quality teaching.To look for resources and initiatives to sustain the campus.To produce moral, diligent, conscious citizens by utilizing the local resources.To encourage a sense of self-disciplined confidence and to develop a multidimensional personality.To produce highly qualified educational manpower in local level in accordance with National policy, plan and need.To provide access to higher education for under -privileged, marginalized, deprived, indigenous people: Madeshi, Women, Dalit and Janajati.To improve teaching -learning process in each and every department and faculty by using high technology and by focusing problem-based learning together with lecture method, group work, project work as per suitability in order to practice students- centered teaching.

name: Vedant College of Management and Technology
description: Vedant College of Management and Technology is a leading academic institution in Nepal, established in 2009, a result of the vision and aspiration of a team of highly qualified and experienced professionals from different sectors of society such as academics, government, and non-government organizations. Vedant College of Management and Technology seeks to bring transformation in Nepali society by developing capable human resources.Vedant College of Management and Technology is dedicated to providing students with a sound and innovative business education that will ensure entrepreneurial and managerial success in tomorrow 's global business environment. It promises to create a powerful and safe learning environment.CreativityAt Vedant College of Management and Technology, students are encouraged to explore their talents and apply their creativity. Students are constantly inspired to promote team based learning and to challenge for creative solution from each other’s talents and support in achieving their academic and career goals through collaborative group works.AchievementVedant College nurtures the culture of results orientation in each individual and encourages students to achieve excellence in all spheres. All students are given the opportunity to be achievers in every way as they are with extensive coaching and counseling sessions.Moral ValuesDiscipline, honesty, sincerity, respect and care for others are the core values of Vedant College of Management and Technology. Values for academic achievements are important and so are the values of good character. Special recognition is given to those who have demonstrated qualities of good character.Action OrientationVedant College of Management and Technology advocates for activity-based learning. Students are engaged in various activities which help them develop their self-confidence. This ultimately enables them to participate constructively in social services and welfare activities.DevelopmentIn response to ever changing development paradigms and challenges, students are familiarized with contemporary development issues and help them debate on such issues. They are also encouraged to participate in contributing to address emerging development needs.Vision of Vedant College CollegeVedant College of Management and Technology envisions to contribute to the nation's development by transforming the college into an epitome of quality education through its academic and professional excellence in management, entrepreneurship, and leadership.Mission of Vedant CollegeTo offer competitive and value-based education that stimulates the students to strive towards achieving excellence in their chosen field of expertise.ObjectivesTo impart quality and sound education in a congenial atmosphere with the state of the art teaching methodologies.To equip students with the profound knowledge that establishes a direct link with the real-world situation.To spark a zest of curiosity in the future stars of the nation.

The Theravada Buddhist Academy (TBA) was established under the auspicious leadership of the most Venerable Dr. Bhikshu Jñanapurnika. It is an independent entity incorporated under the umbrella of the Vishwa Shanti Vihar. Theravada Buddhist Academy is the only institution, which supports systematic promotion and preservation of Theravada Buddhism, its culture and heritage through education, research and various other activities like workshops, conferences, meditation courses etc. it also works towards creating mutual understanding and cooperation between Theravada, Mahayana and Vajrayana traditions of Buddhism. TBA offer two academic degrees in affiliation with Lumbini Buddhist University. They are a) M. A. in Theravada Buddhism and b) M. A. in Pāli Buddhist Studies. The course duration is two years in four semester. TBA is recently registered under Company Act 2063 as profits not distributing company in Sept. 15, 2021 (30 th Bhadra 2078).

The mission of the Theravada Buddhist Academy is to promote Theravada Buddhism and Pāli Buddhist Studies in Nepal through education and research.

description: Times International College is affiliated with Tribhuvan University. The college offers Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS), Bachelor of Business Management (BBM), Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA), Bachelor of Arts in Social Work (BASW) at the undergraduate level. Similarly, at the graduate level Times International College provides Master of Business Studies (MBS).The society has become so much competitive and globalized. Ordinary learning can’t pave the way of success in today’s world. The college molds the students academically, internationally and above all spiritually to take the bull by the horns for their mesmerizing future and career. The college does not provide them only with theoretical aspects, but also gives more priority to their practically, taking them to the field visit, conducting seminar, conference, symposium and course related workshops along with non-credit courses for their leadership and personality development. As educationist not only for the students, about also for the economic growth of the country ensuring the “Dignity and Image” of the nation, so students should be molded and nurtured in such a way that ascertains both the scientific as well as humanistic mentioned vision, the college welcomes all those students/guardians/professionals to step at the promises of college.MissionTo make learning process applied, spontaneous and career –oriented to equip each student to be competent enough so as to excel in the global arena. name: ​Lumbini International Academy of Science and Technology
description: Lumbini International Academy of Science and Technology (LIAST) is affiliated to Lumbini Buddhist University and is offering MSc in Construction Engineering and Management, MSc in Structural Engineering and MSc in Disaster Risk Engineering and Management programs. MissionLIAST aims to provide the qualitative engineering education to all over Nepal. Therefore, it has initiated new trend of live streaming of the class, so no students are left out and can attend the classes from any part of the globe. LIAST aims to facilitate each student so that they don’t miss a single lecture. Since at the master’s degree majority are already job holder not disturbing their professional life LIAST operates class at late evening- after office hour. At LIAST College we foster academic and career success through the development of critical thinking, effective communication, creativity, and cultural awareness in a safe, accessible and affordable learning environment that led to successful completion of degree.VisionLIAST college is driven to provide excellent educational opportunities in every corner of the country that are responsive to the needs of our students, and empower them to meet and exceed challenges as active participants in shaping the future of our world.

name: Shanishchare Multiple Campus
description: Shanishchare Multiple Campus is community owned campus located in Shanishchare, Jhapa. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and approved by University Grants Commission of Nepal. It offers four years’ full time bachelor degree programs in Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) and Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.).

name: Nihareeka College of Management and IT
description: Nihareeka College, affiliated to Tribhuvan University, was established in 2013 A.D. and promoted by a group of experienced and dedicated academicians and management professionals. Nihareeka College is located at Bargachhi, Biratnagar. It offers Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) and Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (B.Sc CSIT), BHM, BITM, BCA, and MBS programs with affiliation from Tribhuvan University.The goal of the college is to provide a high-quality education that enables students to embrace the challenges of the modern world. The college places a strong emphasis on management and information technology in its academic pursuits, complemented by experimental and experiential learning.Apart from academic activities, Nihareeka College is also involved in software development, system administration, and Network Management. Nihareeka College has established organizational tie-ups with various software companies, banks, IT consultancies, and manufacturing industries to provide a platform for internships and job placement opportunities.

name: Pokhara Nursing Campus
description: Pokhara Nursing Campus is an esteemed educational institution dedicated to shaping the future of nursing professionals in Nepal. Established in 1982, Pokhara Nursing Campus is situated at the heart of Pokhara Metropolitan City, Kaski, Gandaki Province, and is a constituent campus of the Institute of Medicine (IOM) at Tribhuvan University (TU).Over the years, the campus has become a pioneer in nursing education, offering a range of academic programs and achieving remarkable success in quality education and infrastructural development.Pokhara Nursing Campus prioritizes excellence in nursing education, providing a strong foundation for young Nepalese women and men entering the nursing profession. Its comprehensive academic programs include the Bachelor of Nursing Science (BNS), Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Nursing, and Master of Nursing (MN) programs. With a specialization in Adult Health Nursing, Women's Health and Development, and Child Health Nursing in its Master's program, the campus ensures that its students receive specialized knowledge and practical skills to meet the profession's demands.The institution takes pride in its track record of producing competent and efficient nursing professionals who contribute to the healthcare sector in Nepal and beyond. Its graduates, numbering around 1700, serve in various government, private health sectors, and NGOs/INGOs, making a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals and communities.To create an enriching and exciting learning environment, the campus offers state-of-the-art facilities, including a well-stocked library, modern laboratories, multimedia-equipped classrooms, a computer lab, and a video conferencing room. Practical exposure is crucial to its programs, ensuring students develop the necessary skills and experience to excel in their future careers.The campus is dedicated to upholding the highest educational standards and providing its students with outstanding facilities. Its dedicated faculty, administrative and supporting staff, and parents have placed their trust and belief in the institution, and the campus is grateful for their support.Prospective students are invited to join Pokhara Nursing Campus and embark on a rewarding journey in the noble nursing profession. With the proper training, orientation, and supervision, its students will become highly qualified and motivated professionals who can tackle the healthcare industry's challenges. The campus strives to build a future where quality nursing practice thrives and its graduates succeed.

name: Nepalaya College
address: Ganeshman Singh Path, Kalanki, Nagarjun, Kathmandu
description: Established in 1999 during the early development of Nepal's modern higher secondary education system, Nepalaya College was founded with the mission to provide globally recognized education to local learners. Over the years, it has evolved into a prominent educational institution in Nepal, continually striving to become a global center of learning. The college currently operates across four buildings, housing nearly eighty well-equipped classrooms to serve its diverse student body.Nepalaya College upholds the principles of equality and diversity in education. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU). The college provides specialized and elective courses designed to meet the unique needs and interests of students.At the undergraduate level, the college offers BSc in Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc CSIT), Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA), Bachelor of Business Management (BBM), and Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS), all in affiliation with Tribhuvan University (TU). Additionally, Nepalaya College offers a Master's program in Business Studies (MBS), also affiliated with Tribhuvan University. MissionModeling Nepalaya as a practical-based learning institute.VisionFounding Nepalaya as a global school in future.MottoPreparing students for success.

name: Himalaya Darshan College

Himalaya Darshan College offers unique opportunities in a highly intellectual setting. The College was founded with the goal of promoting high-quality, value-based education at the graduate level. Through its seasoned and recognized faculty, specialists, and professionals from across the country, the college encourages students' personal and professional growth. The Institution seeks to provide high-quality, competitive education in order to satisfy the aspirations of young people and the difficulties of the new millennium. and offers a modern value-based curriculum in five degree-granting programs that are divided into three areas: science, management, and humanities.

name: College of Applied Business and Technology
description: The College of Applied Business and Technology, affiliated with Tribhuvan University, is a renowned educational institution located in Gangahity, Chabahil, Kathmandu. It was founded in 1998 by a group of academic experts, which aims to provide a quality education at an affordable fee that helps students face the challenges of the market.The college offers various courses at the bachelor level focusing on programs such as Bachelor of Information Technology Management (BITM), Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), and Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc.CSIT). It is renowned for its unique teaching methodology, featuring 2-hour classes where one hour is dedicated to self-learning and engaging discussions that encourage student research and dialogue.In addition, the college offers practical exposure through field visits on Mondays and presentations on Thursdays, enhancing students' hands-on experience.Under the leadership of Mr. Ramesh Pandey, who is the college principal, College of Applied Business and Technology has grown its programs over the years. They started with the BBS program and later added the BITM course after three years. In 2003, they also introduced the popular BBA program.In 2011, the college expanded its offerings again by adding the BSc.CSIT program, which shows that the college is dedicated to providing education in different and vital fields of study. Right now, the college offers three programs: BBA, BITM, and BSc.CSIT.The college regularly organizes seminars, research, and observation tours which help the individuals enhance their knowledge and personality. Currently, the College of Applied Business has signed the TCA (Transfer Credit Agreement) with State University of New York (SUNY) which provides a new opportunity to its students who desire to transfer to The State University of New York at Plattsburgh to get US education up to 60 Cr/HrFurthermore, the College of Applied Business and Technology emphasizes the importance of extracurricular activities to enhance students' skills in various areas. These activities help foster a well-rounded education, preparing students for a successful career and contribution on both national and international scales. Graduates from the College of Applied Business & Technology have made significant contributions in their respective fields globally, showcasing the effectiveness of the college's programs and the quality of education they provide.MissionThe mission of College of Applied Business is to empower the youth with truth, knowledge and realities of life and help discover ways to lead a prosperous life in a dignified manner.GoalsMaking students feel that they share the values and responsibilities in educational process as members of the learner community.Encouraging admission on an equal opportunity basis to competent students motivated to strive for academic excellence.Fostering an environment sensitive to the needs of all students and providing facilities that assist students in achieving academic and professional excellence.Providing instructions and conducting research in the areas of business, management and professional field.

name: Jaya Multiple Campus
description: Jaya Multiple Campus is located in Jorpati, Kathmandu. The college offers BBS and BA/BSW program in affiliation with Tribhuvan University, Nepal. The campus was established in 2064 B.S. The campus is purely a non-profit co-educational institution which has adopted a policy to provide secondary, Bachelor and Master level education at moderate expense with the aim to cover every socio-economic class student in and around the community.A group of deeply committed scholars, much encouraged with the aim of academic excellence is what drives the Jaya Multiple Campus. The campus always strives to create opportunities for the quality education at best possible expense. To meet the growing demand of 21st century education, merely the designed course cannot quench the thirst of the students. In this regard, Jaya Multiple Campus encourages students for Extra Curricular Activities, Sports, and an access to Global range information. It inspires students for active participation in every academic or other activity, which may help them unveil their hidden talents. Jaya Multiple Campus has a dedicated academic team whose wholeheartedness and continuous effort has lead the college to attain its targeted success from the very beginning session with excellent result. Vision:Jaya Multiple Campus envisions to deliver outstanding academic programs in different streams; enabling students to transform their lives and shape their own future. It wants to prepare students to be professional, skilled individuals be-fitted for the modern world, committed to lifelong learning and able to contribute to the communities in which they live and work. It places a high value on developing a mature approach to learning in which students are encouraged to challenge conventional wisdom, handle complexity and benefit from difference and diversity. It wants to contribute to society through the pursuit of education at the highest level of excellence.Aims:To impart quality education to the students.To help the students explore the solution to the difficulties themselves.To increase confidence and the power of reasoning.To encourage the sense of self-discipline, self-reliance and self-motivation.To develop outstanding personality enabling themselves to recognize the norms and values of humble life.To create awareness and sense of responsibility so as to make them understand the duty of a decent citizen.To foster 5Cs- Character, Commitment, Conviction, Courtesy and Courage.To mature to cope with the scientific challenges and to keep up to date with all the changes.To build up the sense of co-operation and tolerance among the students to run more practical classes.To develop a multipurpose institution of fully fledged and standard education.To cater education in reasonable fee structure or affordable education.To conduct research work with the co-operation and co-ordination of different national and foreign institutions.To manage classes according to the need, interest, ability and aptitude of the students.To conduct different extra-curricular activities to boost up their academic excellence.To find the innate capability of the students by providing congenial atmosphere.To mold competitive, qualified and skilled citizens having the abundance of intellectual and vocational insight and skill.

सिद्धेश्वर शिक्षा पब्लिक क्याम्पस बागमती प्रदेशको सुदूर उत्तरपूर्व रामेछाप जिल्लाको अन्तिम बस्ती उमाकुण्ड २ बाम्तीभण्डारमा स्थापित र सञ्चालित सामुदायिक क्याम्पस हो । यस क्याम्पसको स्थापना वि.सं. २०६३ सालमा भएको हो । हिमाली जिल्ला रामेछापको पनि अति विकट हिमाली क्षेत्र (२१५० मिटर उचाई) को उमाकुण्ड गाउँपालिकामा उच्च शिक्षा प्रदान गर्ने एकमात्र समुदायबाट सञ्चालित र जिल्ला सदरमुकामबाट ८० कि.मि. टाढा रहेको क्याम्पस हो ।

क्याम्पस स्थापनाको दुई दशक पुरा गरिसकेको यस क्याम्पसबाट हालसम्म सयौँको संख्यामा स्नातक गरिसकेको अवस्था छ । पछिल्ला वर्षमा विविध कारणबाट विद्यार्थी संख्या घटिरहेको छ भने बिचैमा पढाई छाडेर पलायन हुने दर पनि बढिरहेको छ । सुविधा सम्पन्न ठाउँमा अध्ययन गर्न नसक्ने आर्थिक अवस्था कमजोर रहेका महिला, गृहिणी, सिमान्तकृत, पिछडिएका, आर्थिक सामाजिक रुपमा पछाडि परेका विद्यार्थीहरुकै क्याम्पसमा बाहुल्यता रहेको छ । स्थापनाकाल देखि नै त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय शिक्षाशास्त्र संकायबाट सम्बन्धन प्राप्त गरी अंग्रेजी, नेपाली, अर्थशास्त्र, जनसंख्या मेजर विषय तथा स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा माइनर विषयमा अध्यापन गर्दै आइरहेको छ । योग्यता पुगेका अनुभवी विषयगत शिक्षकले नै पाठ्यक्रममा तोकिएको र अन्य शृजनशील छलफल विधिबाट आवश्यकता अनुसार परियोजना कार्य, प्रयोगात्मक अभ्यास, खोजविधि आदि समेत प्रयोग गरी अध्यापन गरिआएको अवस्था छ । स्थापना कालमा सिद्धेश्वर मा.वि.का कक्षा कोठा, फर्निचर्स तथा भौतिक पूर्वाधार प्रयोग गरी शैक्षिक क्रियाकलाप तथा अध्ययन अध्यापन गर्दै आएकोमा २०७२ सालको भूकम्प पछि उमाकुण्ड २ सोतर्मूमा आफ्नै सुविधा सम्पन्न तिनतले २० वटा कोठा रहेको पक्की भवन निर्माण भई सोही भवनमा पठनपाठन हुँदै आएको छ । त्यसैगरी क्याम्पसको नाममा १० रोपनी जग्गा प्राप्त भइसकेको छ भने ठूलो कम्पाउण्ड घेराबार, गेट, खेलमैदान लगायतले क्याम्पस सुविधा सम्पन्न छ । पर्याप्त उच्च गुणस्तरका फर्निचर्सहरु पुस्तकालय कम्प्युटर तथा आवश्यकता अनुसार अन्य उपकरण, पानी, बत्ती, इन्टरनेट, पुस्तकहरु, सन्दर्भसामग्रीहरु क्याम्पसमा मौजुदा रहेको छन् ।

name: International Center for Academics
description: International Center for Academics (ICA), located in Sinamangal, Kathmandu, is an award-winning center recognized by Indira Gandhi National Open University as the Best Overseas Partner Institution in 2011, 2013, and 2014. It is also the recipient of the Best Distance Education B School of Nepal 2013. Established in 1997, ICA has been providing educational services to the nation for more than two decades.In 2002, ICA became the first Overseas Study Center of Indira Gandhi National Open University in Nepal. It is among the pioneer institutions of blended learning in Nepal and is approved by the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology, Government of Nepal.ICA currently offers eight academic, value-added, and awareness programs through the Open and Distance Learning mode. These programs cover Management, Humanities and Social Science, Tourism, Computer Science, and other disciplines. Learners at ICA include fresh graduates and working professionals from fields such as the hospitality industry, financial institutions, telecommunications, corporate houses, embassies, and diplomatic agencies.The institution provides learners with a unique opportunity to study and work simultaneously. Thousands of students have completed graduation, undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and certificate-level programs from ICA. Supported by qualified faculty members and dedicated staff, ICA consistently maintains a high student success rate.Several ICA learners have been recognized nationally and internationally. Three learners, Gagan Gurung, Kirtan Shrestha, and Chahana Singh, have received the Nepal Bidhya Bhusan Award. Eleven learners have received the IGNOU Gold Medal in Management, Tourism Studies, Computer Science, Health Science, Sociology, and Rural Development. IGNOU degrees awarded through ICA are recognized by all major universities in Nepal, including Tribhuvan University, and are accepted by government, non-government, and corporate institutions across the country.Objectives of ICATo impart quality education at affordable ratesTo provide flexible and individualized learningTo provide a platform for those who missed the opportunity to further their educationTo introduce the latest global trends in education in NepalTo promote blended learning in NepalTo develop skilled human resources in various sectors of NepalExaminationsExaminations are conducted by IGNOU through ICA under the supervision of the Embassy of India.Academic SessionJanuary Cycle: January to JuneJuly Cycle: July to December

description: Central Department of Anthropology (CDA) is located on the premises of University Campus, Kirtipur Kathmandu. name: Upendra Devkota Memorial National Institute of Neurological and Allied Sciences
description: The motto of National Institute of Neurological and Allied Sciences is preventing paralysis and disabilities through timely effective treatment for neurological disorders, which are perhaps the least understood but the most devastating medical problems. A patient with potentially paralyzing or life threatening ailment of the brain or the spinal cord can recover completely and return to the society as a productive member if effective treatment is offered in time; if the same treatment was offered late or offered sub-optimally, would survive with disability or die. Population based studies in the developed countries project the annual requirement for Nepal of neurological consultations of approximately 1.5 million, and that for neurosurgical procedures to be about 25,000. Dismayingly though, the existing facilities in the country, have been able to address less than 10% of this need. Vast majority are therefore currently being left to suffer, get paralysed or seek expensive treatment outside the country. The goal of the National Institute of Neurological and Allied Sciences is thus, to contribute towards meeting this shortage in services. This centre provides quality neurological services based on the appropriateness of the technology to the socio-economic realities; contribute towards the training of required technical human resource, including neuroscientists; conduct research relevant to the needs of the region, and recommend appropriate evidence based interventions. Prof. Upendra Devkota is noted to have used his advanced training in the most renowned Neurological Institutes in Glasgow and London, to translate its scientific essence and quality to the local socio economic realities by innovative and ingenious technology. This institute will be instrumental in realising his vision of regional collaboration in all the three facets of neurosciences- service, training and research as expressed by him as the Founder President of the SAARC Neurosurgical Society; and make a mark outside the region as well. Contact Address National Institute of Neurological and Allied Sciences Bansbari, Kathmandu Fax: 01- 4370779 P.O. Box No. 3711

Mission: The mission of this YHSA is to create and maintain a learning environment that fosters critical thinking, the acquisition of knowledge, and the development of ongoing professional skills which are necessary for our graduates to become superior health professionals. The YHSA will provide learners with tools for success through: Student-centered Professional Education Recognition and Respect for Diversity of Thought Interdisciplinary Collaboration with Professionals in the Global Community Emphasis on Scholarly Teaching, Practice, Scientific Inquiry and Service Ethical Professional Practice and an appreciation for continuous Life-long Learning Vision: The vision of this YHSA is to develop it as a Center of Excellency for the Academic Programs on Health Sciences that produces world class Health Professional aiming at serving human beings at large. Goal: The ultimate goal of this academic institution is to produce the graduates who are qualified and well prepared to work efficiently in the assigned area and cope with the challenging environment in the growing world. Objectives: The college of Health sciences is committed to ensuring that graduates are well prepared to successfully work and lead in this growing and challenging environment. The objectives of YHSA are: To provide quality education in an academic environment by providing excellent faculty and state of the art instruments and equipment To make students excellent in their field of study To prepare students to face new challenges of the century to create an environment that enhances each student's potential and encourages ethical behavior To make them use their knowledge in real life situations To live, lead and serve the country To promote the capabilities of the students in non-curricular fields too, so that there is a balanced all round development of their personalities To have strong interactions with hospitals and other health care teams and regulatory authorities To make students responsible citizens Strategies: In order to achieve the defined goals and objectives, Yeti Health and Science Academy adopted following strategies: Set up student-centered educational environment. Motivate for continuous learning.

description: Dillibazar Kanya Multiple Campus, established in the year 2037 B.S. is a public girl’s campus, founded by some of the renowned social workers, academicians and professional like Late Kamala Devi Rana, Late Ishwor Raj Aryal, Prof. Dr. Pathiweshwor Timalsina, Dr. Pratibha Basnet and several other well known personalities. Since its inception, this kanya campus is providing quality education at affordable fees to aspiring students. The college had a humble beginning with just 17 students, 7 teachers, and a single academic program (I.A). Currently, Dillibazar Kanya Campus has more than 2000 students, 70 teachers, and 16 administrative staffs, and is running Intermediate, Bachelors and Masters level programs in Humanities, Management and Education. Dillibazar Kanya Campus is renowned for its conducive environment that creates the best setting for teaching-learning process. Despite the problems evident in the university education in the country due to a number of reasons for the past few years, DKMC has been successful in keeping itself intact from the problems and has maintained exceptionally regular classes by a highly qualified and experienced faculty. The result of this Kanya Campus is among the best under Tribhuvan University and nearly a dozen of our students have created a history by being toppers in the TU Board Exams.

name: School of Medicine | Patan Academy of Health Sciences
description: Patan Academy of Health Sciences (PAHS) is an autonomous, not-for-profit, public institution of higher education established in 2064 B.S. (2008 A.D.) with the charter granted by the Parliament of Nepal. PAHS aims to work in close partnership with the national health system to improve the health care services in the remote/rural areas primarily through producing technically competent and socially responsible health care workers. In order to achieve this goal, PAHS School of Medicine has adopted innovative strategies in medical education, especially in areas such as student selection, curriculum, teaching-learning methodology, student assessment and faculty recruitment. PAHS MBBS curriculum focuses on holistic care of individual and community. Patan Academy of Health Sciences (PAHS) offeres different programs in medicine namely Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS), MD in General Practice and Emergency Medicine (MDGP), MD in Internal Medicine, MD in Obstetrics Gynaecology, MD in Pediatrics, MD in Psychiatry, MD in Radiology and Imaging, MS in General surgery, MS in Orthopedics, and MS in Otorhinolaryngology (ENT). For inspiring its graduates to serve in remote/rural areas of Nepal, PAHS has adopted a multi -pronged approach which includes preferential enrollment of students of rural origin, training them in a value based curriculum with emphasis on community health sciences and exposing them to rural health care institutions. It also aims to provide continuous support to the graduates while working in the rural areas. By helping them to acquire required competencies and instilling values of social responsibility in its graduates, PAHS intends to inspire/motivate and enable its graduates to become health care providers in the challenging settings of rural Nepal, as well as to become future leaders of Nepal‟s health care system. Patan Hospital, the 450 bedded tertiary care institution, upon which the PAHS is founded, provides natural ambiance for learning holistic and compassionate care. Its history of more than 25 years (more than 50 years if one takes into account its mother institution of Shanta Bhawan) provides the basis for this. PAHS has already built a rich network with prestigious academic institutions and leaders in many universities around the world so as to learn and benefit from the national as well as international experiences and best practices for the proper development, effective implementation and the continuous improvement of the quality of its academic programs.

It is affiliated to Tribhuvan University to achieve our common goal. “ Darkness onto Light.” Bachelor programs is running at the morning from these session we are going to run the BBS in evening shift too. The primary aim of Cambridge International College is to prepare higher, middle and junior level human resource to meet the needs of business industry, schools, academic sectors, social works, volunteer works as well as government in different functional areas of management, humanities and education. CIC’S programs aim to facilitate the students to work as proficient managers in the competitive environment. The students will be able to work as officers, assistant in business industry, school, INGO, NGO’s government and non-government sectors in areas like accounting, marketing, general management, hotel management, computer science, travel and tourism social educational sectors and so on. Education Objectives: To provide the quality education through practical needs To provide new and scientific programs for the study intellectually and emotionally with his/her maximum potentially To develop social awareness and good leadership To integrate all of the subject areas into the learning process To prepare students to face challenges of the 21st century To produce skilled manpower for handling administrative and managerial job for private as well as government organization

To achieve the objective, Nepal Law Campus is running after graduation a three year Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.), a five year Bachelor of Arts Bachelor of Laws (B.A.LL.B.) and a two year Master of Laws (LL.M.) programmes. name: Birendra Bidhya Mandir Campus
description:
Birendra Bidhya Mandir Campus(BMC) is a QAA certified Trubhuvan University(TU) affiliated community campus established in 2063 B.S.(2006 AD). It is a non-profit making institution established as a higher educational wing of Biredra Vidhya Mandir Public Educational Trust(BVMPET) as the foundation of TIkapur city which was established in 2031 B.S.(1975 AD) as Tikapur Aawasiya High School. It is a community based public campus established by the collaborative effort of the intellectuals, professionals, academicians, businessmen, politicians, social workers, guardians and the local people. The core aim of the campus is to produce the energetic, capable and competitive manpower having the traits of knowledge with civilization, responsibility and morality through the access of quality education at reasonable and affordable fee.

Birendra Bidhya Mandir Campus is located at the center of Tikapur city with peaceful and educational environment and it lies in the equal distance of 14 Km south from Mahendra Highway(Lamki) and north from Nepal India-Khakraula border. The main catchment area of BMC is Kailiali, Bardiya, Doti, Bajura, Bajhang, Surkhet, Dailekh, Kalikot, Jumla and Darchula districts.

BMC has been running Masters in Education (M.Ed.) and Bachelor in Education(B.Ed.)programmes in faculty of education and Master of Business Studies(MBS) and Bachelor of Business Studies(BBS)prorgramme in faculty of management. It’s a single TU affiliated campus of Tikapur city; it is responsible towards public, society and the nation. A complete academic environment, dedication of all teaching and non teaching staffs and their respect and mutual understandings with moral support and their active participation in different societal programs are some of the typical features of the campus. A complete educational environment with modern educational system including teaching and learning methodology, materials as well as facilities and services are rendered by the campus. Computer lab, filtered pure drinking water, free Wi Fi internet, library, canteen, bicycle stand, power back up, computerized accounting and administrative system, extra-curricular activities, internal test exam, evaluation and feedback, scholarship, educational tour, professional trainings, academic orientation, participation in different sports and other competition, practical examination and other relevant academic activities, facilities and services are available and carried out in the campus.

description: Manamohan Memorial College (MMC), honoring the late Manamohan Adhikari, a prominent national figure, was founded in Kathmandu in 1999 AD with the aim of contributing to the national education system. It stands as a distinguished institution of learning and academic excellence, led by a team of highly qualified, experienced, and dedicated education professionals. MMC, as a co-educational establishment, boasts a faculty of skilled and devoted members who provide quality education to students from across the country, offering programs in Management, Humanities, and Education faculties at reasonable fees under the motto 'Enlightenment Through Education'. Additionally, it offers MBS and M.Ed. programs under the semester system, continually striving to nurture the potential of its students. name: Khwopa Engineering College
description:
Established in 2001 A.D. (2058 B.S.), Khwopa Engineering College (KhEC) is Nepal's first community-based engineering college and is an undertaking of Bhaktapur Municipality. The college was founded with the goal of making Bhaktapur the center of excellence and promoting engineering knowledge in the society. KhEC is dedicated to providing affordable quality education accessible to people from all economic strata.The college offers undergraduate programs in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Computer Engineering, and Electronics and Communication Engineering, as well as postgraduate programs in Earthquake Engineering and Urban Design and Conservation. The college boasts a competent and enthusiastic academic faculty, sound physical and academic infrastructure, and strong support from the people of Bhaktapur. KhEC's success can be attributed to its emphasis on regular classes, practical assignments, field studies, excursions, report writing, and internal examinations.In a short time since its inception, KhEC has become a popular destination for aspiring engineers and architects from all over Nepal. In 2076, the college was felicitated as the best college among affiliated colleges by the Purbanchal University during the 26th annual function and closing ceremony of the silver jubilee.VisionThe vision of Khwopa Engineering College (KhEC) is to establish Bhaktapur city as the Centre of Academic Excellence and intellectualize the society through engineering knowledge.MissionWith a distant vision of maintaining Bhaktapur's hard-won glory, KhEC provides outstanding platform for students and scholars that produce world-wide competing manpower in the field of engineering and architecture. Each student will not only nurtured with academic excellence but dedicated to the nation & people. We are moving ahead with the mission in integrating the indigenous engineering knowledge with modern-day technologies through research activities. We believe that the real output can be achieved in linking the education with the production labour. Through the integration of teaching, research and service, it shall provide an outstanding academic experience for students as well as scholars. KhEC provides quality education with an affordable fee accessible to people from economically common strata of the society.

Listed by Purbanchal University. Approved programs: BE Civil-96, BE Computer-60, BE EC & Automation-80, B. Arch.-60, M.E. in Earthquake-20, M. Sc. UDC-20; BIT-48, BCA-48
