name: Gramodaya Yugkabi Siddhicharan Campus
description: Gramodaya Yugkabi Siddhicharan Campus, located in Likhu Rural Municipality-06, Gamnanagtar, Okhaldhunga, Koshi Province, is a prominent educational institution dedicated to providing quality education to students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, particularly females from agricultural communities. The campus offers a Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) program, serving as a vital academic hub in the region. With around 250 students and 12 teaching staff, the campus operates in close collaboration with Gramodaya Yugkabi Siddhicharan Secondary School, while its own facilities are under development, expected to be completed by mid-2024. Known for its strong community reputation and impressive annual success rate of over 80%, the campus provides an enriching academic environment with spacious classrooms, a modest library, internet access, and a variety of extracurricular activities. The campus is further distinguished by its Youth Red Cross Circle, which plays a key role in shaping students' social skills and preparing them for future challenges. Supported by a team of experienced scholars, Gramodaya Yugkabi Siddhicharan Campus is committed to fostering both personal and intellectual growth, ensuring that students receive a well-rounded education in a nurturing environment. Objectives The primary objective of the Campus is to provide psycho-scientific, result-oriented, and student-centered education, coupled with managerial skills and knowledge tailored to individual ages and temperaments. Additionally, the Campus aims to transform students into dedicated, disciplined, efficient, and competent citizens of the country. It is committed to supporting students in achieving their goals in alignment with GYSC’s mission. The specific objectives offered by the Campus include: Provide student friendly learning environment Expertise of experienced and well qualified lecturers Organize co-curricular and extra-curricular activities to explore the potentials of students Development of intellectual, professional and practical skills Provide communication and leadership styles skills Extensive multidisciplinary facilities and disciplines Enhance socio-psychological skills to survive in the global world Present Plan The Campus is currently in the process of expanding its infrastructure and increasing student enrollment. The objective is to enhance its facilities and accommodate more students. Additionally, the Campus is committed to offering fee waivers and scholarships to deserving students based on merit and economic background, ensuring accessibility to quality education. The expansion plan aligns with the growing demands for trained teachers in various schools and the managerial skills required at local and district levels in education and local development. To support these goals, the Campus has acquired 5 ropani of land and has set the ambitious target of constructing new facilities, including hostels, laboratories, libraries, and more. These endeavors aim to achieve autonomy and ensure the sustained growth and development of the Campus.

name: Gupteshwor Multiple Campus
description:
Gupteshwor Multiple Campus was established in 1991 A.D. with joint effort of the people of Shivalaya VDC and other VDCs in the neighborhood. It is in the headquarter of Parbat district, Kushma, about 270 km. far from the capital city Kathmandu and about 60 km far from Pokhara, from the establishment of this campus, public donation has been the major source of fund. This campus is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and Higher Secondary Education Board of Nepal. About 27 ropanies of land sponsored by Shivalaya VDC is occupied by this campus. The classes and administration of this campus are now running in four buildings which were built on the year 2002 A.D, 2003 A.D and 2007 A.D. The fund for the construction of the two old buildings was collected as the donation of the public charity and new two buildings were constructed as the financial assistance of Indian Embassy. Altogether this campus has 36 rooms where all the classes are running. Moreover, the library, administration, account and exam procedures have been managed in these rooms. In the beginning of its establishment only the classes of Intermediate level affiliated to Tribhuvan University were running in the morning shift in the buildings of local school namely Narayan Hihger Secondary School. Later , 2002 A.D., the campus was shifted to its own building. Since 2002 A.D this campus had run the classes of class Eleven and Twelve under the affiliation of Higher secondary education board which now have been postponed. After that, the classes of proficiency level (Intermediate level) have been cut off. At present, the Bachelor Level Programs in Arts, Commerce and Education have been running.

Gupteshwor Multiple Campus has celebrated its 21th anniversary with increasing volume. A lot of strive has been invested in its making. Its present position and reputation has been possible through untiring effort and struggle of many educationists, intellectuals, government agencies, non government organizations, politicians, international organizations including Indian Embassy to Nepal and different social workers. Similarly, the dedicated teaching faculties, administrative staff and CMC members deserve equal credit. Started with a few students and hired classroom at Narayan Higher Secondary School in Kushma just 23 years ago, GMC has rapidly grown into a larger sized academic institution satisfying educational needs of thousands of students coming mainly from Parbat and nearby districts of western region. We can find graduates from GMC in various sectors of World Labour Market. I believe it will continue leading the educational field of not only the region but also the nation in the days to come.

name: Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya (College Wing)
description: Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya, Bhaktapur (SAMB) operates under the auspices of the Nepali Army Welfare Fund, guided by the divine motto "Gyanena Paramo Sewa" which means that imparting knowledge is the greatest service. SAMB has a proud history dating back to 2035 B.S. At that time, it was known as Suping Multiple Campus and was established in Bhimphedi, Makawanpur as a constituent campus of Tribhuvan University, jointly funded by the Nepali Army and Tribhuvan University. In Chaitra 2042, the campus was moved to Sallaghari, Bhaktapur, and began operating under the name Birendra Sainik Mahavidyalaya/Campus with affiliation from Tribhuvan University. From 14th Poush, 2043 B.S., the Mahavidyalaya has been solely under the auspices of the Nepali Army. In Shrawan 2067, the name was changed slightly from Birendra Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya (BSAMV) to the present name, Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya, Bhaktapur (SAMB).With the goal of providing modern and high-quality education to both children of Nepali Army personnel and civilians, the Mahavidyalaya expanded its offerings to include school-level education from Grade IV, with the support of the government. Originally offering education exclusively to male students, the Mahavidyalaya introduced co-education to both the campus and school in 2046 B.S. and 2047 B.S., respectively. In 2060 B.S., the Mahavidyalaya obtained affiliation from the Higher Secondary Education Board (HSEB) to offer the Management Faculty. In 2066 B.S., the Mahavidyalaya began offering Humanities, Science, and Management faculties and has done so smoothly ever since. To date, 26 batches of students have completed their SLC/SEE from the Mahavidyalaya. Furthermore, in 2077 B.S., the Mahavidyalaya added two sections of Management and one section of Science for day scholars in the morning shift. Over time, the Mahavidyalaya has also obtained affiliation from Tribhuvan University to offer B.Sc. in 2069 B.S. and BBA in 2070 B.S., and has been efficiently administering these Bachelor's programmes ever since.The students have consistently pursued academic excellence, achieving exceptional results in the Board Exams of SLC/SEE, HSEB/NEB, and TU. Ther current standing of the school is a testament to their past accomplishments. The small seedling that was planted in 2035 B.S. has flourished into a robust tree, disseminating knowledge throughout the region. This long-term vision has inspired countless students, providing them with the necessary motivation to achieve success and accomplish their goals.VisionTo establish the Mahavidyalaya as the Centre of Excellence.

नेपालको पश्चिम क्षेत्रकै गौरवशाली शैक्षिक इतिहास बोकेको क्यू.ए.ए. प्राप्त शैक्षिक संस्था पृथ्वीनारायण क्याम्पस, पोखराको  ६५ औँ वार्षिकोत्सव  समारोह विभिन्न कार्यक्रमको आयोजना गरी भाद्र १७ गते सोमबारको दिन भव्य रूपमा सम्पन्न भयो । क्याम्पस प्रमुख प्रा.डा. सरोज कोइरालाको अध्यक्षता रहेको उक्त समारोहमा प्रमुख अतिथि त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालयका शिक्षाध्यक्ष प्रा.डा. खड्ग के.सी. ले झण्डोत्तोलन गरी रुद्राक्षको बिरुवा रोप्नाका साथै कलात्मक पानसमा दीप प्रज्वलन गरी विधिवत् रूपमा कार्यक्रमको समुद्घाटन गर्नुभएको थियो ।

name: Mechi Multiple Campus
description: Mechi Multiple Campus established in 2021 BS (1964 AD) is the only constituent Campus of TU in Bhadrapur Municipality Corporation, Jhapa district Nepal. This campus has been fulfilling the social responsibility by providing higher education in nominal fees to all and the economical backward students. Initially the campus started with the proficiency certificate level, followed by graduation program and at present the campus has Post-Graduate programs. The campus is planning to add new graduation and Post-Graduation program in Humanities, Management and Science to produce efficient, technically skilled, Job-Oriented man power to fulfill the social demands in the national and international level. Eventually it is planning to start Medical Science, Engineering and Tea Science. Besides the general subjects, the future plan is to make this institution a technical and Research-Oriented College. Mission To develop Mechi Multiple Campus as center of academic excellence in national and international standards and provide efficient manpower to the country. Objectives To prepare fully capable knowledge-based students enabling them to pursue higher studies To develop socially responsible & result oriented professionals To provide internationally recognized quality education together with practical knowledge To provide quality education and produce professionals at different levels in all sectors like business, public and governmental and development organizations To increase the level of maturity & power of reasoning

name: Ed-Mark College
description: Ed-Mark College, established in 2007 A.D., is located in Kalanki, Kathmandu, and was founded by a group of highly professional educators with a strong commitment to quality education and academic excellence. Backed by an excellent management system, the college has grown into a trusted institution dedicated to shaping the future of students through well-structured academic programs and supportive learning environments.Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB), Ed-Mark College offers +2 programs in Science, Management, Humanities, and Law. At the undergraduate level, it is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and provides BBS, BASW, BA, and BCA programs. At the master’s level, the college offers an MBS program. These programs ensure students receive a well-rounded and industry-relevant education.The hallmark of the ‘Ed-Mark Experience’ lies in its outstanding teaching and learning facilities, where students receive instruction and guidance from a team of highly qualified and experienced faculty members. The college integrates modern educational technologies, such as audio-visual teaching aids, and encourages interactive learning through group discussions. Its extensive library provides access to a wide range of textbooks, reference materials, periodicals, and magazines, helping students deepen their academic insights.Ed-Mark College also offers courses tailored to individual interests, along with professional career counseling and support. Subject-specific laboratories are adequately equipped to ensure practical learning, and students are introduced to essential computer skills through basic IT orientations. With this comprehensive academic approach, Ed-Mark College continues to foster a vibrant and empowering educational journey for each of its students.

name: Purwanchal College
description: Purwanchal College is located in Damak-9, Jhapa . This college is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and is offering BBS program.

name: Gurbhakot Multiple Campus
description: Gurbhakot Multiple Campus is a community-based campus located in the Surkhet District of Nepal. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, Gurbhakot Campus offers Bachelors in Education (B.Ed) program. Currently, 105 students are studying on this campus.

name: Manmohan Memorial Institute of Health Sciences
description: Manmohan Memorial Institure of Health Sciences (MMIHS) is an academic institute of applied sciences run under the umbrella of Nepal Health Care Cooperative limited (NEHCO). The Institute is committed to provide the practical and real life based education. The MMIHS is put up by a group of academicians, researchers, industrialists and prominent professional with extensive exposure to a wide range of knowledge, experience and teaching/learning practices. It is committed towards the excellence and innovation in imparting high quality health education for Nepalese youth and international community. Apart from this, MMIHS aims to provide high end health service facilitating with modern medical technology with the reach of all Nepalese citizens.In line with national and international thinking of Center of Excellence in health education, health service delivery and health research, MMIHS is committed to involve itself through enhanced partnership with local, national and international rights/stakeholders.MMIHS believes that the triangulation of education, services and research will help develop the technically component, socially accepted and internationally recognized professional, educators and researches. Though it technically renowned and professionally committed faculty members, MMIHS is stanched to support government of Nepal to achieve its national and international commitments in health and education sector.VisionManmohan Memorial Institute of Health Sciences (MMIHS) envisions to ensure the quality of life of the Nepalese people through the provision of quality health education and health services.MissionPromote the quality health education through the equity in service delivery, social inclusion in health program planning and health service utilization, and production of competent human resources including marginalize groups and remote areas of Nepal.GoalsDevelop MMIHS as a A CENTER OF EXCELLENCE through education, research and services. MMIHS seeks to prepare socially responsible and technically competent health professionals in the society. Its aim is to produce innovative professionals with good attitude to serve the patients and communities at large with head, hands and heart. Its special characteristics is the wide range of activities that it provides with the idea of developing a full personality and to bring out talents of the students for developing own benefit and that of society as a whole.ObjectivesTrain health professionals with full exposure at the implementation level and fundamental theoretical knowledge.Provide students a wide range of resources on subject matter required for quality education that combines effective skills as well as high level of confidencePrepare high quality human resources for health who could take a lead in planning, organizing delivering, and evaluating health policy and health care services within the country and in the globePractice and facilitate linkages with national and international academic and research institutions and prepare students for higher education in the field of pharmacy, nursing, public health, and other health related sectorsOrganize the national level campaigns to support the Governments care policy and other national and international commitments and impart academic services.Conduct clinical, participatory and community based research related to pharmacy, nursing, public health, medicine and bio medical sciences Contact AddressMana Mohan Memorial Institute of Health SciencesNakhkhu-4, Lalitpur, Kathmandu

name: Rudrawati Multiple Campus
description: Rudrawati Multiple Campus is located in Wamitaksar, Gulmi. It is a community campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University . It offers BBS and B.Ed program.

name: Chamunda College
description: Established in 2065 B.S., Chamunda College is a community-managed, non-profit educational institution situated in Chamunda Bindrasaini, Dailekh. Locals , social workers, and community representatives founded the institution through a joint initiative to expand access to higher education for students from working and underprivileged backgrounds in this geographically remote district.The college operates under affiliation with Tribhuvan University and offers programs under the Faculty of Education, namely the Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) and the Master of Education General (M.Ed.). The academic framework is structured around practical and skill-based learning, designed to align with employment needs and address local socio-economic challenges related to unemployment and poverty.Although the institution began operations without formal physical, academic, or administrative infrastructure, it systematically developed its facilities in coordination with the University Grants Commission (UGC), local government bodies, and supporting organizations. Chamunda College serves as an educational center that meets the higher-learning needs of students in Dailekh, operating through ongoing institutional cooperation with relevant stakeholders to run its academic programs.

name: Southwestern State College
description: Located in Basundhara, Kathmandu, Southwestern State College (SWSC) is an educational institution dedicated to providing qualitative, practical, and values-based education. Under the stewardship of an experienced management team, the college offers a diverse range of academic programs spanning from secondary to postgraduate levels, designed to meet contemporary professional demands.At the secondary level, SWSC provides +2 programs in Science, Management, Law, and Humanities under the National Examination Board (NEB). For higher education, the college is affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU), offering undergraduate programs including Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Business Management (BBM), Bachelor of Arts in Computer Application (BCA), Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS), and Bachelor’s in Social Work (BSW). At the graduate level, students can pursue a Master of Business Studies (MBS) or a Master of Arts (M.A.) in English.The college emphasizes a research-led teaching methodology and maintains well-equipped facilities, including specialized laboratories for Computer Science, Hotel Management, and Management studies. As an ISO 9001:2015 QMS certified institution, SWSC is also in the process of obtaining Quality Assurance and Accreditation (QAA) from the University Grants Commission (UGC) Nepal. Beyond the classroom, the college integrates civic education and motivational sessions into its curriculum to foster holistic development. With earthquake-resistant infrastructure and a focus on faculty excellence, the college seeks to prepare students for global opportunities while encouraging social responsibility.

name: Nepal Kasthamandap College
description: Nepal Kasthamandap College, located at Kalanki (near Makalu Petrol Pump), Kathmandu, is an academic institution established by a diverse group of experienced educators, bankers, and entrepreneurs. The college is dedicated to providing a platform for students to develop their creative potential while maintaining a focus on moral and social responsibility. It offers a comprehensive range of programs under the affiliation of both the National Examinations Board (NEB) and Tribhuvan University (TU).At the secondary level, the college provides Ten Plus Two (+2) programs in Science, Management, Humanities, Law, and Education. For students pursuing higher education, the institution offers the Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS), Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA), and the Master of Business Studies (MBS) under the affiliation of Tribhuvan University.Nepal Kasthamandap College emphasizes a balanced approach to education by integrating Extra-Curricular Activities (ECA) and Co-Curricular Activities (CCA) into its academic calendar. These initiatives are designed to enhance students' interpersonal skills and practical knowledge. Supported by a faculty of experienced professionals, the college focuses on maintaining an environment that supports the academic and personal growth of its students.

name: Mega College International
description: Established in Kumaripati, Lalitpur, Nepal, Mega International College has a rich history of providing quality higher education. With a strong affiliation with Far Western University of Nepal, the college offers BSc Computer Science and Information Technology (CSIT) and Master of Business Administration (MBA) programs to equip students with the skills needed for their careers.Mega International College stands as a beacon of academic excellence, nurturing students for success in their chosen fields. Since its inception, the institution has focused on innovation, critical thinking, and professional growth, creating a conducive environment for holistic development.Dedicated to fostering a culture of learning and advancement, Mega International College has a legacy of producing graduates equipped with both knowledge and practical experience to thrive in today’s competitive job market. The mission of the college is to provide a quality education that fosters innovation, critical thinking, and professional growth in students pursuing BSc CSIT and MBA programs.

name: ​Shiva Shakti Campus
description: Shiva Shakti Campus is situated at Phoolbari, Pokhara. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University, this campus offers B.Ed and BBS programs.

name: IEC College of Art and Fashion
description: IEC College of Art & Fashion is Nepal's pioneering institution offering Fashion and Interior Design education. It is an initiative of IEC School of Art & Fashion, a trusted name in creative education with over 28 years of excellence.The institution has earned several prestigious recognitions, including the International Gold Quality Award (USA) for Quality Education and Total Quality Management (TQM) in 2003, the Fashion Asia Award 2016 as the Asian Top Fashion Organization of the Year in China, and the Nepal Best Brand Leadership Award 2018. Over the years, IEC has expanded its presence through multiple study centers across the Kathmandu Valley, supported by experienced industry professionals and modern technical facilities.IEC College provides world-class infrastructure and learning resources designed to develop skilled creative professionals. Its alumni community has made a significant impact on Nepal's fashion and interior design sectors, with graduates establishing more than 257 fashion labels and 112 interior design studios in Nepal and abroad.The institution is also the promoter and organizer of Nepal Fashion Week, the country's largest fashion event, demonstrating its strong influence and leadership within the fashion industry.For its bachelor's degree programs in Fashion and Interior Design, IEC operates a dedicated campus at Mandikhatar, Kathmandu. Spanning over 55,000 square feet of carpet area, the campus offers a spacious, modern, and industry-focused learning environment equipped to support students throughout their academic journey.

name: Nepal Film Campus
description: Nepal Film Campus, located in Baneshwor, is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and offers a four-year course, Bachelor in Film Studies. The College was established in 2076 B.S. by a team of academicians, filmmakers, and media workers to cater to the need for skilled manpower for the film industry.Nepal Film Campus aims to attract international students to study film studies in Nepal. Film experts from Hollywood, Bollywood, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, and Nepal will conduct the Script Writing and Direction, Sound Production & Design, Video Editing, Cinematography, Acting, and Film Analysis, classes.For those considering sharpening their skills, the Nepal Film Campus offers a wide selection of immersive, hands-on workshops where working industry professionals teach students to create their original work using the latest techniques, industry-standard equipment, and premier facilities.The campus fosters leadership, writing, and critical thinking skills through producing complex productions. Nepal Film Campus seeks to promote and advance the art of Visual Storytelling through filmmaking.To serve aspiring visual storytelling artists/students, teachers on the campus pass on their knowledge, techniques, and methods of artistic film-making while incorporating new technology and innovations. The mission of the institute is to establish itself as a hub for film studies in South Asia.Objectives:To provide excellent undergraduate teaching in the study of cinema and the practice of making motion picturesTo provide extensive knowledge pre-production, production, and post-production of the film-making processTo empower students through its innovative training programs, enabling its learners to develop creativity and contribute to the nationTo embrace new technologies and modes of creative expression for workshops

name: Shramik Shanti Campus
description: Shramik Shanti Campus, located in Chyasal, Lalitpur, is a constituent campus of Pokhara University. Formerly operating as a community campus affiliated with Pokhara University programs in 2025 AD. As a constituent campus of Pokhara University, Shramik Shanti Campus now offers a 5-year BALLB program, a 4-year BCSIT program, and the newly introduced Bachelor of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (BAIDS) program, launched by Pokhara University in 2025 AD.With a vibrant student community and a strong commitment to quality education, Shramik Shanti Campus strives to empower students to reach their full potential and equip them with skills that meet the demands of today’s job market. Many of its graduates go on to pursue higher education or join the professional workforce.The campus’s vision focuses on expanding educational opportunities, fostering cultural enrichment, and supporting workforce development to enhance students’ lives while contributing to economic growth.Dedicated to addressing both community and individual needs, Shramik Shanti Campus ensures affordable, high-quality education and remains committed to preparing students for success in diverse management and professional sectors worldwide.Vision of Shramik Shanti CampusTo establish institution for quality education with reasonable cost in the country.To develop confident and responsible citizens for the nation.

name: Nanda Devi Multiple Campus
description: Nanda Devi Multiple Campus is a community-owned higher education institution located in Kotwada, Kalikot. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, the campus provides accessible undergraduate education in Education and Humanities to students in the Karnali region.

name: Reliable College
description: Reliable College is located in Tinkune, Kathmandu. It is affiliated with Far-Western University and offers Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) and Master of Business Administration (MBA).Mission The mission of Reliable College is to empower students with the knowledge and skills they need to thrive in a rapidly changing world. The college is committed to fostering a learning environment that encourages curiosity, innovation, and academic excellence.VisionTo emerge as one of the most preferred educational groups with global recognition. The institution aims to achieve this by developing competent and socially sensitive leaders who are committed to excellence in their respective fields.Core Values and Educational PhilosophyReliable College operates on a foundation of strong core values that guide its academic and administrative functions:Integrity: The college upholds the highest standards of honesty and ethical behavior across all its interactions. This ensures that students and staff are part of a respectful and trustworthy environment conducive to learning and growth.Innovation: Embracing creativity and forward thinking, the institution continually seeks new ways to enhance its educational practices. It remains at the forefront of modern learning techniques, providing a relevant and effective education.Excellence: A dedication to achieving the highest standards is evident in all aspects of its educational programs. The college strives for continuous improvement in both teaching and learning to deliver an exceptional academic experience.The educational philosophy at Reliable College is built upon a student-centered approach. This methodology is designed to nurture individual strengths and cultivate a passion for lifelong learning. The philosophy focuses on creating an engaging, supportive, and inclusive environment where every student is given the opportunity to excel and make meaningful contributions to society.

name: Aspire College
description: Aspire College says it opened in 2022 at Malaya Road, Biratnagar-14, as a partnership and extension campus of Kathmandu University.

name: New Everest College, Biratnagar
description: Everest College, located in Biratnagar-5, Morang, offers diverse educational pathways at the secondary and undergraduate levels. Affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB), the college offers +2 programs in Science, Law, Management, and Hotel Management. These courses are designed to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of their respective disciplines, preparing them for future academic and professional pursuits.In addition to its secondary education offerings, Everest College provides a Bachelor in Information Technology (BIT) program in affiliation with Kathmandu University. This undergraduate course focuses on the intersection of healthcare and information technology, addressing the growing demand for professionals in this specialized field.The institution emphasizes a well-rounded educational experience by integrating various Extra-Curricular Activities (ECA) and Co-Curricular Activities (CCA) into its curriculum. Everest College frequently organizes diverse events and programs aimed at fostering the personal and interpersonal growth of its students. By combining structured academic learning with organized activities, the college fosters a professional environment focused on steady student development.

name: South City College of Science and Technology
description: South City College of Science and Technology, located at Birgunj-15, Vishwa, Parsa, is an educational institution dedicated to providing higher education in the fields of science and technology. Affiliated with Kathmandu University, the college offers a specialized dual-degree program comprising a Bachelor of Technical Education in Information Technology (B.Tech. Ed. in IT) and a Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT). This integrated curriculum is designed to provide students with a comprehensive foundation in both technical applications and educational principles.The institution focuses on equipping students with the specific knowledge and practical skills required for various professional roles in the evolving tech industry. The program prepares graduates for diverse career paths, including Software Developer, Web Developer, Ed Tech Engineer, Android/iOS Developer, and Big Data Engineer. Additionally, the dual degree structure qualifies students for roles such as TVET IT Instructors. By offering these academic programs, South City College of Science and Technology provides a pathway for students to develop the technical expertise and pedagogical skills necessary for the modern workforce.

name: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology, Birtamod
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology, located in Birtamode, Jhapa, is an academic institution dedicated to providing business and technology education in Eastern Nepal. Affiliated with Kathmandu University, the college offers undergraduate programs including the Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT) and the Bachelor of Technical Education in Information Technology (B.Tech.Ed. IT). These courses are designed to combine academic rigor with practical industry exposure, ensuring students are prepared for the evolving demands of the technology sector.The mission of the institution is to make quality technical education accessible within the region, nurturing innovators and educators who can contribute to both local and national development. By fostering an inclusive campus culture, the college supports the personal and professional growth of its students from admission to graduation.Looking forward, WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology envisions becoming a regional hub for innovation and applied research. The college aims to expand its focus on emerging fields such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT) through specialized labs. By strengthening alumni and employer networks, the institution seeks to bridge the gap between classroom learning and real-world problem-solving, while also championing digital literacy within the wider community.

name: Bhairab Multiple Campus
description: A Tribhuvan University campus list and the Nepal Public Campus Association both name Bhairab Multiple Campus at Rainadevi Chhahara, Palpa, which matches this record.

name: J.S. Murarka Multiple Campus
description: J.S. Murarka Campus is located in Lahan. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and is offering Bachelors and Masters level program. Its sister concern J.S. Murarka Secondary School offers school level education. J.S. Murarka Multiple Campus Lahan, Siraha is a community campus established In 2044 BS. The campus has its own building granted by the renowned social worker and business entrepreneur, late Prameshwor Murarka and his brothers. The college is established with the collaborative efforts to fulfill the demands of people in the field of education. The college is offering +2 level to post graduate level in humanities, education, management and science. The campus has successfully completed the SHEP program of UGC and has been selected for its HERP program, out of forty five community colleges nationally. Vision To be a model institution for producing qualified, skilled and devoted human resources. Mission The mission of this campus is to contribute for building prosperous society by producing updated and efficient human resources providing research and practical based quality education under well physical facilitated infrastructure, good governance, mobilization of local resources, stakeholders’ participation and their access as well. Goals To enhance access to quality education with effective management and well facilitated physical infrastructure for sustainable development To mobilize the local resources with the active participation of the stakeholders To develop and expand its policy and procedures as well as research based activities and linkage with other organizations for the institutional development of the campus, and To organize different workshops, seminars and trainings for the professional development of the staff. Objectives To develop well managed physical infrastructure as per need To make the administrative activities well managed and effective To maintain the updated educational environment To maintain it as a green and clean Institution To expand the interaction with the stakeholders To mobilize the local donors and well wishers for their contribution To mobilize the internal and external resources, To form and apply the required policy and plan in the Institution To manage the ways of reducing hazards in the Institution To manage the modernized information systems To expand the academic programs as per need To maintain and promote the research oriented activities To organize workshops, trainings, conferences, etc. for developing the quality of the staff and students as well. To achieve the certificate of QAA (Quality Assurance and Accreditation)

name: Modern College
description: Modern College was established in 2050 B.S. (1993 A.D.) with the motto “Education for Peace and Prosperity”. It is a contemporary, activist, careful learning center where students are prepared to meet the challenges and opportunities of the 21st century and flourish as competent and disciplined global citizens. It is well known for its individual-centered learning approachIn the last thirty years, Modern has acquired unprecedented success at all levels of education and has become a synonym for an excellent education hub. It has bagged various prestigious National and International awards for its transformative educational practices and remarkable exam results.Since its establishment, it has been incessantly contributing to the nation by producing academically sound, highly disciplined, socially and morally conscious, and accountable graduates. It has proved itself as the leading institution in providing world-class education through its excellent results in various national-level academic examinations and in extra-academic competitions. The toppers in various reputed organizations and the proficient, competent, disciplined, and well-mannered graduates who are competing in the global market in rank one validate the quality of education in the institution. With the same guts, it is marching ahead with its vision of enhancing the capacity of each individual associated consequently preparing them for a dignified life and enables to contribute to the nation’s development.Modern has taken a ground-breaking step by launching the first +2 Management College in Bhaktapur district in 2065 B.S. and the first time +2 Law in Bhaktapur in association with the Katmandu School of Law in 2074 B.S. with the slogan “building your career, shaping your future”, since then, it is imparting the quality in academic and extra-academic services to the students and committed to building students’ careers in the field of management and law ensuring the better position in their workplace as well as dedicated to preparing them as a complete package of good and smart citizens. Modern English Secondary School has been run at the same place.

name: Chakrabarti Habi Education Academy (College of Allied Health Science)
description: Chakrabarti Habi Educational Academy (College of Allied Health Sciences) is located at Madhyapur, Thimi-3, Bhaktapur. Currently, it offers a B.Sc. in Nursing (BSN) and a Post Basic Bachelor of Nursing (PBN) with affiliation from Purbanchal University.Why Chakrabarti College?Chakrabarti College is dedicated to serving the community through various outreach initiatives that extend beyond classroom education. Students of the college actively participate in health camps, awareness campaigns, and projects aimed at addressing public health issues. In addition to these, numerous other camps are organized each month.The college is committed to a holistic learning approach that surpasses traditional classroom teaching methods. Its curriculum is designed to integrate theoretical knowledge with practical training, clinical rotations, and community engagement.Chakrabarti College boasts a team of experienced faculty members. These educators bring a wealth of knowledge and practical experience to the learning environment. Their expertise ensures that students receive a quality education and training, which prepares them to excel in their respective healthcare careers.

name: Janapradeep Multiple Campus
description: Shree Janapradeep Multiple Campus is located in Syangja district of western Nepal. It is a community campus, which is offering B.Ed program with affiliation from Tribhuvan University. Currently 52 students are studying in this campus.

name: Chakrabarti Habi Educational Academy
description:
Chakrabarti HaBi Education Academy College of Law (Chakrabarti Law) is a part of the Chakrabarti HaBi Education Academy. This college was established in 2010 AD. A Purbanchal University affiliate college Chakrabarti Law offers five years BA LL.B. and two years LL.M. programChakrabarti Law is an endeavour to create the most professional and intellectually sound groups of law professionals in Nepal. It is also a scholastic enterprise that aims to provide academic leadership and foster new ideas and debates.Contact AddressChakrabarti Habi Educational Academy (College of Law)Bijulibazar, Kathmandu

Listed by Purbanchal University. Approved programs: BA (Hon.)-100, MA (Eng.)-100

name: Shiksha Mahabhidyalaya Campus
description: Shiksha Mahabhidyalaya Campus is located in Pokhara. It is a community campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University . It offers B.Ed program.

name: Gaurishankar Multiple Campus

name: Central Department of Statistics |  Tribhuvan University
description:
Central Department of Statistics, Tribhuvan University is the sole department in Nepal which offers and produce Master’s Degree holders in Statistics as well as PhD in Statistics. The department was established in 1972 with its first Head of the Department, Prof. B. N. Nagnur of Karnatak University, India. In its early developing phase, Indian Co-operation Mission supported M.Sc. Statistics program with distinguished Professors Dr. P. C. Sharma and Dr. A. V. Kharshikar. In due course of time, TU constructed Statistics Instruction Committee which later transformed to Central Department of Statistics.

The M. Sc. / M. A. Statistics program is an academic course covering both theoretical and applied areas of Statistics. It is divided into four semesters (six months per semester) with a total duration of 2 years and annual intake system. The program contains 11 core courses, 5 optional courses, 3 computing (practical) courses, dissertation and two additional courses as an alternative option for dissertation.

Central Department of Statistics started to produce Ph. D. in Statistics from the year 2005 under the supervision of Prof. Mrigendra Lal Singh. Since then the department has produced Ph. D.s in Statistics regularly for the span of around 20 years with the output of 14 Ph. D. Statistics holders. Diverse areas of Statistics have been covered in Ph. D. researches such demographic and related areas, environmental health and climate change, agricultural statistics, Bayesian inference, tourism statistics, and many more with substantial contributions to Statistics through statistical models and analysis methods, techniques and tools. At present, altogether 9 scholars are undertaking their Ph. D. research works.

Huge congratulations to Ishwari Prasad Banjade for successfully completing the PhD Viva Voce Examination, 2025/09/03.

Central Department of Statistics (CDS) extends its heartfelt wishes to Prof. Dr. Gauri Shrestha for a retirement filled with happiness, health, and prosperity. CDS appreciates her commitment and dedicated service over more than 30 years, during which she made remarkable contributions in statistics.

Huge Congratulation to Krishna Prasad Acharya for successfully completing the PhD Viva Voce Examination, 2024/01/05.

name: Dibyabhumi Multiple College
description: Dibyabhumi Multiple College (DMC) is the bright place for the students who are very eager to achieve fruitful knowledge for their prospective future. ‘Dibyabhumi’ is developed as a center for teaching and learning activities where all the teachers, students, and even the independent academic experts involve in discussions, interactions and seminars so as to raise and solve the socio-economic and political and cultural issues. Dibyabhumi Multiple College (DMC) affiliated to Tribhuvan University was established in 2014, is located at Kupondole, Lalitpur. DMC is established with an only view to create a more civilized humanity that contributes to the formation of a peaceful and prosperous world, and thereby easily hand on a better world to the coming generation. In order to materialize this goal, DMC believes that only a meaningful education filled with professional efficiency and moral responsibility can help. DMC along with the university textbooks has developed its own curriculum so as to update the students with the trends and demands of the changing time. DMC’s academic programs are Bachelor in Social Work (BSW), Bachelor in Computer Application (BCA), Bachelor in Journalism & Mass Communication (BJMC), and Bachelor in Major English. DMC is also teaching the students the subjects such as Leadership Skills, Social Entrepreneurship, Global Citizenship, Critical Thinking, Creative Writing, Core Skills, Digital Design, Videography, Proposal Writing, French Language Classes, MOOC Courses and so on. So, that the students could understand they are digital and global citizens and they have to fulfill the global responsibilities. Dibyabhumi Multiple College from its establishment has been providing guest lecture classes in which the experts from various fields, even the retired ones share their work experiences of their area. These classes have been proved quite fruitful to instill in the students organizational and professional knowledge and motivate them to do something good for the betterment of the society. Dibyabhumi Multiple College with the active participation of the students organizes various programs such as seminars, conferences, workshop, Round Table meetings, and training. Similarly, students during academic time will indulge in National and International organizations working in Social sectors and corporate sectors with a view to sharing and exchanging the ideas and skills. DMC is always open to discover and expand its ties with the institution. Dibyabhumi Multiple College has signed MOU with the 1. Microsoft Innovation Center-Nepal 2. Shire Oak Academy, England, UK 3. Seoul University South Korea 4. VGT Denmark and 5. Kunjang University College, South Korea 6. Korea Association for Function of Handicapped, Seoul South Korea and KNSU, South Korea 7. Press Council Nepal for the academic development and in some joint projects for the mutual benefits of our students and academia. DMC has also signed MOU with Nepalese Professional Organizations namely Press Council Nepal, Gateway Publication Pvt. Ltd. (www.sralpatrika.com), Gaun Sahar Sanchar Pvt. Ltd (http://gaunsahar.com/), Centre for Media Research (CMR), Nepal. Teach For Nepal (TFN) for Internship, Fellowship, Research Assistantship, skill transfer, and academic development. Dibyabhumi Multiple College and UNDP Nepal jointly have already started a Lecture Series program on UN Sustainable Development Goals and 2030 Agenda for college and University students. DMC has already signed MOU with UNESCO Centre for Global Education, and it believes that this helps to work in the field of education, young people and academy in an effective manner and meet with the SDGs and 2030 agenda. Similarly, in coordination with the academic institutions of Nepal, DMC has been continuously organizing different academic programs. To sum up, Dibyabhumi Multiple College believes in the fact that only education in the true sense of the word can bring a positive change in the world. For the overall development of a person, an education must give all kinds of necessary exposures to the students. To fulfill these goals, we are joining hands with different likeminded organizations and professionals working tirelessly and we are hopeful that we will be successful to produce competent, qualified and moral citizens who contribute to the development of the peaceful and prosperous world. Mission To prepare our students for a future of dynamic change with relevant knowledge, life-long skills, and responsible global citizenship so as to address significant social issues for the advance of their communities and the world. Vision To create digital and global citizens. Objectives To emphasize a student centered approach to teaching, learning, and college life by expanding educational opportunities and social mobility through high quality instructional and student support services that are both accessible and affordable. To foster and strengthen effective partnership with educational governmental, business, charitable, and civic organization. To provide quality education quite conductive to address the changing trends of the world To provide knowledge through the modern and latest technology To Provide the students with practical knowledge and life skills To make the students self reliant, creative and responsible for the humanity To equip them with practical life skills, sense of morality, honesty and dedication

name: Central Department of Population Studies | Tribhuvan University
description: The Central Department of Population Studies (CDPS) was established in 1988 by T.U. Council. Since 1990, CDPS has been modestly funded by the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA). It has grown and developed during the last twenty years and has made significant contributions to the nation's population dynamics sector. It is envisaged that CDPS will continue to grow, in line with the evolving needs for research and training in the country; and that it will emerge in due course as a major research and training centre in South Asia. In addition to having regular support from Tribhuvan University, CDPS received UNFPA assistance from 1990 till 2007 including the physical infrastructure. CDPS also received technical assistance from Department for International Development (DFID) to support institutional linkages with the Centre for Population Studies (CPS), London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine. International Labour Organization (ILO), the World Bank and the British Council/DFID have been recurrent sources of funding for small and medium scale research and curriculum development. Contact Address Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences Tribhuvan University, Kirtipur Kathmandu, Nepal Tel: 977-1-331323

name: Durgalaxmi Multiple Campus
description: Durgalaxmi Multiple Campus is the constituent campus of Far-Western University, and it is still running the programmes of Tribhuvan University as well (TU programmes will exist till the last batch of masters and bachelors pass out from the campus according to the MoU between Far-Western University and Durgalaxmi Multiple Campus). The campus was established in 2063 B.S (2006 A.D.) with the combined effort of the local community, representatives of political parties, teachers, students, different social groups/ organizations and other stakeholders of Attariya and peripheral areas. In the initial point, the campus had permission for one faculty in bachelor’s level from TU: Education. In 2064 B.S. the campus got permission to run Management, and in 2065 B.S. the campus got permission to run Humanities(B.A.). Recently, the campus has been providing education to the students of the Far-Western region in B.Ed, B.A, BBS, BBA and B.Ed CSIT at the bachelor’s level and M.Ed (TESOL, CPL, Health Education and Nepali Education) and M.B.M.in Master’s level. Over six hundred students enrol in the campus annually to study different programmes, master's and bachelor's, in different faculties in this campus every Year.MissionThe mission of Durgalaxmi Multiple Campus is to provide access to quality higher education by providing skill based, career based, vocational, technical, research based and general education to the people of Far Western region and the whole nation emphasizing the participation of ethnic, Dalit, Janajatis and the people of different social strata and marginalized groups incorporating the mission of Far-Western University, Nepal.VisionThe vision of Durgalaxmi Multiple Campus is to be a nationally recognized educational institution of quality education through making contribution on intellectual, social, cultural and economic development of the Far-Western region as well as the entire nation, incorporating the vision of Far-Western University, Nepal.GoalsTo achieve the vision and mission of the campus, under the goals of Far-Western University Nepal, The Campus strives to achieve the following goals:• Programme extension in line with the educational demand of the local community and the Far-Western region. • Continued efforts towards quality improvement. • Strengthening infrastructures base and human resource development • Qualify for Accreditation from the UGC and maintain accreditation status. • Improving internal academic and administrative efficiency. • As a socially responsible educational institution, maintaining good relations with the community. • Achieving sustainability by expanding the financial resource base.Durgalaxmi campus is equipped with the required physical infrastructure. The campus is running all academic programmes, administration, library and other activities in its own building. Currently, the campus has a three-stored single building constructed in about 1 bigaha of a total 6.5 bigaha of land. There is a separate room for the library, a store room, an administration room, a teacher-staff room and a main office room for the campus chief out of a total of 27 rooms. The building is covered by a concrete wall and a wire fence for security. There is a main gate on the front side. The campus has a separate building for toilets for girls, boys, teachers and staff with sufficient water supply. The campus has a facility for pure drinking water and a sanitation system. At the south corner of the campus building, there is a tube well for an alternative drinking water supply to the entire campus. The campus premises include play ground for volleyball, football, and badminton. Similarly, the campus has maintained greenery through tree and flower plantations around campus premises.

name: Mid-West University School of Management
description: The School of Management (SOM) of Mid-West University offers a dynamic environment and modern and forward-looking teaching pedagogy. Regardless of whether students intend to study at the undergraduate or graduate level, the School strives to create an intellectually challenging and stimulating atmosphere at all levels. The School of Management is committed to fostering leadership with a deep understanding of business. With a constant focus on the changing employment world, the school's academic programs try to blend theoretical foundations of management with the practical requirements of the actual job market. Mid-West University School of Management seeks to understand the nature and directions of global change and provide solutions following an interdisciplinary approach based on teaching, scholarship, and research. The School aims to prepare business leaders and expert managers for leadership positions in industries and governments at national, regional, and global level. VISION The Vision of the School of Management is to become a leading Management and Business School committed to the highest standards of learning and teaching to prepare the youth for tackling in a creative and productive way the growing challenges of the business world, both locally and internationally. It strongly promotes scholarship and research, as well as the integration of theory and practice through close collaboration with the private and public sectors and the wider society. MISSION The School of Management aims to create a legacy, enhance knowledge and understanding of business studies, improve the practice and profession of management by producing market and service-oriented graduates, and link the University system with community services. The School aspires to prepare students for professional pursuits in business, industry, and government who are able to efficiently and effectively cope with the challenges of the emerging business professions, equip them with proven business skills, and be able to play an active role in national and international leading business organizations.

description: Biratnagar Nursing Campus is the only affiliated nursing campus of Tribhuvan University in Koshi Province, Nepal. With a rich history dating back to its establishment as an ANM training center in 1966, our campus has evolved into a comprehensive educational institution dedicated to nursing and nursing science.At Biratnagar Nursing Campus, we offer bachelor's programs in nursing and nursing science and master's programs in nursing science. description: Birgunj Nursing Campus, located in Madhesh Province, Birgunj Metropolitan City, Birta – 4, has been a prominent institution in nursing education since its establishment in 2032 BS (1975 AD). Originally started as the AHW/CMA (Community Medicine Auxiliary) program, it later became a part of Tribhuvan University Institute of Medicine (T.U.IOM) as Birgunj Campus in 2033 BS.Over its >43 years of existence, Birgunj Nursing Campus has achieved significant progress and has expanded its academic programs from Community Medicine to the Bachelor of Nursing Science. It initiated the Proficiency Certificate Level Nursing Program (PCL) in 2043 BS, Bachelor in Nursing (BN) program began in 2068 BS, and the intake for BNS students started in 2073 BS.The vision of Birgunj Nursing Campus is to produce nursing personnel of the highest academic excellence and gain recognition as a prestigious nursing institute in Madhesh Province, contributing to achieving universal health goals and meeting Sustainable Development Goals.The campus's mission is to create and maintain a learning environment that nurtures critical thinking, knowledge acquisition, and the development of ongoing professional skills. It aims to transform care in a rapidly changing, diverse, and complex healthcare environment through academic excellence, innovative research, strong partnerships, and global initiatives.To accomplish its mission and fulfill its vision, Birgunj Nursing Campus has set strategic goals. These goals include delivering high-quality nursing education that meets international standards and promoting quality education through faculty development initiatives.The campus also strives to produce competent mid-level healthcare professionals who are well-prepared to work efficiently in their assigned areas and adapt to the challenges of a growing world. Additionally, it aims to upgrade and update its academic infrastructure, including library and IT facilities, to support the delivery of quality education.Birgunj Nursing Campus stands as a leading institution in nursing education, dedicated to providing a comprehensive and excellent learning experience for aspiring nursing professionals, ultimately contributing to the advancement of healthcare in the region.

name: Graduate School of Humanities and Social Sciences | Mid-West University
description: The Faculty of Humanities and Social Science comprises the School of Humanities and Social Sciences (SHSS) which is based in the University premises in Birendranagar Municipality, in the District of Surkhet, Nepal. Starting from the Academic Year 2012-2013, the School is offering graduate and undergraduate programs in various subjects and disciplines. As it moves forward with the implementation of the 4-year curriculum starting from 2012, the School has identified in the concept of social responsibility and human development the core themes that will guide the future development of the Institute. The concept of social responsibility finds application in the constant attention towards what is happening in the society at national, regional and global level. This concept goes hand in hand with the concept of social leadership. By pursuing research and learning activities in this area of study, the School aims to promote global social engagement and prepare future leaders and professionals who are responsible citizens, socially committed and able to read, interpret and cope with the challenges of continuous changing scenarios. Development is a multi-dimensional process of improving the quality of all human lives at different but equally important levels, by creating conditions conducive to the holistic growth of the individuals and increasing peoples’ freedom to choose by enlarging the range of their choices. Inspired by the statement that “People are the real wealth of a nation”, the School tries to promote a concept of Human Development that is sustainable in the long run, inclusive of all members that make-up a society, ensure full human rights and equal opportunities for everyone. These core themes inform the teaching philosophy of the School of Humanities and Social Sciences and nourish all of its taught programs. Around these core themes, the School has thus identified the main subject areas of the Institute and, based on this, has developed its academic offer both at graduate and undergraduate level. Some courses are interdisciplinary and broad-ranging, looking at key social issues from a variety of angles and perspectives, while others are subject specific. Around these core components, the School of Humanities and Social Sciences also aims to build the research strengths of the Institute. The School is committed towards the promotion of a thriving research culture and has made of it its mission. The School aims at enhancing the research competencies of the students and training them in the qualitative and quantitative methods that are fundamental to social science research. To reinforce the strength of its research activities, the School has also identified some research clusters in which it is particularly keen to carry out extensive research and attract research students. The Schools thus promotes research in fields such as culture, citizenship, identities, good governance and administration, international development and innovation. VISION The School of Humanities and Social Sciences is committed to excellence in scholarship, expand high quality and innovative teaching and learning, and promote the universal values of human dignity, freedom of expression and pursuit of knowledge, for the ultimate goal of advancing the collective understanding and increase the social good. The School seeks to impart high quality education with a holistic approach in order to enhance the capabilities of the students and contribute to the overarching development and advancement of the nation. It also strives to create an intellectually stimulating and culturally diverse environment that prepares competent professionals and leaders who are able to use a variety of methodologies, skills and strategies necessary to provide effective and creative solutions in Nepal and worldwide. MISSION The School of Humanities and Social Sciences aims at strengthening the University’s capacities in learning, teaching and research in the field of humanities and social sciences by promoting the development of the students and of their competencies by fostering critical thinking skills, enhancing students’ creativity, preparing them for professional careers and exposing them to an integrated approach of the relevant social, economic, political and cultural components of the human development. The School seeks to implement these purposes by pursuing specific core strengths, which are: scholarship, creativity, academic freedom and accountability, creation and disseminations of new knowledge, social and cultural relevance, diversity and flexibility across the disciplines. These core strengths find full application in an environment which is cultural diverse, respectful of diversity and human dignity and inclusive of all individual and collective effort.

description: MRM College is located at Banasthali, Kathmandu. It was set up in 2007 with the efforts of the proactive academicians aiming to impact competitive and quality education to the students as per the demands of the contemporary world. The principal objective behind its establishment is to prepare individuals equipped with experienced academic and social qualities to be able to a range of his/her career aspects. name: Shepherd College
description:
Shepherd College is located in New Baneshwor, Kathmandu. It was established in 2002 A.D. to provide a value-based education. The College offers a Bachelor of Media Technology (BMT), Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT) and Master of Media Technology (MMT) with affiliation from Purbanchal University.The college has helped generate several Batches every year in BMT and MMT and getting proficient in Media, IT and Mass communication skills. As a first media technology education hub in Nepal, it has been arming its students with top journalism courses and practical experiences that align with their desired dream job for more than a decade. Academic courses of excellence are a big asset of the college on one hand and catering frequently and regularly the training and orientations to the mid-career journalists and media people on the other hand, where students can also join these activities. Apart from providing its students with a dynamic, practical environment, the college believes it is its duty to help students design creative approaches to overcome numerous hurdles. This persistent and consistent effort of the faculty, students, and alumni has helped it hold a top-notch position in Media Education in Nepal. With the increasing demand for media positions, Shepherd College of Media Technology has expanded its program from Bachelor of Media Technology to Master of Media Technology. Recognizing the need for a four-year bachelor's degree in media, the college expanded the three-year Bachelor of Media Technology course into a four-year program. This has enabled its students to gain recognition abroad for university admissions and global jobs.Shepherd College emphasizes imparting quality education and fostering an amicable teaching-learning atmosphere on campus. Its goal is to have a dynamic and extensive applied research program that provides practical solutions to real-world issues.The college aims to provide active learning environments with top notch Media and Journalism courses to students with practices in up-to-date Media technologies and resources. Shepherd College believes it is the duty to give back to the community and Media Industry by providing them with skilled individuals expert in Media and Information Technology. The college provides the advanced and intensive Media and Media Technology course in Nepal that aims to help its students get a foothold in the Media market and build their way towards success. It has a mission to equip students with creativity, morality, and competence that make them the leader in the Media industry.

header.classList.add('header--scrolled'); } else if (isScrolled && scrollPos College of Natural Resource Management (CNRM), Madichaur, Rolpa Home Faculty of Agriculture (FOA) College of Natural Resource Management (CNRM), Madichaur, Rolpa About College of Natural Resource Management (CNRM), Madichaur, Rolpa is the one of the constituent college under Faculty of Agriculture at Agriculture and Forestry University (AFU), the only state-owned technical university of Nepal. Established on 3rd February, 2020, the college currently has four batch under its undergraduate program on agriculture i.e. B.Sc. Ag with total of 150 students. The college officially started its classes from 26th February, 2020. The college is situated at Madichaur, Rolpa Municipality, Rolpa, Province 5 of Nepal. The college represents the mid hill ecology of Nepal (995 masl) and can be accessed via road (120 km from East West Highway-Bhalubang and just 9 km from district headquarter, Libang) in all seasons. Equipped with majestic views and pleasing topography, the college sits at the lap of ancient settlement area of Rolpa. Fragrance of cultural diversity and natural beauty are among the most iconic features of this area.

Though being a youngest college under AFU, the college has excellent academic environment and well-equipped laboratory to propel the technical knowledge. The college has well spacious classrooms, modern seminar hall, equipped library, internet facility, drinking water facility, power backup, playground and acres of cultivable land to address the need of the students for quality education. College has maintained a cordial relationship with the community and students will feel at home in this environment. The college plans to conduct regular community programs like plant clinic, soil testing camps, seed testing and frequent field visits to make the students more connected to the community. Human Resources: The college has currently 5 permanent faculties and 8 administrative staffs along with 5 contract based supporting staffs. Faculties from the central university, other universities, other colleges are engaged on course basis. Apart from these, guest lectures from renowned experts and scholars across the globe will also be utilized to sharpen the knowledge of the students. Infrastructure Facilities: The college currently has one academic building (Four storied with 8 rooms), one faculty guest house (3 rooms) and a VIP guest house at Madichaur. Apart from it, lab structures like fishery pond, poultry cages, goat and sheep shed, separate laboratory for field exercises are also available. The college has almost 90 ropanis of land where the construction process for bigger infrastructures is expected to commence in near future. We currently have separate laboratory facilities as Field Lab (Agronomy and Horticulture), Soil Lab, Basic Science Lab (Crop Physiology, Biochemistry), Plant Protection Lab (Entomology and Pathology), LPM and Fisheries Lab at the college premises. Apart from all these lab, we are also planning for operation of service lab to deliver the basic soil testing and seed testing facilities to the farmers. Academic Program: 4 years (8 Semester) Undergraduate Program in Agriculture, B.Sc.Ag Criteria for Admission : As per the Entrance Examination Result published by AFU. Courses and Delivery: As per the AFU Bulletin.

Its excellence in teaching, research and outreach activities in agriculture has been recognized both at national and international level. This faculty has 9 departments, 2 centers consisting 52 highly qualified faculty members involved in teaching undergraduate and post graduate courses with the support of a team of 67 administrative and technical staff members. Recently, this faculty has expanded its undergraduate program (B.Sc.Ag.) through College of Natural Resources Management, Puranchaur in Kaski.

It encourages, facilitates and supports faculty members and students for research and scholarly activities relevant to the needs of concerned stakeholders. The FOA fosters student self-development, commitment and responsibility for welfare of Nepalese society through imparting the knowledge regarding modernization and commercialization of agriculture sector in sustainable manner.

name: KAHS
description:
Karnali Academy of Health Sciences (KAHS)  has been established in October 20, 2011 (2068/07/03), by an Act of parliament of Nepal by upgrading existing Karnali Zonal Hospital at Jumla. The goal of KAHS is to enable an access in Quality healthcare services and education for the people of backward (Pichhadiyako) areas in affordable cost by establishing health institute at Jumla and KAHS working district to produce skilled health professionals to deliver quality health care services and conduct health researches. The backward areas (9 districts) mentioned in act of KAHS are  Karnali Zone : Humla, Jumla, Kalikot, Dolpa, Mugu districts,  Bheri Zone : Jajarkot district,  Seti Zone : Bajura, Bajhang & Achham districts and remaining districts of  Karnali Pradesh  Includes Surkhet, Dailekh, Rukum and Salyan according to federal system of Nepal.

The Nepal government owned Karnali Zonal hospital and started its services as  Karnali Academy of Health Sciences, Teaching hospital  from 17th Kartik, 2069. From the very beginning the teaching hospital has started outpatient, inpatients, diagnostic services (Lab, X-ray, USG, ECG etc) and operation theatre in existed facility. The services have been upgraded and expanded its scope of services in health care and academy each year.

There are 10 districts (Jumla, Dolpa, Humla, Mugu, Kalikot, Rukum-west, Jajarkot, Salyan and Surkeht) in Karnali Province. Karnali is the largest province of  Nepal  with an area of 24,453 km2 (% of total area). The population of the province is 1,701,800, (% of total population) which is least in ranking of province. The province is surrounded by  Gandaki  province in east,  Province No. 5  in south-east, and south, province No. 7 is in west and  China  in north.

There is high mountains land in north and mid hills. There is a Kubi Gangri, Changla and Kanjiroba Mountain in north. The  Shey Phoksundo National Park  with  Phoksundo lake  is the largest national park of Nepal and  Rara lake  is the largest lake of Nepal which are located in Karnali Pradesh.  Karnali River  is the biggest river of the province and longest river of Nepal. 

Karnali Academy of Health Sciences prepares the next generation of health professionals and leaders to become vital contributors to the delivery and advancement of health care to those who are marginalized and living in backward areas. Our mission is accomplished through educational excellence, innovative research, evidence-informed patient-centered care, public health advocacy, and collaborative community engagement.

KAHS is an autonomous health sciences university that visualize at providing interdisciplinary leadership for new directions in health promotion and wellness, as well as illness care and disease prevention at all levels, in the community and beyond through innovation in education, practice, research, and scholarship for Nepalese students, especially targeting to those who reside in backward and rural area as well as those who are socially marginalized. It will be a national centre for providing health services, prestigious centre for biomedical and health system research, centre for excellence in implementing complete total human development through \\\'health\\\' as main agenda in its neighboring teaching districts.

name: Model Purbanchal College
description:
Model Purbanchal College, located in Janakpur, is an academic institution dedicated to providing quality education in a supportive learning environment. With a long-standing history of academic service, the college focuses on developing skilled and responsible individuals across various disciplines. The institution’s main building is situated on a spacious campus, offering a comprehensive classroom experience that encourages both lectures and active student participation.The college provides a sound academic atmosphere supported by well-facilitated infrastructure, including digital classrooms, modern science and computer laboratories, and a well-managed library. Experienced faculty members ensure that students receive a balance of theoretical knowledge and practical exposure. Beyond academics, the institution emphasizes holistic growth through career counseling, industrial visits, and co-curricular activities. Guided by values such as honesty, responsibility, and discipline, Model Purbanchal College strives to empower learners to become independent human resources ready to meet the challenges of the professional world while contributing to the transformation of society through education.

Listed by Purbanchal University. Approved programs: BBA-144, MBA (Spring)-33; BIT-48

name: Morang Model Campus
description:
Morang Model Campus (MMC) was established in 2010 AD (2067 BS) as a community-owned higher educational institution. It is located in Urlabari-6, Morang, Koshi Province of Nepal. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU) and offers a Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) program. 

Affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU), the campus follows TU’s official curriculum and examination system, so students can earn nationally recognized degrees without having to leave their hometown.

MMC was started with a simple but important goal: to make higher education accessible to students in Morang and nearby districts. Today, it offers programs like the Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) , ideal for those who want to build careers in management, commerce, and related fields.

For many students, studying at MMC means they can enjoy quality university-level education while staying close to family and friends. It’s a chance to save on living costs, remain connected to their community, and still aim high in their academic and career ambitions.

With approachable teachers, relevant courses, and strong ties to the community, Morang Model Campus has become a place where local students can take confident steps toward building their future—without losing their roots.

MMC also provides quality education with a 100% scholarship for deserving and financially deprived students.

name: Muktimarga Secondary School
description:
Muktimarga Secondary School (मुक्तिमार्ग माध्यामिक विद्यालय, म्याग्दी) is a public academic institute located in  Annapurna Rural Municipality , Ghar, Myagdi district,  Gandaki Province  of Nepal. It is affiliated to National Examinations Board (NEB) and approved by Ministry of Education, Nepal. This Secondary School offers Ten Plus Two under Education and Management Streams.

Muktimarga Secondary School, Ghar, Myagdi provides a Pre-primary level to secondary (10+2) level education with minimal and affordable fees structures. It also offers scholarships schemes for deserving, hardworking and the underprivileged students of the society. Muktimarga Secondary School provides Counseling,  Sports, Educational tours, Multimedia, Extra-curricular Activities (ECA), Conference Hall, Conference, Classrooms, and scholarships facilities.

Before 2048 BS (1992 AD), there was not any institution of higher education in Myagdi District. The absence of educational opportunities after SLC created an urgent social demand for establishment of a campus in the district. Prior to the establishment of Myagdi Multiple Campus (MMC), most of the students of this region had to go to Kathmandu, Pokhara or outside Beni for further studies after passing the SLC. The people of Myagdi thus took the initiative for the establishment of a campus. As a result, Myagdi Campus later renamed as Myagdi Multiple Campus was established in 2048 BS. Financial and other resources required for the establishment of the campus were raised from the efforts of local people and Myagdi people who were living in Kathmandu.
