Janakpurdham, Madhesh, Nepal 26°43′43″N 85°55′30″E +977-41590931 [email protected]

Founded in October 2017 by the legislature-parliament, Rajarshi Janak University stands as a testament to Nepal’s commitment to advancing education, particularly in the Madhesh Province. The university’s establishment was formalized through the passage of a bill. Nestled in the cultural heart of Janakpur, the institution draws its name from the esteemed King Janak, a legendary figure in Mithila. This naming reflects a deep connection to the region’s rich heritage, symbolizing a commitment to preserving and advancing traditional values within a contemporary educational framework.

The university’s infrastructure is a blend of collaborative efforts and independent initiatives. While some facilities were provided by Tribhuvan University based on governmental decisions, Rajarshi Janak University has taken strides in establishing its own infrastructure. This strategic combination reflects the institution’s dedication to academic autonomy and self-sufficiency, ensuring a holistic approach to educational development and fostering a dynamic environment for both faculty and students.

Rajarshi Janak University is committed to fostering an inclusive and transformative learning environment that empowers individuals to excel academically, ethically, and socially. Our mission is to provide holistic education, integrating traditional wisdom with modern knowledge, and to cultivate graduates who are not only proficient in their respective fields but also possess a deep sense of responsibility, ethical conduct, and social awareness. Through cutting-edge research, innovative teaching methodologies, and a dedication to social responsibility, we strive to contribute meaningfully to local, national, and global communities.

Our vision at Rajarshi Janak University is to be a beacon of academic excellence, recognized globally for our commitment to holistic education, research, and community engagement. We envision a university where students are inspired to become leaders and innovators, grounded in the values of excellence, freedom, responsibility, and ethical conduct. With a focus on co-existence, creativity, and environmental responsibility, we aspire to shape individuals who contribute positively to the ever-evolving needs of society.

The overarching goal of Rajarshi Janak University is to emerge as a dynamic center for learning and research, fostering an environment that encourages intellectual curiosity, critical thinking, and innovation. We aim to continually enhance our academic programs, ensuring relevance to the evolving needs of various industries and society at large. Our goal is to expand access to quality education, promote interdisciplinary collaboration, and contribute significantly to the sustainable development of our nation and beyond. Through strategic partnerships and a commitment to democratic participatory governance, we strive to achieve academic excellence while upholding the values that define our institution.

It is a full time, two-year program stretched over six trimesters. MBA students are required to complete 66 credits including 27 courses, 3 practicum and seminars, 8 weeks internship and a Graduate Research Project Report (GRP).

Masters of Business Administration (MBA-Jobholder) is a general management degree taught from a global perspective that prepares students for a range of management careers. It is a full time, the 32-month program spread over eight trimesters. Students are required to complete 66 credits including 27 courses, 3 practicum and seminars, 8 weeks internship and a Graduate Research Project Report (GRP). The program is designed to meet the needs of working professionals who want to earn an MBA degree. However, it is equally useful for those looking for a challenging graduate business education that features experiential learning opportunities and a strong global focus. These courses aim to prepare managers who are well-conversant various latest managerial concepts, tools and techniques.

Bachelors of Business Administration (BBA) is a four-year, eight-semester, 120 credit hour bachelor level management program. The curriculum aims to provide students with a comprehensive knowledge of mathematics, economics, accounting, finance, human resource and marketing. The BBA program aims to expand knowledge and improves skills in the area of management in general and anyone concentration area in particular. The curriculum is designed to equip students with the competencies, knowledge, skills, and attitudes needed for success in the management field. The coursework gives students a broad and holistic view of the challenges in today’s business environment. The BBA program provides students basis for career growth and prepares them for higher studies.

name: Thrangu Sekhar Retreat Centre
address: Bhaktapur (eastern rim of Kathmandu Valley), near Milarepa practice site
description:
Thrangu Sekhar Retreat Centre is situated in the hills forming the eastern rim of the Kathmandu Valley, just below a cave where the revered Tibetan yogi, Milarepa, practised. It was established in 2004 by the Lord of Refuge, Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche, to serve as the main retreat for the Thrangu Monastery lamas selected to undertake the traditional three-year three-fortnight retreat. Thrangu Rinpoche named the retreat ‘Sekhar’ after the famous tower built by Milarepa during his arduous training under Marpa Lotsawa.

Several lamas are resident and teaching in the retreat centre: Drupon Khen Rinpoche Karma Lhabu, Drupon Lama Dawa Phurba, Drupon Khenpo Wangchuk, Lama Samten from Ganden monastery, Geshe Sonam Drakpa who was invited from Drepung.

The dharma activities of Thrangu Sekhar Retreat Centre are overseen by Drupon Khen Rinpoche, who has introduced a number of initiatives to further the retreat centre’s scope to benefit sentient beings and the buddha-dharma. These include: – A six-year retreat programme for students of all nationalities and backgrounds – A study & practice curriculum in the tantric tradition of Marpa for the ever-increasing number of children that are being nurtured in the retreat centre and for the international retreatants who are proficient in the Tibetan language – Thrangu Sekhar Institute of Meditation in collaboration with Lumbini Buddhist University offering university degrees in Buddhist Mind Training – The Thrangu Sekhar One-Week Retreat, a one-week retreat that is held annually for aspiring retreatants.

These activities run alongside the primary focus of the retreat centre, the traditional three-year three-fortnight retreat programme for the Thrangu Monastery lamas.

At the time of writing, eight cycles of three-year three-fortnight retreat have been completed at the retreat centre; the ninth cycle and tenth cycles are ongoing. One six-year retreat has been completed and the second and third are ongoing.

There are currently more than 180 people practising long-term in the retreat centre: 24 Thrangu gompa lamas and nuns in the three-year three-fortnight retreat, 68 international students in the six-year retreat, and 83 children in the Study & Practice Curriculum in the Tantric Tradition of Marpa.

description: Santpur Chandraniyahapur Multiple Campus is located in Chandrapur (Chandranigahapur), Rautahat. It provides higher education opportunities in management, education, and humanities under the affiliation of Tribhuvan University.

name: Shree Juddha Multiple Campus
description: Shree Juddha Multiple Campus is situated in Gaur, Rautahat, offering higher education programs affiliated with Tribhuvan University.

name: Brijlal Prasad Koirala Memorial Campus
address: Gujara Municipality, Rautahat, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Brijlal Prasad Koirala Memorial Campus is a community-based higher education institution located in Gujara Municipality (Simra Bhawanipur), Rautahat district, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.

name: Rolpa Multiple Campus
address: Liwang, Rolpa Municipality-2, Rolpa, Lumbini Province, Nepal
description: Rolpa Multiple Campus was established in 2049 BS (1992 AD) as a community-based campus in the Rolpa district of Lumbini Province, Nepal. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and offers various undergraduate and certificate level programs in humanities, management, and education streams to cater to the higher educational needs of students in the remote hilly region.

name: Rukum East Multiple Campus
address: Sisne-5, Rukumkot, Rukum East, Lumbini Province, Nepal
description: Rukum East Multiple Campus is a community-owned higher education institution located in the Rukum East district of Lumbini Province, Nepal. Established to expand access to higher education for students in remote hilly regions, it offers undergraduate programs affiliated with Tribhuvan University.

name: Rukum Campus
address: Musikot, Rukum West, Karnali Province, Nepal
description: Rukum Campus provides higher education opportunities in management, education, and humanities disciplines to students in the Rukum West region.

name: Jajarkot-Rukum Polytechnic Institute (Rukum West Extension/Program)
description: Jajarkot-Rukum Polytechnic Institute operates under the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT), offering diploma and certificate level technical programs in engineering and allied health sectors.

name: Salyan Multiple Campus
address: Sharada-1, Srinagar, Salyan, Karnali Province, Nepal
description: Salyan Multiple Campus is a community-owned higher education institution located in Sharada Municipality, Salyan, Karnali Province, Nepal. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, it offers undergraduate and intermediate programs in humanities, management, and education streams.

name: Kapurkot Multiple Campus
description: Kapurkot Multiple Campus is a community higher education institution established to serve students in the Kapurkot rural municipality area of Salyan district, offering programs affiliated with recognized national universities.

name: Mahendra Bindeshwori Multiple Campus
description: Mahendra Bindeshwori Multiple Campus is a constituent campus of Tribhuvan University, situated in Rajbiraj, Saptari district. Established in 1958, it offers various programs in humanities, management, science, and education.

name: Hariwan Multiple Campus
description: Hariwan Multiple Campus is a leading community higher education institution located in Hariwan municipality of Sarlahi district. Established with the active participation of local academics, social workers, and community members, the campus provides affordable quality education in humanities, management, and education streams.

name: Lalbandi Multiple Campus
description: Lalbandi Multiple Campus serves as a vital institution for higher education in Lalbandi and surrounding regions of Sarlahi. It offers programs in management and education faculties, catering to local students seeking affordable university education.

name: Nawalpur Multiple Campus
description: Nawalpur Multiple Campus is established to serve the educational needs of students in Ishworpur municipality and surrounding areas of Sarlahi district. It operates under Tribhuvan University affiliation, offering foundational degree programs in management and education.

name: Sarlahi Technical School
description: Sarlahi Technical School provides diploma and technical certificate programs in various engineering and health disciplines under the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT).

name: Mid-Western University Central Campus
description: Mid-Western University (MWU) is a governmental university established in 2010 located in Birendranagar, Surkhet, Karnali Province, Nepal. The Central Campus offers multiple undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs across faculties like Science and Technology, Humanities and Social Sciences, Management, Education, and Engineering.

name: Birendranagar Multiple Campus
description: Birendranagar Multiple Campus serves the higher education needs of students in Surkhet district by offering affordable undergraduate programs.

name: Syangja Multiple Campus
description: Syangja Multiple Campus was established in 1980 as a community campus to provide affordable and quality higher education to students in the Syangja district and surrounding regions. It offers various programs in humanities, management, and education faculties under Tribhuvan University.

name: Taplejung Multiple Campus
description: Taplejung Multiple Campus is a prominent constituent campus of Tribhuvan University in the mountainous district of Taplejung, Koshi Province. It serves students from Taplejung and surrounding remote areas by offering streams in Humanities, Management, and Education.

name: Terhathum Multiple Campus
description: Terhathum Multiple Campus is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and offers various undergraduate and education programs to students in the Koshi province region. It plays a vital role in providing accessible higher education in the hilly terrain of Terhathum.

name: Lumbini Adarsha Degree College
description: Lumbini Adarsha Degree College is a community college in Kawasoti. A public listing describes it as a place to pursue higher studies.

name: Jana Adarsha Multiple Campus
description: Jana Adarsha Multiple Campus is listed in Birendranagar. The phone on that listing, 056-419023, uses a Chitwan area code, so the place and the phone may not belong to the same campus.

name: Nepal Aadarsh Secondary School and College
description: Nepal Aadarsh Secondary School and College is listed as a private college in Waling, Syangja, with the phone 061-696474.

name: Tribhuvan Adarsha Multiple Campus
description: Tribhuvan Adarsha Multiple Campus is in Putalibazar, Syangja. A public listing calls it a well-known campus of Syangja and gives the phone 063-424380.

name: Sahid Adarsha Campus
description: Sahid Adarsha Campus is a community campus in Kageshwori Manohara, Kathmandu, and a public note says it is affiliated to Tribhuvan University.

name: Uma Badi Adarsha Sherchan College
description: Uma Badi Adarsha Sherchan College is listed in Dibyanagar, with the phone 056-620721.

name: Aadarsha Higher Secondary School
description: Aadarsha Higher Secondary School (आदर्श उच्च माध्यमिक विद्यालय) is listed in Ramgram, with the phone 078-520300.

name: Laxmi Adarsha Multiple Campus
description: Laxmi Adarsha Multiple Campus is listed in Lekhnath, with the phone 980-6546797. This is not Laxmi Adarsha Secondary School in Sishuwa.

name: Bhakti Adarsha Multiple Campus
description: Bhakti Adarsha Multiple Campus is a community campus in Bhoteodar, Sundarbazar-9, Lamjung. CollegeNP says it was established in 1999 and is affiliated to Tribhuvan University for B.Ed. and BBS.

name: Hetauda School of Management and Social Sciences
name_ne: हेटौंडा स्कुल अफ म्यानेज्मेन्ट एन्ड सोसियल साइन्स
description: Hetauda School of Management and Social Sciences is a private college in Hetauda. This is not Hetauda School of Management Secondary School.

name: Makwanpur Technical Institute
description: Makwanpur Technical Institute is listed as a technical school in Hetauda, with the phone 057-521852.

name: T.M.M.H.S.S and Narayani College
description: T.M.M.H.S.S and Narayani College is listed in Hetauda, with the phone 057-522136.

name: iTech Univ Plus
description: iTech Univ Plus is listed in Hetauda, with the phone 057-526770.

name: Palung Multiple Campus
description: Palung Multiple Campus is listed in Thaha, Makwanpur. No phone was on that listing.

name: Hetauda City College
description: Hetauda City College, also listed as Zenith, is in Hetauda. No phone was on that listing.

name: Nawodit Nepal College
description: Nawodit Nepal College is listed in Hetauda, with the phone 057-526840.

name: Churiyamai Technical College
description: Churiyamai Technical College is listed as a technical school in Hetauda, with the phone 985-5036291.

name: Parbat Multiple Campus
description: Parbat Multiple Campus is listed at Devisthan, Phalewas, Parbat, with the phone 067-430032.

name: Shree Nava Jagrit Multiple Campus
description: Shree Nava Jagrit Multiple Campus is listed at Dimuwa, Parbat. No phone was on that listing.

name: Huwas Multiple College
description: Huwas Multiple College is listed at Huwas, Mardikhola, Parbat. No phone was on that listing.

name: Bhairab Higher Secondary School
description: Bhairab Higher Secondary School is listed at Bhakunde, Parbat. The listing calls it a community college, while the name is a higher secondary school.

name: Janasewa Sanskrit Higher College
description: Janasewa Sanskrit Higher College is listed at Huwas, Mardikhola, Parbat. No phone was on that listing.

name: Kumarwarti Multiple Campus
description: Community campus in Kawasoti offering +2, bachelor, and master programs affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Established in 2045 BS.

name: Madhyabindu Multiple Campus
description: Community campus in Kawasoti offering bachelor and master programs affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Accredited by the University Grants Commission. Established in 2062 BS.

name: Shree Shadananda Multiple Campus
address: Shadananda Municipality Ward No. 7, Dingla, Bhojpur, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established with local participation and affiliated to Tribhuvan University in 2067 BS (2010 AD). Named after educationist and social reformer Balaguru Shadananda. It offers four-year B.Ed. and BBS programs aimed at students in the northern part of Bhojpur, including women, Dalit, indigenous and marginalized students. B.Ed. subjects published by the campus and its reports include English Education, Nepali Education, Economics Education, Health and Physical Education, Population Education and Educational Planning and Management. The campus website's master's page did not publish a running master's program.

name: Sumnima Polytechnic Institute
address: Bhojpur Municipality-6, Deurali, Bhojpur, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: CTEVT constituent technical institute established in 2069 BS at Deurali. It produces middle-level technical workers in construction and agriculture. Published diploma programs are Civil Engineering (48 seats), Agriculture (Plant Science) (40 seats) and Agriculture (Animal Science) (40 seats), each three years after SEE, plus shorter vocational training. The institute describes itself as a CTEVT constituent school. A regular-program fee of NPR 50,000 for three years, applicable from admission year 2080/81, is published on the civil and plant-science course pages.

name: Shreeram Mithila Polytechnic Institute
address: Ramprasad Rai Rural Municipality-5, Aambote (Manebhanjyang), Bhojpur, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: CTEVT constituent polytechnic at Aambote, described by the institute as founded in 2076 BS and the seventh constituent institute in Koshi Province. The building was inaugurated on 14 December 2022. The official site says it offers three-year full-time diploma programs in agriculture. The confirmed running program is Diploma in Agriculture (Plant Science). Shorter pre-diploma programs were described as proposed, not as currently offered, on an institute admission post. No published fee was found on the institute website.

name: College of Natural Resource Management, Pakhribas
description: Constituent college of Agriculture and Forestry University under the Faculty of Agriculture, and described by AFU as the only AFU agriculture college in Koshi Province. Approved by a special AFU Senate meeting on 18 April 2017 and established in 2074 BS. Located at about 1,730 metres elevation. The college reports about 100 ropanis of land, its own academic, administrative, laboratory, library, and smart-classroom buildings, plus agronomy and horticulture fields and a playground. As of 13 July 2025, the eighth batch was enrolled and three batches had graduated.

name: Gokundeshwar Campus
address: Dhankuta Municipality-5, Balmandir, near Tundikhel, Dhankutanagar, Dhankuta
description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-recognized. Founded in 2067 BS (2010 AD). It offers the four-year Bachelor of Business Studies. Nepal Public Campus Association lists establishment date 2067-04-24 and QAA status as not applied. It appears on a TU BBS second-year 2081 exam-centre list.

name: Tulasi Mehar College
address: Hulak Tole and Thadobazar Street, Dhankuta Municipality, Dhankuta
description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-recognized. It offers Bachelor of Business Studies. Some directories label it a public institution. It appears on the TU BBS second-year 2081 exam-centre list. Establishment year of the bachelor campus is not published on the pages reviewed.

name: Bhasha Campus
description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-recognized. Directory accounts say it was founded in 2064 BS / 2008 AD and that it was the first community non-profit campus in Dhankuta. It offers Bachelor of Business Studies. UGC HEIMS 2081/82 lists Bhasha Campus, Dhankuta, with a B.B.S. programme and 43 students. It appears on the TU BBS second-year 2081 exam-centre list.

name: Budhuk Campus
description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-recognized. Campus accounts say it was established in 2069 BS (2012 AD); some directories also print 2011. It offers Bachelor of Education. UGC HEIMS 2081/82 lists Budhuk Campus, Dhankuta, with a B.Ed. programme and 85 students. A campus site describes it as a community campus providing higher education in rural Dhankuta since 2069 BS.

name: Uttarpani Polytechnic Institute
description: CTEVT constituent polytechnic, described as the oldest TVET school in eastern Nepal and the second constituent school of CTEVT. Established in 2040 BS. The campus is described as covering 44.25 hectares (865 ropani). It runs three-year diplomas in agriculture (plant science and animal science) and pharmacy, plus 18-month pre-diploma agriculture programmes and short vocational courses. From FY 2080/81 it has taught Diploma in Pharmacy under a special scholarship programme.

name: Dhankuta Institute of Health Science
description: Private CTEVT-affiliated health institute established in 2055 BS (1998 AD) at Bich Bazar, Dhankuta Municipality ward 6. Accredited by the Nepal Health Professional Council. Published programme lists include PCL/Diploma in General Medicine (Health Assistant), and also ANM and TSLC/CMA. A CTEVT 2083 diploma and certificate exam-centre notice lists the institute among Dhankuta centres.

name: Millennium Technical Institute
description: CTEVT technical institute in Dhankuta. Edusanjal lists TSLC in Medical Laboratory Technology. A CollegeNP course page and a 2082/83 CTEVT CMLT college list name Millennium Technical Institute, Dhankuta, for the three-year Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology. A CTEVT 2083 diploma and certificate exam-centre notice also lists Millenium Technical Institute, Dhankuta. Phone, email, and establishment year were not published on the pages reviewed.

name: University Campus, Rajarshi Janak University
description: Constituent University Campus of Rajarshi Janak University in Janakpurdham. Edusanjal lists bachelor and master programs in IT, agriculture, management, law, journalism, public health and laboratory technology.

name: Madhesh Institute of Health Sciences
description: Autonomous provincial health-sciences institute established under the Madhesh Institute of Health Science Act 2077. Public pages describe undergraduate teaching in medicine, nursing, public health and medical laboratory technology, with postgraduate MD/MS preparation reported in 2026.

name: Shree Mithila Ayurveda College and Research Centre
description: Ayurveda college established in 2063 BS under Nepal Sanskrit University and approved by the Nepal Ayurvedic Medical Council. It offers BAMS, including a one-year internship, and operates a teaching hospital.

name: Janak Hajari Vidyapeeth
description: Constituent vidyapeeth of Nepal Sanskrit University in Janakpurdham. Published accounts say it began with Uttar Madhyama and later added Shastri-level classes, with land, teaching buildings, hostel and library. Establishment year is published as 2047 BS on Collegenp and 2049 on Edusanjal.

name: Janakpur Campus
description: Community campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University and also running NEB +2 programs. Higher-education offerings published are B.Ed. and M.Ed.

name: Gauri Campus
address: Bhanu Chowk, Kishorinagar, Janakpur, Dhanusa, Nepal
description: Public campus offering the four-year TU Bachelor of Education, with major and minor subject specializations for secondary teaching.

name: BP Koirala Campus
description: Community campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University and approved by UGC Nepal, focused on bachelor-level education.

name: Public Youth Campus
description: Private campus established in 1998 and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Published bachelor programs are BBS, B.Ed. and BCA.

name: Mithila College
description: Public campus established in 2000 and listed as offering TU Bachelor of Business Studies. Some published phone and email details overlap with Mithila Institute of Technology listings and should be verified directly.

name: Mithila Institute of Technology
address: Bishara Chowk-4, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Private institution at Bishara Chowk listing bachelor programs under more than one university, including BBS, BBA and BSc CSIT. Its website also advertises BA, law and MBS. Establishment year is not used here because directory dates conflict with the school history on the campus site.

name: Universal Academy College
address: Janakpurdham-9, near north of Sankat Mochan Mandir, Dhanusa, Nepal
description: College established in 1999. Collegenp lists TU bachelor programs in education and management in addition to +2 streams.

name: New Millennium College of Education
description: Private college established in 2009 offering TU bachelor programs in management and education, with morning and evening shifts, in addition to +2 programs.

name: City College Janakpur
description: Edusanjal lists City College as a private institution in Janakpurdham affiliated with Tribhuvan University and offering BBS. No further public contact or fee details were found on the opened page.

name: Shree Tapasi Baba College
address: Hansapur Municipality-6, Tilhi, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Public/community college established in 2012 at Tilhi, affiliated with Tribhuvan University for a four-year B.Ed. program.

name: Vigyan Adhyayan Kendra Campus
address: Tirhutiagachhi, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2051 BS. It runs +2 programs and a TU-affiliated four-year B.Ed.

name: Central Engineering College
address: Ramanand Chowk, Janakpurdham-8, Dhanusa, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Private engineering college at Ramanand Chowk. Collegenp lists Purbanchal University bachelor programs and CTEVT diploma and pre-diploma programs. Published establishment years conflict between 1992 and 2066 BS, so the year is left unset.

name: Nepal Technical Institute
description: CTEVT-affiliated technical institute established in 2005, offering diploma programs in engineering, nursing, pharmacy and laboratory technology. It is described as a sister organization of Central Engineering College.

name: Model Purbanchal College
description: Private college established in 2009 and affiliated with Purbanchal University. Published programs are BIT, BBA and MBA.

name: Janaki College of Management
address: Janakpurdham-4, Pidariya Mai Sthan, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Management college established in 2008 and listed by Purbanchal University Faculty of Management for BBA with 144 seats.

name: Model Multiple College
address: Janakpur-4, Ramchowk, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Private college established in 1997. Collegenp lists university bachelor and master programs and CTEVT health programs, plus +2 streams.

name: Model Medical Institute
description: Private CTEVT health institute offering diploma-level general medicine and medical laboratory technology. It is described as a sister institution of Model Multiple College.

name: Janaki College for Professional Studies
address: Akshar Vidya Mandir, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: College established in 2022 and associated with the Lord Buddha Education Foundation group. It offers a Kathmandu University Bachelor of Technical Education in Information Technology.

name: Siddhartha International College
description: College established in 2079 BS at Bhanu Chowk and affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University for BBA. This is distinct from the similarly named college in Butwal.

name: Krishna Medical and Technical Research Centre
description: Purbanchal University health institution offering public health, pharmacy and nursing degrees. Nursing education is described as accredited by the Nepal Nursing Council, with a 100-bed hospital for practicum.

name: Janakpur Nursing Campus
address: Devi Chowk-10, near Janakpur Zonal Hospital, Janakpurdham, Dhanusa, Nepal
description: Private nursing campus established in 2000, affiliated with CTEVT and accredited by the Nepal Nursing Council. It offers a three-year PCL Nursing program with 40 seats.

name: National Human Resource Development Academy
description: Private CTEVT health institute established in 2002, accredited by the Nepal Nursing Council and Nepal Health Professional Council. Published programs include PCL Nursing and CMLT.

name: Valley College of Engineering
description: Private CTEVT institute established in 2010. It ran Diploma in Civil Engineering in Kathmandu until 2023 and is listed as having moved to Janakpur in 2024.

name: Care Medical Center
description: Private CTEVT health training institute established in 2008. Published programs are PCL Nursing and PCL General Medicine, each with 40 seats.

name: Ram Janaki Health Foundation
description: Private foundation that manages Janaki Medical College and is also the named admitting institution for CTEVT certificate-level nursing seats in Janakpur. A 2082 notice invited applications for vacant full-fee PCL Nursing seats.

name: Nepal College of Nursing and Health Science
description: A CTEVT institutional list and a Dhanusa business listing describe a private nursing college in Janakpur offering PCL Nursing with 40 seats. A similarly named college is also published in Birgunj, so the Dhanusha record should be confirmed with CTEVT before admission.

name: Garuwa Multiple Campus
address: Mai Municipality-2, Sittali, Danabari, Ilam, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2064 BS (2008 AD) at Danabari in Mai Municipality. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and offers a Bachelor of Education program. Nepal Public Campus Association lists its QAA status as not applied.

name: Ekatappa Multiple Campus
description: Community campus established in 2069 BS (2012 AD) at Ektappa, Phakphokthum Rural Municipality. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and approved by the University Grants Commission, and offers a four-year Bachelor of Education.

name: Atmananda Multiple Campus
description: Community campus in Mangsebung Rural Municipality, named after Kirat religious leader Atmananda Lingden. A 2074 BS news report said four-year B.Ed. classes under Tribhuvan University began that year, initially at the local Bhalutar secondary school, with 36 students in the first year. Current directory listings still show only the B.Ed. program.

name: Modern Campus Ilam
description: Campus established in 2062 BS (2005 AD) at Ilam-3 and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Directory listings describe it as a private campus offering Bachelor of Business Studies and Bachelor of Arts, with scholarships for talented and economically disadvantaged students.

name: Ratna Kumar Bantawa Polytechnic Institute
description: CTEVT constituent polytechnic established in 2074 BS (2017 AD) at Sakhejung. Institute and directory pages describe it as a public technical institute on a large site and list diploma programs in agriculture, forestry, pharmacy, and civil engineering. A pre-diploma in tea technology is also mentioned, but that is below diploma level.

name: Sunrise Engineering College
address: Silikhan, Ilam Municipality Ward No. 9, near Mount Mechi Boarding School, Ilam, Nepal
description: CTEVT-affiliated technical college in Ilam-9 offering three-year diploma programs after SEE/SLC. Public listings and a CTEVT institute dataset name Diploma in Forestry and Diploma in Civil Engineering. It appears as an examination institute assigned to an Ilam exam centre.

name: Chisapani Campus
address: Jantedhunga Rural Municipality-5, Chisapani, Khotang, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2069 BS (2012 AD) at Chisapani, affiliated to Tribhuvan University. Published pages describe a four-year B.Ed. under the Faculty of Education. It is one of seven TU community campuses named in a 2025 district report.

name: Halesi Campus
address: Halesi Tuwachung Municipality-7, Mahadevsthan, Khotang, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2069 BS (2012 AD) at Mahadevsthan, near Halesi, affiliated to Tribhuvan University. It offers a four-year B.Ed. Published scholarship funds include Late Bhagisara Rai Memorial Scholarship Endowment Fund-2070, Late Panch-Kirtimaya Rai Memorial Scholarship Endowment Fund-2076, and Late Rina Rai Memorial Scholarship Endowment Fund-2079. It is one of seven TU community campuses named in a 2025 district report.

name: Sakela Multiple Campus
address: Sakela Rural Municipality-2, Ratanchha, Khotang, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2070 BS (2014 AD) at Ratanchha, affiliated to Tribhuvan University. Published pages state that it offers a Bachelor of Arts. A course directory lists 125 seats and a four-year program. It is one of seven TU community campuses named in a 2025 district report. It is distinct from Sakela Secondary School at Ratanchha, which runs a CTEVT diploma.

name: Mahuregadhi Polytechnic Institute
address: Diktel Rupakot Majhuwagadhi Municipality-13, Nunthala, Khotang, Nepal
description: CTEVT constituent polytechnic established in 2075 BS at Nunthala, about 17 km from Diktel. The institute states that 68 ropanis of land were obtained for infrastructure. It offers three-year diplomas in Civil Engineering (48 seats) and Forestry (40 seats), plus short-term vocational courses. Official pages publish a three-year full-fee figure of Rs. 60,000 for Diploma in Civil Engineering, Rs. 40,000 for the targeted-group scholarship track, and deposit-plus-tour fee only for the merit scholarship track.

name: Shahid Adarsha Campus
address: Molung Rural Municipality-2, Rampur, Okhaldhunga, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2059 BS (2002 AD) at Rampur, about 16 km west of the district headquarters. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University and recognized by UGC. The campus website lists B.Ed. majors in Nepali, English, Mathematics, Population, and Health and Population Education, and also states that it provides education from bachelor to master’s level. It reports participation in UGC SHEP, HERP, and NEHEP.

name: Rumjatar Campus
address: Siddhicharan Municipality-4, Rumjatar, Okhaldhunga, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2063 BS (2006 AD) at Rumjatar. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University and recognized by UGC. It runs a four-year Bachelor of Education program. Nepal Public Campus Association lists CMC chair Mis Pasupati Gunrung and campus chief Indra Kumar Gurung, and QAA status as not applied.

name: Uma Katwal Campus
address: Siddhicharan Municipality-2, Nishankhe, Thulachhap, Okhaldhunga, Nepal
description: Community campus established on 2065 Magh 12 (published as 2009 AD) at Nishankhe, Thulachhap. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University and recognized by UGC. It offers a four-year Bachelor of Education.

name: Ragani Chandeshwori Campus
address: Khijidemba Rural Municipality-2, Ragani Polthali, Okhaldhunga, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2070 BS (published as 2013) with support from Shree Chandeshwori Secondary School, the then VDC, teachers, parents, and local representatives. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University Faculty of Education. Runs a four-year B.Ed. with published majors in Nepali, English, Mathematics, and Population Education. Published land area is 15 ropani 5 ana, with a six-room concrete building. Enrollment for 2081/82 is published as 201 students.

name: Chisankhugadhi Campus Khanibhanjyang
address: Chishankhugadhi Rural Municipality-2, Pokhare, Khanibhanjyang, Okhaldhunga, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2079 BS (2022 AD). Purbanchal University Faculty of Education lists it as Chisankhugadi Campus, Khanibhanjyang, Okhaldunga, with an approved B.Ed. quota of 60. Collegenp lists campus head Narayan Prasad Bastola and first-year areas Social, English, and Nepali.

name: Yasok Campus
address: Kummayak Rural Municipality-1, Yasok, Panchthar, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Community higher-education campus in Yasok, established in 2064 BS (published as 2007 AD). Affiliated with Tribhuvan University and listed by the Nepal Public Campus Association. Current program listings confirm four-year B.Ed. and BBS. A published motto is Empowering Minds, Building Communities. Local news in 2018 and 2023 said teaching was underway in education, humanities, and management faculties; current university examination lists and campus directories confirm B.Ed. and BBS, not a separately named BA program. Older TU and directory listings recorded the same Yasok location as Siddhadevi Campus or Siddha Devi Campus (2064 BS, Yasok Bazar). That older name is treated here as an alias, not a fifth campus. An older Siddha Devi directory listing published the phone +977-24-520304; it is not repeated as a current campus phone.

name: Rabi Campus
address: Miklajung Rural Municipality-4, Rabi Bazaar, Panchthar, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2065 BS (2009 AD); the Nepal Public Campus Association records the establishment date as 2065-09-19. It received Tribhuvan University affiliation in 2065 BS and offers four-year B.Ed. and BBS programs. It is recognized in directory listings by the University Grants Commission. QAA status on the Nepal Public Campus Association page is Applied. EduSanjal has reported 39 students in B.Ed. and 28 in BBS. The campus publishes a journal, Rabi Sangyan, Volume 1, Issue 1, November 2024, ISSN 3059-9423.

name: Tharpu Campus
description: Community campus established in 2065 BS (2009 AD) in Tharpu, Yangwarak, Panchthar. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University and described as recognized by the University Grants Commission. It offers a four-year full-time B.Ed. QAA status on the Nepal Public Campus Association listing is Not Applied. Admission Nepal has reported 68 students studying at the campus. An older TU affiliated list used the pre-federal address Tharpu 2; current directory address is Yangwarak-4.

name: Barun Multiple Campus
description: Community campus in Khandbari, the district headquarters, affiliated to Tribhuvan University and also running NEB +2 programs. Named after the Barun River. It offers bachelor's programs in humanities, education and management and master's programs in education. Edusanjal has reported 516 students (37 BA, 305 B.Ed., 114 BBS, 60 M.Ed.). The campus prospectus states that the one-year B.Ed. is currently suspended. It publishes BARUN Journal.

name: Sankhuwasabha Multiple Campus
description: Community campus established in 2037 BS (1981) in Chainpur. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University for BA, B.Ed., BBS and M.Ed., and to the National Examination Board for +2. Edusanjal reported 156 bachelor students (16 BA, 78 B.Ed., 62 BBS). It appears on Tribhuvan University affiliated-campus lists.

name: Madi Campus
description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University, serving Madi Municipality and nearby rural areas. It offers B.Ed. and BBS. Edusanjal reported 75 students (40 B.Ed. and 35 BBS). It is listed among Tribhuvan University affiliated campuses in Sankhuwasabha.

name: Rameshwor Campus
description: Community campus in Mamling, also listed as Rameswar Campus. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University and offering B.Ed. Edusanjal reported 64 students. The same institution's secondary school runs NEB +2, including a plant science stream. It appears on Tribhuvan University affiliated-campus lists for Sankhuwasabha.

name: Himalaya Kiran Public Campus
address: Khandbari-07, Nayabazar, Khandbari, Sankhuwasabha, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Community campus affiliated to Purbanchal University. Degree classes began in 2062 BS (2005); news reports say it originated as Himalaya Middle School in 1949. Programs are B.Ed., one-year B.Ed., M.Ed., and BBS. Colleges Nepal states it has University Grants Commission approval. A three-storey academic building built with Indian grant assistance of NPR 37.40 million was inaugurated on 6 September 2023.

name: Vidushi Yogmaya Himalayan Ayurveda University
address: Khandbari Municipality-9, Tumlingtar / Dhunge Bisauna, Sankhuwasabha, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: National Ayurveda university established under the Yogamaya Ayurveda University Act, 2079. The central office is in Khandbari Municipality-9. A central college and postgraduate classes were inaugurated in Khandbari; an admission notice was issued for MSc in Yoga and Meditation. Kantipur reported that teaching was suspended from Baisakh 19, 2083 because of political and administrative uncertainty. As of Kartik 2083, land of about 416 ropani across Khandbari-9 and Shadananda-6, Bhojpur, had been obtained and physical construction was still being planned.

name: Makalu Technical Institute
description: Private CTEVT-affiliated institute, also called Makalu Health Academy. An older profile dates establishment to 2055 BS. Current listings include PCL/diploma General Medicine (HA) and Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology, each described as three years, plus TSLC programs in Community Medical Assistant and Medical Laboratory Technology. It is assigned to CTEVT diploma and certificate exam centers in Sankhuwasabha. A 2082/83 CMLT college list includes Makalu Technical Institute, Khandbari.

name: Solukhumbu Multiple Campus
address: Salleri, Solududhkunda Municipality Ward No. 5, Solukhumbu
description: Community, non-profit campus at the district headquarters, established in 1993 AD (2050 BS) with financial support from the Himalayan Trust associated with Sir Edmund Hillary and Ang Rita Sherpa. It is TU-affiliated and also runs NEB +2. Bachelor affiliation timeline published by the campus: B.Ed. 1996, one-year B.Ed. 2000, B.A. 2009, BBS 2013. Master's in Education began in 2005 in Nepali, Health, and Educational Planning and Management, with English education affiliation in 2017. It serves students from Solukhumbu, Okhaldhunga, and Khotang. Nepal Public Campus Association lists QAA status as in process. Campus chief published as Uddab Kumar Sharma. A Himalayan Trust project note dates establishment support to 1991.

name: Himal Darshan Campus
description: Community campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University and described as recognized by the University Grants Commission. It runs B.Ed. and is linked with Himal Darshan Secondary School for classes 1 to 12. Edusanjal lists the location as Necha Batase, Nechasalyan, and reports 60 students studying B.Ed. It appears on UGC community-campus grant lists as Himal Darsan Campus, Nechabatase.

name: Dudhakoshi Multiple Campus
description: Community campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University and described as recognized by the University Grants Commission. It offers BA and B.Ed. Edusanjal reports 51 students, 26 in BA and 25 in B.Ed. It is listed on TU affiliation renewal lists and UGC community-campus records as Dudhkoshi Multiple Campus, Salyan, Solukhumbu. No published phone or email was found.

name: Bishweshwar Prasad Koirala Sanskrit Vidyapeeth
description: Constituent vidyapeeth of Nepal Sanskrit University. NSU records establishment in 2055 BS, Uttara Madhyama classes from the 2055/56 session, and education through Shastri. Prak-Shastri includes compulsory Grammar and Sanskrit Language, with optional Veda, Grammar, Nyaya, and Jyotisha. Shastri has compulsory Sanskrit, English, and Nepali, with optional Grammar, Literature, Niti Shastra, Nepali, political science, and English. Edusanjal lists the campus at Salleri and only Uttar Madhyama; NSU and a campus Facebook post place it at Salyan, Nechasalyan-2. Also listed as B.P. Koirala Sanskrit Vidyapeeth.

name: Solukhumbu Law Campus
description: Law campus established in 2025 AD (2082 BS). CollegeNP documents a three-year LLB under Purbanchal University with permission to enroll 60 students, eligibility as graduation in any subject, campus head Gita Ghimire, director Uddhav Kumar Sharma, and board leadership Ang Rita Sherpa. Initial classes use the buildings of Solukhumbu Multiple Campus. Fees, entrance dates, and separate facilities are not published. Edusanjal lists the campus as a public institution offering BALLB; that program name is not confirmed on the more detailed CollegeNP pages.

name: Thulung Dudhkoshi Technical College
address: Thulung Dudhkoshi Rural Municipality-6, Mukli, Solukhumbu
description: Public CTEVT technical school offering Diploma in Civil Engineering. Edusanjal describes it as a technical school in the Solukhumbu region and says the program is intended to expand to other technical courses later. A business directory lists the website tdtc.edu.np. It is named as an institution in CTEVT diploma and certificate exam-center arrangements for Solukhumbu.

name: Aagaman Campus
address: Duhabi-3, Sunsari, Koshi Province, opposite Sunsari Samudayak Hospital
description: Private campus established in 2070 BS. It runs National Examination Board plus-two programs and Tribhuvan University bachelor programs in management, education, hotel management, and general science.

name: Adarsha College
description: Sister institution of Vishwa Adarsha Academy in Itahari. Edusanjal lists it as affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University. The college site describes work in management, law, IT, humanities, and social sciences.

name: Alpine College
description: Private college established in 2067 BS on College Road, Dharan, offering a Tribhuvan University Bachelor of Business Studies program.

name: B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences
address: Dharan Sub-Metropolitan City, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Health-sciences institute and teaching hospital in Dharan. Public pages describe undergraduate pathways in MBBS, BDS, BSc Nursing, and allied health, plus postgraduate and fellowship training.

name: TNK Balaha Multiple Campus
description: Community campus in Inaruwa listed by Edusanjal under Tribhuvan University. A public course page describes a four-year BBS program.

name: Bharabi Science College
address: Itahari, Sunsari; previously located in Dharan
description: Private science campus established in 2062 BS. It shifted from Dharan to Itahari and offers Tribhuvan University BSc programs, including physics and microbiology.

name: Bhadgaun Sinuwari Multiple Campus
description: Community campus established in 2067 BS at Jhumka, Ramdhuni. It is affiliated to Tribhuvan University for BBS and B.Ed.

name: Bijayapur Technical Institute
description: Private CTEVT technical institute established in 2071 BS. It offers PCL General Medicine, Diploma in Pharmacy, and Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology.

name: Birendra Memorial College
description: Private Tribhuvan University college in Dharan, established in 2060 BS. Public pages list BSc CSIT, BSc Microbiology, BBS, and MBS.

name: College of Nursing, B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences
description: Nursing college unit of B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences in Dharan. The institute homepage lists BSc Nursing among undergraduate programs.

name: Depot Adarsha Multiple Campus
description: Private campus established in 2071 BS at Ghopa Camp, Dharan, near BPKIHS. It offers a four-year Tribhuvan University BBS program.

name: Dharan City College
description: Tribhuvan University-affiliated college in Dharan, described in a public college list as founded in 2009 by teachers of Dharan. Published programs include BA, BBS, and B.Ed.

name: Dharan Mega College
description: Listed as a college in Dharan-12 on the Wikipedia list of educational institutions in Dharan. No public program, affiliation, or contact page was confirmed in this search.

name: Dharan Model College
description: Higher-education branch of Dharan Model Academy, established in 2066 BS. It runs Tribhuvan University bachelor programs in management, education, humanities, and social work.

name: Dharan Multiple Campus
description: Private higher-education institution established in 2068 BS. A public directory states it is affiliated with Tribhuvan University for bachelor programs including B.Tech Food Technology.

name: Edutek College
address: Itahari-9, Biratnagar line (Gaisar Road), opposite Chintan Chautari, Sunsari
description: College in Itahari publicly advertising plus-two streams and bachelor programs. Social listings mark some bachelor programs with an asterisk. A university affiliation was not confirmed on an official academic page in this search.

name: Godawari College
description: Private college established in 2049 BS under Peace Foundation, which also operates Sushma Koirala Memorial Engineering College and Sushma Secondary School. Edusanjal lists TU BBS and BSc CSIT, and a KU BSW program commencing in 2025.

name: Green Peace Lincoln College
address: People’s Marga, ISMT Chowk, Itahari-10, Sunsari; also published as Dipendra Chowk, Itahari
description: Private college established in 2071 BS, affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia. Its site lists BIT, BBA, and MBA.

name: Ithari Global College
description: Itahari college affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University. Edusanjal states that it offers BCA and BSc CSIT.

name: Itahari Namuna College
description: Private college established in 2070 BS in Itahari. Edusanjal lists TU programs in BHM, BCA, BSW, BBS, and BA. The college website also advertises BBM.

name: Janata Multiple Campus
description: Community campus established on 30 Ashad 2045 BS to provide university education in Itahari at moderate fees. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and was QAA-accredited by UGC Nepal on 30 November 2018.

name: Jibika College of Agricultural Sciences
address: Ramdhuni, Sunsari; also listed as Itahari, Sunsari
description: Cooperative-run college affiliated to Agriculture and Forestry University, Rampur. Public pages state that it runs a four-year B.Sc. Agriculture program.

name: Kasturi College of Management
description: Management wing of the Kasturi group at B.P. Chowk, Itahari. Public pages state that it offers Tribhuvan University BBS and MBS.

name: Kaushiki Campus
description: Community campus established in 2060 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. It focuses on teacher education, including four-year and one-year B.Ed. routes.

name: Koshi Saint James College
description: Private college founded in 2064 BS by academic professionals and managed by Koshi Academy. Its website states that it runs Tribhuvan University BBS and BCA programs in downtown Itahari.

name: Mahendra Multiple Campus, Dharan
description: Constituent campus of Tribhuvan University, established in 2012 BS. Edusanjal lists bachelor and master programs in humanities, law, management, and education. Another directory also lists additional management and arts programs.

name: Makalu Technical College
description: Private CTEVT nursing college in Inaruwa, recognized by the Nepal Nursing Council. Public pages state that it offers three-year PCL Nursing with 40 seats.

name: Nara Bahadur Karmacharya Memorial Polytechnic Institute
description: Itahari technical institute affiliated with CTEVT. A national diploma-pharmacy listing names Nara Bahadur Karmacharya Polytechnic Institute, Itahari, among Koshi Province diploma pharmacy colleges.

name: National Academy of Applied Science and Technology
description: Described as a sister organization of Dharan Multiple Campus, operating since 1999. A public directory states that it runs National Examination Board plus-two programs and a CTEVT food or dairy development diploma.

name: National College of Integrated Studies
description: Private college in Itahari, established in 2024 and affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University. Edusanjal states that it offers BBA and MBA.

name: Nilgiri College
description: Private food-technology college founded in 2069 BS by food-technology professionals. It offers a four-year Tribhuvan University B.Tech in Food Technology.

name: Peoples Multiple Health Institute
description: Private health institute established in 2060 BS, affiliated to CTEVT and recognized by the Nepal Nursing Council. It offers PCL Nursing with 40 seats.

name: Pindeshwar Vidyapeeth
description: Sanskrit campus in the premises of Pindeshwar Temple. Edusanjal states that it runs as a branch of Nepal Sanskrit University and offers Prak Shastri, Shastri, and Acharya. Another directory lists Uttarmadhyama and Acharya.

name: Purwanchal Campus, Institute of Engineering
description: Constituent engineering campus of Tribhuvan University Institute of Engineering, formerly Eastern Region Campus. The campus site states it was established in Poush 2034 BS under an Asian Development Bank loan agreement and lists bachelor programs in civil, agricultural, mechanical, electrical, computer, and electronics and communication engineering.

name: Rastriya Janasahayog College
address: Itahari-20, Tarahara, Sunsari; also listed as Hansposa, Itahari
description: Community college established in 2066 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. A public profile lists BBS and B.Ed.

name: Sacred Heart College
description: College in Itahari-7 established in 2025 and affiliated with Purbanchal University for BBA. Edusanjal classifies the institution as public.

name: Sagarmatha College
address: Mahananda Marga, Dharan, Sunsari; also indexed as Itahari, Sunsari
description: Tribhuvan University college listed by Edusanjal at Mahananda Marga, Dharan/Itahari. A public course page describes a four-year BBS program and places the campus in Dharan-3.

name: Saradha Balika Namuna Multiple Campus
description: Dharan campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Edusanjal states that it offers BBS and classifies it as a public institution.

name: Saptakoshi Multiple Campus
description: Community campus established in 2067 BS. It received Tribhuvan University affiliation for BBS in 2067 BS and for the Faculty of Education in 2069 BS.

name: Sunsari Multiple Campus
description: Community campus established in 2037 BS under local educationists, including parliamentarian Shyam Prasad Gupta. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and runs management, education, and humanities programs from bachelor to master level, alongside plus-two.

name: Sunsari Technical College
description: Technical college established in 2052 BS, formerly Sunsari Technical School. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and CTEVT and is described as recognized by Nepal Pharmacy Council, Nepal Health Professional Council, and Nepal Nursing Council.

name: Sushma Koirala Memorial Engineering College
description: Private CTEVT engineering college established in 2056 BS. Edusanjal states that it runs three-year diplomas in civil and computer engineering, with 48 seats in each. It is part of the same institutional group as Godawari College.

name: United National College
description: Private college in Dharan established in 2071 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Public pages list BBS and BHM.

name: Vijayapur College
description: Private college established in 2043 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. A public profile states that it offers Bachelor of Business Studies.

name: Vishwa Adarsha College
description: Private college in Itahari established in 2055 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. A public profile lists BCA, BBS, and MBS.

name: Pathibhara Multiple Campus
address: Phungling Municipality-4, Taplejung, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Pathibhara Multiple Campus (also spelled Pathivara) is a non-profit community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University, not a TU constituent campus. It was established in 2047 BS (published as 1990; some directories list 1991) and is the main higher-education campus in the district headquarters. It runs BA, B.Ed. and BBS, and M.Ed. in Nepali and Educational Planning and Management. Edusanjal also lists National Examinations Board plus-two programs in Management, Humanities and Education. It serves students from Taplejung and nearby districts such as Panchthar and parts of Tehrathum. Finances come mainly from student fees, UGC projects and local-government support. Published highlights include about 0.74 hectares of land (14-8-3-0), a library of 8,092 items, and an Annual Report 2080 submitted to UGC. It is not listed among UGC QAA-accredited institutions. Campus Chief published on the campus site is Sajan Poudel; Campus Management Committee chairperson is Shila Ijam (Rai). Edusanjal reports 402 bachelor students (86 BA, 211 B.Ed., 105 BBS) without a stated reporting year. TU exam-centre lists use campus code 201.

name: Sinam Multiple Campus
address: Sirijangha Rural Municipality-1, Sinam, Taplejung, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Sinam Multiple Campus is a community campus in Sirijangha-1, Taplejung, established in 2065 BS. The campus UGC report states it has run since 2008 AD and offers Bachelor of Education and Bachelor of Business Studies under Tribhuvan University, recognized by the University Grants Commission. UGC EMIS 2023/24 reports 129 B.Ed. students (42 male, 87 female) and 22 BBS students (12 male, 10 female). Edusanjal, without a stated year, reports 411 bachelor students (322 B.Ed., 89 BBS). TU exam-centre lists use campus code 770. Edusanjal states the campus received CTEVT affiliation in 2075 BS for Diploma in Agriculture (Plant Science). The campus UGC report lists only B.Ed. and BBS, and CTEVT centre lists assign diploma agriculture and civil programs to Sinam Secondary School, Sirijangha, not to this campus. No published mission or vision statement was found.

name: Myanglung Campus
description: Community/public campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University for bachelor and master programmes and to the National Examinations Board for +2. Formally established in 2038 BS at the district headquarters after higher education had been available only at Chuhandanda. It began with PCL Humanities, added BA in 2048/049 BS, B.Ed. in 2057/058 BS, BBS in 2064/065 BS, and master's classes from 2066/067 BS. Edusanjal reported 241 students. The campus has taken part in UGC SHEP and HERP and has been in the QAA process. It also runs +2 Management, Education and Humanities, which are not bachelor or higher programmes.

name: Basanta Multiple Campus
description: Community, non-profit campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University and recognized by UGC. The campus website says a public meeting on 17 Magh 2066 BS decided to establish it at the then Basanta Higher Secondary School grounds, and that BBS affiliation was received in the last week of Shrawan 2067 BS, with B.Ed. added in 2069 BS. Morning classes run from 6:00 to 11:00. Edusanjal reported 66 students (32 in B.Ed. and 34 in BBS). Published establishment dates conflict: campus site Magh 2066 BS, CollegeNP 2009 AD / 2066 BS, Edusanjal and the chair's message 2067 BS, and NPCA 2067-04-24 BS.

name: Hyatrung Jharana Campus
address: Aathrai Rural Municipality-1, Sankranti Bazar, Dadagaun, Tehrathum, Nepal
description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-approved. Established in 2066 BS (published as 2009 AD) and named after Hyatrung waterfall. It offers bachelor-level education. EducateNepal reported 52 students in B.Ed. No campus website, phone, or email was published on the pages reviewed.

name: Chhathar Campus
address: Chhathar, Panchakanya Pokhari, Chhathar Rural Municipality, Terhathum, Nepal
description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-recognized. Established in 2069 BS (2012 AD). It offers B.Ed. with published specializations in Economics, English and Nepali, including morning classes for employed learners. Edusanjal reported 79 students. Directory pages that call it private or give a generic info@chhatharcampus.edu.np address were not used because they conflict with community-campus sources and show an unclaimed listing.

name: Tehrathum Polytechnic Institute
description: CTEVT constituent technical institute at Ewa, Aathrai-4. CTEVT's annual report lists it as तेह्रथुम बहुप्राविधिक शिक्षालय, आठराई, तेह्रथुम, offering Diploma in Agriculture (Plant Science) and Diploma in Agriculture (Animal Science). It is not a +2-only school. A CollegeNP establishment year of 1989 matches CTEVT's own founding year and is not treated as the institute's founding year. Published phones differ between the institute site and CollegeNP.

name: Triyuga Janata Multiple Campus
address: Motigada, Triyuga Municipality-8, Gaighat, Udayapur, Nepal
description: Community/public campus in Gaighat, established in 2044 BS (1987 AD). It is affiliated to Tribhuvan University, is listed by the Nepal Public Campus Association, and also runs +2 programs under the National Examinations Board. UGC granted first-cycle QAA on 6 January 2019, stated as valid until 5 January 2024; a second-cycle self-study report was submitted on 5 January 2024. The campus website describes a transition toward autonomy and a Research Management Cell. Published higher-education programs include BA, BASW, BBS, four-year B.Ed., one-year B.Ed., BICTE, M.Ed., and MBS.

name: Baruwa Campus
description: Community campus established in 2066 BS (2009 AD), affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-approved. It offers BBS and B.Ed. Edusanjal reported 377 students, including 246 in BBS and 131 in B.Ed. The February 2025 TU affiliated-campus list gives the address as Triyuga-2, Gaighat, which differs from the CollegeNP ward-12 address.

name: Jyoti Janata Multiple Campus
address: Chaudandigadhi Municipality-6, Beltar, Sathdhare, Udayapur, Koshi Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2065 BS (2008 AD) at Beltar, affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-approved. It offers B.Ed. and BBS. The February 2025 TU list records it as Jyoti Janta Multiple Campus, Beltar 5, Udayapur. A 2025 municipal report said Chaudandigadhi Municipality had allocated an annual conditional improvement budget of Rs. 600,000 and appointed a full-time campus chief.

name: Shree Narad Adarsh Education Campus
address: Chaudandigadhi Municipality-4, Basaha, Barkhedanda, Udayapur, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2060 BS (2003 AD) at Basaha and affiliated to Tribhuvan University for B.Ed. It is distinct from the adjoining Narad Adarsha Secondary School. Indian grant-funded campus infrastructure, reported as about NRs 30.2 million, was inaugurated in 2019; reports described a two-storey building with 12 classrooms, a library, a meeting hall, and separate toilets. A 2022 local report said about 200 education-faculty students were enrolled and named Dhrub Rai as campus head.

name: Udayashree Multiple Campus
description: Community campus established in 2057 BS (2000 AD) at Katari, affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-approved. Published programs are B.Ed. and BA. TU Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences lists it among general campuses, not as a separately confirmed BCA college. College of Natural Resource Management, Katari, initially operated from this campus before moving to its own building about 4 km east of Katari.

name: Shree Belaka Janata Campus
description: Named as Shree Belaka Janata Campus, Gurungchauri, Thoksila-7, Udayapur, on Tribhuvan University's affiliated campus list published 23 February 2025. Nepal Public Campus Association also lists Belaka Janta Campus, without a public program or contact profile found in this search. No published course list, year of establishment, phone, or fee was found. It should not be confused with Shree Janata Belaka Secondary School, Purandah, or Shree Janata Model Secondary School, Gurungchauri, which are school-level institutions.

name: Rauta Janata Campus
description: Named as Rauta Janata Campus, Rauta, Udayapur, on Tribhuvan University's affiliated campus list published 23 February 2025. No public program list, establishment year, phone, email, or campus website was found in this search. It should not be confused with Shree Rauta Janata Secondary School, Rautamai-6, which Edusanjal lists as a school from ECD to grade 10.

name: Takshashila College
description: Private college in Triyuga, Udayapur, listed by Edusanjal as established in 2024 and affiliated to Rajarshi Janak University for BBA. The 30 August 2024 RJU affiliation notice lists Takshashila College, Udayapur, for BBA. No phone, email, fee, or campus website was published on the pages found.

name: Modern Institute of Health Science
description: Private CTEVT-affiliated health institute in Gaighat. TyroCity lists establishment in 2061 BS; that year was not confirmed on a current official page, so the year is left unset. Published programs include diploma-level General Medicine (HA), CMLT, and Pharmacy, plus shorter TSLC/ANM programs. It is recognized in CTEVT sources and is an assigned institution for the Mangsir 2083 diploma and certificate examinations. A TyroCity profile names Er. Shailendra Mohan Jha as chairperson and publishes a vision of quality technical education in health and non-health fields.

name: Triyuga National Education Academy
description: Private CTEVT technical college in Triyuga-2. Colleges Nepal says it was founded in 2069 BS; CollegeNP lists 2014, so the year is left unset. It offers diploma CMLT and, according to its public page, diploma-level Ayurveda and lab programs, plus pre-diploma agriculture, veterinary, livestock, lab assistant, and Ayurveda programs. It is an assigned institution for the Mangsir 2083 CTEVT diploma and certificate examinations.

name: Ram Raja (Mohan Bikram Shah) Multiple Campus
name_ne: राम राजा (मो. वि. शाह) बहुमुखी क्याम्पस
description: Community campus founded on 30 December 1981 (15 Poush 2038 BS) in Kalaiya and named after Mohan Bikram Shah (Ram Raja) after land and a building were donated by the family. The official site states it offers MBS, BBS, M.Ed., and B.Ed. under Tribhuvan University. Directory pages also list a one-year B.Ed. and +2 programmes. A December 2024 report said the campus then had 1,332 students in commerce and education faculties.

name: Bakuliya Campus
address: Bhawanipur, Bakuliya, Jitpur Simara Sub-Metropolitan City Ward 5, Bara, Nepal
description: Community campus in Bhawanipur/Bakuliya, affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as recognized by the University Grants Commission. Published programme information is limited to a four-year B.Ed. TU campus code 183 appears in a TU affiliation-renewal list for Bara, Jitpur.

name: Sapahi College
description: Community campus established in 2069 BS (2013 AD; listed date 2069-09-26), affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as approved by the University Grants Commission. It offers BBS and B.Ed. Campus chief is named as Dinesh Adhikari. QAA status is published as in process. Older TU lists use the address Sapahi-9, Bara.

name: Gauri Shankar Campus
description: Community campus established in 2063 BS (2006 AD) in Nijgadh, affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-recognized. The campus website lists Bachelor of Business Studies and Bachelor of Education. A college directory also lists bachelor-level humanities (Rural Development) and states that bachelor and master levels are offered, but a named master's programme was not confirmed on the pages opened. The campus has submitted a QAA self-study report. It publishes a research journal titled GS WOW – Wisdom of Worthy.

name: Dumarwana Multiple Campus
address: Jeetpursimara Sub-Metropolitan City-15, Dumarwana Hattisar, Bara, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Non-profit community campus established in 2064 BS (2007 AD), affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-recognized. It runs bachelor classes in Education, Humanities and Social Sciences, and Management. An annual report lists subject areas in each faculty. Campus chief listed on the campus site is Radheyshyam Shiwakoti.

name: Gadhimai Multiple Campus
address: Mahagadhimai Municipality-1, Bariyarpur, Bara, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2066 BS (2009 AD; listed date 2066-04-30) beside the Hulaki Highway at Bariyarpur. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University and described as UGC-approved. The published degree programme is B.Ed. QAA status is published as not accredited. It serves students from Mahagadhimai and nearby rural municipalities.

name: Mount Everest College
description: Private institution listed by education directories as affiliated to Tribhuvan University and offering BBS in Simara, Bara. It is listed separately from Mount Everest Secondary School. No establishment year, phone, email, or campus website was published on the college pages opened.

name: Shubharambha College
address: Jeetpursimara Sub-Metropolitan City-2, Simara, Bara, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Community institution established in 2066 BS (2009 AD) in Simara. Also listed as Shuvarambha College and Shuvarambha Bahumukhi Campus. Bachelor BBS is affiliated to Tribhuvan University and appears in TU BBS examination-centre lists. MBA is affiliated to Rajarshi Janak University. The college also runs NEB +2 programmes in Management, Education, and Law; those are not higher-education degrees.

name: Rainbow Health Management and Technical College
description: College in Simara established in 2080 BS (2024 AD). The published programme is BBA under Rajarshi Janak University. Ownership type was not stated on the page opened.

name: Mendit Polytech College
address: Manakamana College Building, behind the CDO Office, Ghusukpur, Kalaiya-5, Bara, Nepal
description: Mendit Polytech Pvt. Ltd., also called Mendit Polytech College, is a private institution established in 2024 AD in Kalaiya-5. It is affiliated to Rajarshi Janak University and lists admissions for BBA and B.Sc. CSIT. Published features include scholarships up to 100 percent, free textbooks, seminars, industrial tours, and job-placement support. No phone or email was published on the page opened.

name: Gyan Batika Institute of Technical and Medical Science
name_ne: ज्ञानवाटिका प्राविधिक तथा चिकित्सा विज्ञान प्रतिष्ठान
description: Private CTEVT institute in Parwanipur-5, described as a sister organization of L.S. Neuro and General Hospital Pvt. Ltd. It offers three-year diploma and certificate programmes in nursing, general medicine, and pharmacy, with practical training linked to the 100-bed hospital. A directory page dates establishment to 2020.

name: Prasauni Polytechnic Institute
description: CTEVT constituent technical institute at Prasauni-2, Bara. The CTEVT Madhesh Province page lists Diploma in Electrical Engineering. A claimed education-directory page lists three-year diplomas in Automobile Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering, each with 48 seats. A government CTEVT programme list records Diploma in Automobile Engineering at this constituent institute with an annual-capacity figure of 48 and a published fee of NPR 98,000 for three years. Phone numbers differ across public pages.

name: Simraungadh Polytechnic Institute
description: Named by the CTEVT Examination Control Office as an institution in Bara assigned to the Mangsir 2083 diploma and certificate examination centre at Shree Teen Chandra Secondary School. Programme names, ownership, establishment year, and contact details were not published in the sources opened.

name: Sanothimi Campus
description: Constituent campus of Tribhuvan University Faculty of Education. Founded in 1968 as the National Vocational Training Center and affiliated to TU in 1972. It offers teacher education and, since 2080 BS, BBS.

name: Khwopa College
description: Community college undertaken by Bhaktapur Municipality. TU decided on 2080-4-7 that Sharada Campus, Bhaktapur merged with Khwopa College. It offers bachelor's and master's programs in humanities, management, science, and education.

name: Khwopa Polytechnic Institute
description: Community technical institute undertaken by Bhaktapur Municipality and affiliated to CTEVT. It runs three-year PCL Nursing and Diploma in Civil Engineering.

name: Seabird International College
description: Listed by Edusanjal among bachelor's colleges in Bhaktapur and affiliated to Tribhuvan University. Specific current programs were not published on the pages retrieved.

name: Padma College
description: Listed by Edusanjal among colleges in Bhaktapur, including education-discipline listings. Affiliation and program details were not published on the pages retrieved.

name: Bagiswori College
description: Community institution at the eastern gate of Bhaktapur. The school began in 2015 BS; +2 programs started in 2061 BS, and bachelor-level study is also offered. TU affiliation is listed by Edusanjal. A separate Purbanchal University college, Bagiswori College of Management, is also listed in the district.

name: Janapremi College
description: TU-affiliated college listed by Edusanjal among bachelor's and management colleges in Kaushaltar. Specific program names were not published on the pages retrieved.

name: Nicholson College
description: Private college in Sallaghari. +2 is affiliated to the National Examination Board; bachelor's and master's management programs are affiliated to Tribhuvan University.

name: Universal Modern College
description: TU-affiliated college listed by Edusanjal in Sallaghari. Specific program names were not published on the pages retrieved.

name: Kathmandu World School of Engineering and Management
description: Far-Western University college listed by Edusanjal in Suryabinayak, including among BBA providers.

name: Shree Krishna Multiple Campus
description: Community campus established in 2066 BS (2009 AD) and affiliated to Tribhuvan University. It runs Bachelor of Business Studies. A directory page also gives an established year of 2004, which conflicts with the 2066 BS account.

name: Iwamura College of Health Science
description: Academic wing of Dr. Iwamura Memorial Hospital and Research Center, affiliated to CTEVT. It offers PCL and diploma health programs and is recognized in directory listings by Nepal Nursing Council, Nepal Pharmacy Council, and Nepal Health Professional Council.

name: Suwal International College
description: A Colleges Nepal directory page states that Suwal International College is in Suryabinayak and offers bachelor's and master's programs, including a three-year Master of Computer Applications, with Dr. Prakash Suwal named as principal. An independent college website was not retrieved, so program and contact details beyond that directory page are unpublished here.

name: Nilkantha Multiple Campus
description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University, campus code 375, established in 2057 BS. UGC QAA-accredited on 22 June 2020. Official site states it runs B.Ed., BBS, M.Ed., BA and MBS; admission notices also cover BICTE. Edusanjal records that Ganesh Himal Campus, Nilkantha, was merged into this campus by a TU decision dated 2080-4-7. Reported scale is about 1,000 students.

name: Adarsha Multiple Campus
address: Gajuri Rural Municipality-1, Gajuri Bazar, Dhading, Nepal
description: Non-profit community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University, established in 2063 BS (2006 AD) with the initiation of Rajendra Prasad Pandey. Campus strategic plan states it began with B.Ed., added management in 2064 BS, and introduced M.Ed. in Education Planning and Management and Nepali Education in 2075 BS. HEIMS 2081/82 records BBS, B.Ed. and M.Ed. enrollment. A two-storey building built with Indian grant assistance was inaugurated on 26 June 2023.

name: CP College
address: Nilkantha Municipality-4, CP Chowk, CP Nagar, Dhading, Nepal
description: Private TU-affiliated college established in 2010 AD (2067 BS), approved by the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology. It offers BBS and is described as a sister organization of Children Park Secondary Boarding School. HEIMS 2081/82 records 22 BBS students. TU affiliation lists include CP College, Dhading.

name: Dhunibesi Adarsha Campus
description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University, established in 2009 AD (2066 BS). CollegeNP places it at Dhunibeshi-3, Chhatrepati; Edusanjal lists Jeevanpur-6, Dhunibeshi. It runs four-year B.Ed. and BBS. HEIMS 2081/82 records 93 students in BBS and B.Ed. Campus chief is published as Jeevnath Dhakal.

name: Machchhindra Multiple Campus
address: Dhunibeshi Municipality Ward No. 7, Khanikhola, Naubise, Dhading, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2010 AD (2066 BS), affiliated to Tribhuvan University. Current Edusanjal, CollegeNP and HEIMS 2081/82 listings give BBS and BA, not B.Ed. BA subject areas published as Nepali, Sociology and RD. HEIMS records 223 students. An older directory page that listed B.Ed. conflicts with these later sources.

name: Netrawati Community Multiple Campus
address: Tripurasundari Rural Municipality-7, Khahare, Dhading, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2064 BS at Khahare, about 34 km north of Dhadingbesi, through local initiative linked with Shree Achane Secondary School. Edusanjal also lists the place as Tripureshor. Campus profiles state B.Ed. since 2064 BS and BBS since 2070 BS. HEIMS 2081/82 records only B.Ed. enrollment (44 students). NPCA lists campus chief Basudev Sedai.

name: Saphal College
description: Bachelor-level arm of Success Academy / Saphal College. The school site says the academy was established in 2068 BS, plus-two in 2074 BS, and bachelor study in 2070 BS, and states TU affiliation. HEIMS 2081/82 records Saphal College, Dhading, with BBS and 50 students. A TU BBS exam-centre list places Saphal College at Baireni-8, Galchhi, Dhading. The website text also mentions management and humanities at bachelor level, but only BBS is confirmed in HEIMS.

name: Namuna Bageshwori Multiple Campus
address: Galchhi Rural Municipality-6, Baireni Bazar, Dhading, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2067 BS (2010 AD), affiliated to Tribhuvan University, offering four-year BBS and B.Ed. HEIMS 2081/82 lists Shree Namuna Bageshworee Multiple Campus, Dhading, with BBS and B.Ed. and 87 students. Edusanjal’s district list places Baireni under Benighat Rorang, which conflicts with the Galchhi-6 address used by CollegeNP and a news video. A TU exam-centre list once recorded Baireni-9.

name: Dhading Polytechnic Institute
description: CTEVT constituent technical institute established in 2075 BS (2018 AD).
