Edusanjal and CollegeNP state it offers diploma programs in Agriculture (Plant Science) and Agriculture (Animal Science). A CTEVT institutional list records 40 seats in each program. These are diploma programs, not university bachelor degrees.

name: Nilkantha Polytechnic Institute
description: CTEVT constituent technical institute established in 2079 BS (2022 AD). Edusanjal states it offers three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering specialized in Hydropower and Diploma in Automobile Engineering. CollegeNP details the hydropower diploma with intake 48 and 4 scholarship seats. A Ministry listing also classifies the hydropower diploma as a constituent CTEVT program in Nilakantha. These are diploma programs, not university bachelor degrees.

name: Janaswasthya Tatha Prabidhik Adhyayan School
description: Listed among CTEVT diploma/certificate institutions in Dhading. A CTEVT health-program directory lists Health Assistant (General Medicine) at Janaswasthya Tatha Prabidhik Adhyayan School, Nilkantha. CTEVT exam-centre notices assign the school to Dhading centres. A 2019 video title places a similarly named school at Chaptari, Dhading. No official phone, fee, or establishment year was found on the pages opened. This is a CTEVT diploma/certificate program, not a university bachelor campus.

name: Bardibas Janata Multiple Campus
description: Community, non-profit campus established in 2064 BS with local participation to provide affordable higher education in western Mahottari and nearby areas. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University and approved by the University Grants Commission of Nepal. It offers bachelor's programs in management and education and a master's program in education. Public reports place it at Bardibas-14, with about 1,200 students, and note a Letter of Intent toward quality assurance.

name: Nava Kshitiz Campus
description: Public campus in Bardibas-8 offering bachelor programs under Tribhuvan University and Far-Western University. It is approved by the University Grants Commission of Nepal. Published establishment dates vary between 2065 BS (2008 AD) and 2066 BS (2009 AD).

name: Shree Durga Campus
address: Manara, Manara Shisawa Municipality, Mahottari, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Public campus established in 2066 BS (2009 AD) and affiliated to Tribhuvan University. It is approved by the University Grants Commission of Nepal and currently offers Bachelor of Business Studies on the morning shift.

name: Ramananda Bisheshwor Mahendra Campus
description: Public higher-education campus in the district headquarters, affiliated to Tribhuvan University and also linked to the National Examinations Board for plus-two programs. It is approved by the University Grants Commission of Nepal and offers bachelor's and master's programs as well as plus-two streams.

name: Yajnavalkya Lakshminarayan Vidyapeeth
description: Constituent Sanskrit campus of Nepal Sanskrit University at Matihani, associated with the Lakshminarayan Math. Public histories date the teaching tradition to 1801 BS (1744 CE) under King Hema Karna Sen and the sage Tasmaiya Baba. It offers traditional Sanskrit programs and has been reported to teach up to Acharya level. Published CE dates sometimes conflict between 1744 and 1774.

name: College of Natural Resource Management, Bardibas
address: Kisan Nagar, Bardibas Municipality Ward 6, Mahottari, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Constituent college of Agriculture and Forestry University under the Faculty of Agriculture, established in 2075 BS. It is about 5 km south of Bardibas Bazaar and has land allocated for academic buildings and an agricultural farm. It runs a four-year B.Sc. Agriculture program.

name: NATHM Bardibas
address: Bardibas-14, Bardibas Municipality, Mahottari, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Branch of the Nepal Academy of Tourism and Hotel Management, a government academy under the Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation. The Bardibas branch was opened as a provincial expansion and runs Bachelor in Hospitality Management in partnership with Kathmandu University. Published start years include 2020 and 2022.

name: Gaushala Multiple Campus
address: Gaushala Municipality-5, Mahottari, Madhesh Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2069 BS (2012 AD), affiliated to Tribhuvan University, offering four-year B.Ed. and BBS programs. It appears as campus code 975 in Tribhuvan University examination centre lists.

name: Kantibazar Rastriya Campus
description: Listed as Tribhuvan University campus code 935, Kantibazar Rastriya Campus, Laxminiya-7, in official TU bachelor examination centre lists, including the 4-year B.Ed. centre list for 2081. A dedicated public campus profile with phone, fee or website was not found. It should not be confused with nearby plus-two schools that use similar names.

name: Bherukhi Campus
description: Listed as Tribhuvan University campus code 977, Bherukhi Campus, Loharpatti-7, in official 4-year B.Ed. examination centre lists. No separate public profile with contact details, fees or facilities was found. A similarly named secondary school in Loharpatti is a plus-two school and is not treated here as this campus.

name: Yog Manohar Basant Janta Campus
description: Listed as Tribhuvan University campus code 978, Yog Manohar Basant Janta Campus, Balwa-3, in official 4-year B.Ed. examination centre lists. No dedicated public page with phone, email, fees or facilities was found.

name: Ramnarayan Ayodhya Janata Campus
description: Listed as Tribhuvan University campus code 974, Ramnarayan Ayodhya Janata Campus, Pipara, in official 4-year B.Ed. examination centre lists. No dedicated public campus profile with contact details was found. The similarly named Ram Narayan Ayodhya Secondary School at Pipara is a plus-two school and is not listed as this campus.

name: Bardibas New Horizon College
description: Private college in Bardibas listed by EduSanjal as affiliated to Far-Western University and offering BBA. No published phone, email, fee, establishment year or facility list was found.

name: Nirmal Lama Polytechnic Institute
description: Public CTEVT constituent polytechnic established in 2018 at Khayarmara, about 20 km from Bardibas bazaar. It is described as a model technical institute of Madhesh Province and runs three-year diploma and certificate programs.

name: Chitragupt Institute of Technology
description: Private CTEVT-affiliated technical institute in Bardibas, established in 2013 AD (2070 BS). It offers three-year PCL and certificate health programs as well as shorter pre-diploma courses. Only the three-year programs are listed here as higher CTEVT programs.

name: Rara Technical Institute
description: Private CTEVT-affiliated technical institute in Bardibas offering PCL in General Medicine and a medical laboratory certificate program. One directory dates the institute to 2011 AD (2067 BS).

name: Aishwarya Multiple Campus
description: Private multiple campus in Birgunj affiliated to Tribhuvan University offering bachelor-level programs.

name: Madhesh Institute of Health Sciences
description: Provincial health-science institute of Madhesh Province. Public listings associate health-science teaching capacity with the province including Parsa; confirm campus location before treating it as a Birgunj-only campus.

name: Kshitiz Education Foundation
description: CTEVT-affiliated technical institute in Birgunj offering diploma and higher technical programs in health and engineering trades.

name: Everest College
description: Private college in Birgunj listed for bachelor-level management and IT programs.

name: Himalayan College of Engineering
description: Name appears in some Birgunj college directories; affiliation, programs and operating status were not confirmed on an official page during this search.

name: Model Multiple College
description: Private multiple college in Birgunj listed for bachelor programs under TU affiliation in public directories.

name: Parsa Community Campus
description: Community campus name associated with Parsa district in campus directories; exact municipality and current program list were not confirmed on an official site.

name: Pokhariya Multiple Campus
description: Community campus in Pokhariya municipality of Parsa, listed for TU bachelor programs outside Birgunj.

name: Bindabasini Campus
description: Community campus name appearing in Parsa higher-education listings; detailed contact and program pages were not retrieved.

name: Advance Academy
description: Private academy in Birgunj listed for bachelor-level management study. +2 programs, if offered, are outside this record's focus.

name: Birgunj Institute of Technology
description: Technical institute in Birgunj associated with CTEVT diploma-level engineering and IT programs in public listings.

name: Nepal Engineering College Birgunj Center
description: Some directories mention a Birgunj-linked engineering study center; an official Pokhara University campus page confirming a full constituent or affiliated engineering college in Parsa was not confirmed in this search. Treat as unverified.

name: Madhesh Agriculture and Forestry University related outreach
description: No confirmed AFU constituent campus with a published degree program seated in Parsa was verified. Field extension or outreach activity, if any, is not recorded here as a college.

name: Kalika Himalaya Campus
address: Kalikasthan, Dhaibung-5 / Kalika-2, Kalika Rural Municipality, Rasuwa, Nepal
description: Community campus in Kalikasthan, Rasuwa, affiliated to Tribhuvan University and listed by the Nepal Public Campus Association. It opened in 2005 AD (2062 BS). Published directories report Bachelor of Education and Bachelor of Business Studies; Edusanjal recorded 109 students in B.Ed. and 107 in BBS. CollegeNP states B.Ed. began in 2062/63 and BBS in 2067/68, and that an M.Ed. program was launched in 2075/76 BS. NPCA lists M.Ed. among offered programs and records QAA status as Applied. It also appears as a TU examination centre.

name: Rasuwa Campus
description: Named as an affiliated campus of Tribhuvan University at Dhunche, Rasuwa (serial 560) in TU's affiliated campus directory published at portal.tu.edu.np. No separate public page was found giving programs, fees, facilities, notices, reviews, or contact details. It is distinct from Rasuwa Secondary School, which offers only up to grade 12.

name: Uttargaya Campus
description: Named as an affiliated campus of Tribhuvan University at Laharepauwa, Rasuwa (serial 561) in TU's affiliated campus directory published at portal.tu.edu.np. No separate public page was found giving programs, fees, facilities, notices, reviews, or contact details.

name: Kamala Multiple Campus
address: Dudhauli Municipality-9, Dudhauli, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2064 BS. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University and recognized by the University Grants Commission. Offers bachelor's and master's programs in education and humanities. Public pages report more than 500 students and 21 teachers and staff.

name: College of Natural Resource Management, Marin, Kapilakot
address: Marin Rural Municipality-7, Kapilakot, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
description: Second constituent college of Agriculture and Forestry University, established by a senate decision on 5 Baisakh 2074. Located about 26 km west of Sindhulimadi. Offers B.Sc. Agriculture. Formal opening was on 3 Falgun 2074. Published intake figures vary by page (about 45 to 54 students per year).

name: Sindhuli Community Technical Institute
address: Nunthala, Kamalamai Municipality-6, Rammadi, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
description: Nonprofit community technical institute formed with DCC Sindhuli, Kamalamai Municipality, and CTEVT. Operates on CTEVT-owned land of about 3.399 hectares at Nunthala. Runs CTEVT diploma programs and Kathmandu University bachelor programs in technical education. A 2022 KU agreement covered B.Tech.Ed. (IT) and B.Tech.Ed. (Civil Engineering).

name: Technical Training Centre, Kamalamai
address: Kamalamai-6, Sindhulimadi, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
description: CTEVT-affiliated technical training centre established in 1996 (2053 BS). Not a +2-only school. Published program lists differ by source: one lists ANM and TSLC Community Medicine Assistant; another lists TSLC in Civil Engineering, Certificate in Diagnostic Radiography, and PCL in General Medicine (Health Assistant).

name: Tripureshwor Shiksha Campus
address: Tinpatan Rural Municipality-8, Bahuntilpung, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established on 5 October 2007 (18 Ashwin 2064 BS) to provide local higher education. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University and recognized by the University Grants Commission. Main published higher-education program is Bachelor of Education. Early classes were held at Benkateshwar Higher Secondary School.

name: Gaumati Multiple Campus
address: Madibazar, Kamalamai Municipality-6, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2067 BS (2010 AD). Affiliated to Tribhuvan University and recognized by the University Grants Commission. Confirmed programs include BA and BBS. An Edusanjal page also lists B.Ed.; a UGC EMIS extract for 2023-24 records BA and BBS enrollment.

name: Tinpatan Multiple Campus
address: Tinpatan Rural Municipality-2, Bhimsthan, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2064 BS (2007 AD), also listed as Tinpatan Shiksha Campus. TU campus code 638. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University and recognized by the University Grants Commission. Offers B.Ed. and BBS.

name: Saraswoti Campus
address: Dudhauli Municipality-4, Dakaha, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
description: Community campus established in 2064 BS (2007 AD). TU campus code 636. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University and recognized by the University Grants Commission. Offers B.Ed. and BBS under the annual system.

name: Janajagriti Campus
address: Kamalamai Municipality-9, Bhiman, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
description: Community campus at Bhiman. Detailed campus pages date establishment to 2063 BS (2006 AD); one directory header also shows 2003. Affiliated to Tribhuvan University and recognized by the University Grants Commission. Offers a four-year Bachelor of Education. A sister school, Jana Jagriti Secondary School, operates separately at school level.

name: Lumbini ICT Campus
description: Lumbini ICT Campus is a private college in Gaindakot offering bachelor programs in BSc CSIT, BIM, BCA, and BHM. The campus states that it focuses on quality education, laboratories, and student-led activities.

name: Balkumari College
description: Balkumari College in Bharatpur, Chitwan was established on 18 September 1986 and is affiliated to Tribhuvan University. The college website states that it received UGC QAA certification on 22 November 2009 and ISO 9001 quality-management certification in July 2008.

name: NIT College (Nagarik Institute of Technology)
description: NIT College, Nagarik Institute of Technology, is in Gaindakot, Nawalpur and is affiliated with Kathmandu University. The campus site lists a four-year Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT) and describes a learn-and-earn approach with laboratories and placement support.

name: Nagarik College
description: Nagarik College in Gaindakot-2, East Nawalpur was founded in 2013. It runs a four-year Bachelor of Technology in Food Technology affiliated to Tribhuvan University under the Institute of Science and Technology.
